fdroid:com.resolvecommunity.awaydoomscro.name: AwayDoomscrollin'
fdroid:com.resolvecommunity.awaydoomscro.summary: Break the scrolling loop on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
fdroid:com.resolvecommunity.awaydoomscro.description:
Break the scrolling loop without losing touch. AwayDoomscrollin' is an open-source Android app from Resolve Community. It covers the feeds and stops short-video scrolling on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, while messages, search and the things you choose to watch stay available. It does not set time limits.
How it works:
• Protection uses the accessibility information these apps provide. It reads the structure of the screen rather than its text, so it works the same in any language. Updates to these apps, Android or your phone's software can delay or break detection, so it is not guaranteed to work on every device.
What it covers:
• Instagram: Both modes cover Home and Explore and block the Reels tab. Messages and search stay open, and the Explore cover stays below the keyboard. Balanced keeps profiles, profile posts, Stories and Highlights open and lets you watch one Reel you open, with its comments; swiping to the next one takes you back. Strict also covers profile posts and blocks Reels, Stories and Highlights.
• YouTube: Both modes cover Home and block the Shorts tab. Search results, channels, playlists, the You tab and long videos stay open. Balanced keeps Subscriptions open and lets you watch one Short opened from Subscriptions, search, a channel or a link; swiping to the next one takes you back. Strict also covers Subscriptions and blocks all Shorts.
• TikTok: You can open and browse TikTok. The first swipe to the next video in a video feed takes you back, and on Home every top tab other than For You switches back to For You. TikTok has a single protection setting. The regional TikTok app used in Korea, Japan and Southeast Asia is protected too.
• Open in Messages (Instagram, optional): when Instagram opens on Home, the app opens Messages for you.
• Languages: English, Turkish, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Korean.
• If your phone stops protection in the background, a notification tells you within about a minute. On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO, setup also leads to Autostart, which brings protection back by itself.
• You stay in control: protection can be turned off in the app or in Android's accessibility settings, and the app does not try to stop you.
• Analytics: blocks for today, this week, this month and all time, your busiest hour, measured Instagram and YouTube curtain time (not an estimate of time saved) and a daily streak for every day protection is on.
Privacy:
• All protection decisions are made on your phone. What is on your screen is never sent anywhere.
• The app has internet access only for optional usage data sharing, which is off by default. Nothing is sent until you read the details and tap "Agree to share", and protection works without it.
• When sharing is on, the app sends a short summary to awaydoomscrollin.com at most once a day: a random installation ID, your phone model, Android and screen details, the versions of AwayDoomscrollin', Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, block counts per app, and the measured Instagram and YouTube curtain time. Your streak is not sent. Turning sharing off stops new reports. The server keeps the latest summary for up to 90 days and stores only a hashed form of the ID; encrypted backups are kept for 14 days.
• The troubleshooting log in About is off unless you turn it on. It stays on your phone for 24 hours, contains no names, messages or screen text and is never sent on its own; you can paste it into a support email.
AwayDoomscrollin' is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Meta, ByteDance, Google, Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube. Their names are used only to describe compatibility.

fdroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.name: Karui ToDo
fdroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.summary: 200kB aesthetic notes app with pomodoro, calendar, reminders and widgets
fdroid:io.github.ronynn.karui.description:
An open source, privacy focussed, 145kB aesthetic Google Tasks alternative todo list app to quickly jot down things to do. 
This app cannot connect to the internet, doesn't have internet permissions. Secure by design.
Inspired by the discord system-24 theme and the Windows Mobile design system with a mash up of retro terminalesque design inspired by Unix customizations found online.
Inspired by orgzly and colornote, it supports sync and QR sharing of notes between devices.
## Typical uses and what makes it special
- Daily quick notetaking, pomodoro, making shopping lists, bucket lists, calendar event marking, reminders and recurring notes.
- Tasks list with percentage remaining metrics, notemenu shows word count, useful when you are writing prose.
- Taking notes from status bar or other app, taking design ideas when on youtube, instagram, snapchat, whatsapp, tiktok without the need to switch to a notes app.
- Capture passing thoughts when on a jog.
- Journal events of your daily life on a separate tab or in the calendar, a daily log of activities.
- Playing quick mobile games (easter eggs).
- Use it like a password manager, save your passwords for quick access with copy paste at one place.
## Features
- Simple note taking and shopping list making with home screen widgets, status bar input, calendar, recurring reminders, offline sync, recycle bin, drag and drop sorting.
- To add a new note tab: use the `/TabName` format. Bringing some Linux Terminal vibes.
- Long-press any tab to rename, delete or add new tab (has a shadow that kinda brings back MS-DOS vibes).
- Support for dynamic custom themes and fonts, so pick and select any .ttf files you like from your files system.
- Add a % symbol on any tabname and it automatically counts percentage of tasks completed. Use %s term syntax to search and find a note.
- Encrypt tabs or disable screenshots for privacy when screensharing, toggle celebration mode with confetti.
- Homescreen widgets for notes, Karui also has a floating pomodoro timer.
- Easter egg games like Flappy Bird, Snake and Moon lander. Use the codes FLAPTHEBIRD, SLITHER, MOONMAN to test them out, share your highscores on our telegram, discord server and reddit, good place for more details on features or for casual notetaking discussions. Links in github readme. Github issues are the fastest way to reach out.

fdroid:org.billthefarmer.gridle.name: Gridle
fdroid:org.billthefarmer.gridle.description:
Guess those words
Move letters in the grid to make a gridle of words. It's a good idea to use a soft tipped stylus to see what you are doing, as it's difficult to see past stubby fingers.
Letters which are in the word but in the wrong place will turn yellow. If they are in the right place they will turn green. If they are not in the word they will turn grey. Keep trying until you have guessed all the words.
Tap the Refresh button in the toolbar to clear the display and generate another gridle of words. Words are chosen at random from a list, and are checked that they haven't been used recently.
Use my Crossword or WordleSolver app to cheat.

fdroid:si.uni_lj.fe.lablog.name: LabLog
fdroid:si.uni_lj.fe.lablog.summary: A digital lab notebook with MQTT
fdroid:si.uni_lj.fe.lablog.description:
LabLog is a digital laboratory notebook designed to replace traditional paper-based lab records. It allows you to record sensor readings, procedures, and observations in a structured and organized way. Each entry is automatically timestamped, ensuring accurate and tamper-proof records.
In addition to text and numeric values, LabLog enables the storage of images, which can be particularly useful for later analysis—something paper notebooks can’t provide. The app differentiates itself by associating each entry with specific data keys, making it easier to categorize, search, and filter entries based on the type of information stored.
LabLog is ideal for laboratories equipped with IoT sensors that automatically measure and send data to a server. The app can also send manual entries to the same server using the MQTT protocol, ensuring that human-recorded data is securely stored alongside automated sensor readings.
This approach improves both the transparency and reliability of laboratory data. For example, when using analog pH strips, a lab technician can manually input the pH reading into LabLog and send it to the server with other sensor data, ensuring a unified and secure record-keeping system.

apple-macos:6760339547.name: GeoGuess - World Map Quiz Game
apple-macos:6760339547.description:
A photo pops up on your screen. Could be a narrow street, a mountain range, a temple, or a highway sign in a language you don't recognize. Your job? Figure out where in the world it was taken.
That's GeoGuess. No complicated rules, no tutorials. Just you, a photo, and four country options. Pick one before the timer runs out. The faster you answer, the more points you get.
HOW IT WORKS
Each game is 5, 10, or 15 rounds - your choice. You'll get a mix of easy, medium, and hard photos. Easy ones might show something obvious - a famous landmark or a well-known skyline. Hard ones? A dirt road with a single sign in the distance. Good luck with those.
After each round, you'll see the correct answer, the exact location on a map, and a bit of info about the place. You'll learn stuff without even trying.
7 CATEGORIES
- World Landmarks: Iconic places everyone should recognize. Eiffel Tower, Colosseum, Machu Picchu, and dozens more. Great for warming up.
- Europe: Cobblestone streets in Portugal, canals in Amsterdam, villages in the Swiss Alps. From famous cities to places you've never heard of.
- Asia & Oceania: Temples in Cambodia, neon-lit streets in Tokyo, beaches in New Zealand. Huge variety, lots of surprises.
- Americas: Everything from the Grand Canyon to a random intersection in Buenos Aires. North and South, coast to coast.
- Africa & Middle East: Deserts, markets, wildlife reserves, ancient ruins. The category that catches most people off guard.
- Nature & Landscapes: No buildings, no signs - just raw nature. Waterfalls, volcanoes, glaciers, forests. Pure visual guessing.
- City Streets: Everyday urban scenes from around the globe. Taxis, storefronts, street food carts. Feels like actually being there.
WHY PEOPLE KEEP PLAYING
It's not just a geography quiz. It's a challenge that hits different every time. You start thinking you know the world pretty well, then a photo of some random road in Southeast Asia humbles you real quick. That's what makes it addictive.
Some play it to kill 5 minutes on the train. Others go for perfect scores in every category. A few use it to prep before trips or just to learn flags, capitals, and country locations without boring flashcards. Teachers have told us their students love it too.
If you're into trivia games, map quizzes, or anything where you test what you actually know about the world, this one's going to stick. It's one of those games that makes you smarter without feeling like homework. And once you start recognizing street signs in Cyrillic or telling apart Thai and Lao temples, you'll realize how much you've picked up just by playing.
No ads. No subscriptions. Optional one-time purchase to unlock all categories. Just a clean geography game that respects your time.
DESIGNED FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
GeoGuess is a native iOS app built specifically for your device. Photos load fast and look sharp, even on the smallest details - the ones that actually help you guess. Tap to answer, swipe through results, everything feels snappy.
Perfect for a quick round on the bus, in a waiting room, or before bed. One game takes just a few minutes, but good luck stopping at one. Works great on iPad too - the bigger screen makes photo clues easier to spot, and it's a fun way to play together with someone next to you.
SCORING & STATS
Every correct answer earns points. Faster answers earn bonus points. Each game gives you 0 to 3 stars based on your total score.
PRIVACY
No account required. No data collection. No social logins. Your stats are stored locally on your device and nowhere else.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The vacuum of space is inhabited by a low density of particles, which by their tendency to be electrically charged interact with each other, vibrate. Space songs which cannot be heard directly by our ears, but can be heard by the sensitive instruments of the probes sailing in and sometimes outside our stellar system.
 The sonification process of the collected data allows us to hear the stars, the planets, their magnetic field, the ionizing radiations, the sources and sinks of particles. Space is not silent.
 In this game, you will play a little space probe, floating, traveling, discovering sounds of space.

flathub:net.ptilouk.littlebrats.name: Little Brats!
flathub:net.ptilouk.littlebrats.description:
The school bell has just rung, and the children have worked well. And
 for just a few minutes, the playground belongs to them. One goal: to
 have as much fun as possible!
 Swings, merry-go-rounds, balloons, yo-yos, boost your fun 
 score any way you can. There’s just one problem: these little kids are
 real brats… and won’t hesitate to slap each other on the back and steal
 each other’s toys.
 But beware: the teacher is on the lookout, and she’s not easy-going.
 You don’t want to get caught being a little brat in front of her!
 Features 
 Immerse yourself in a colorful universe in the style of a 2D
 cartoon
 Customize your brat from head to toe
 Compete against your friends in a joyful mess to the sound of hard
 rock, in splitscreen, online or LAN mode
 Fall back into childhood by playing tag, British Bulldog or other
 game modes
 Play with toys and try not to get them stolen, or prefer equipment
 such as swings
 Collect the Sillymon cards scattered by your
 classmates
 Win titles by being the nicest, the meanest, the laziest, the most
 hyperactive… or the one who hides the most behind the teacher!
 Above all, collect as much fun as you can to win the
 game!

flathub:org.gnome.LightsOff.name: Lights Off
flathub:org.gnome.LightsOff.description:
Lights Off is a collection of light switch puzzles. Clicking on a light
 toggles it either on or off, but also toggles all the surrounding lights,
 too. Your objective is simple: turn off all the lights!
 Players who delight in turning off lights will enjoy the huge number of
 levels.

flathub:org.kde.kompare.name: Kompare
flathub:org.kde.kompare.description:
Kompare is a GUI front-end program that enables differences between source files to be viewed
 and merged. It can be used to compare differences on files or the contents of folders, and it supports
 a variety of diff formats and provide many options to customize the information level displayed.
 Features:
 Comparing differences on files or the contents of folders recursively.
 Supports a variety of diff formats and provides many options to customize the information
 level displayed.
 Creating and applying patches.

flathub:org.kde.ktorrent.name: KTorrent
flathub:org.kde.ktorrent.description:
KTorrent is a BitTorrent application by KDE which allows you to download files using the BitTorrent
 protocol. It enables you to run multiple torrents at the same time and comes with extended features
 to make it a full-featured client for BitTorrent.
 Features:
 Queuing of torrents
 Global and per torrent speed limits
 Previewing of certain file types, build in (video and audio)
 Importing of partially or fully downloaded files
 File prioritization for multi-file torrents
 Selective downloading for multi-file torrents
 Kick/ban peers with an additional IP Filter dialog for list/edit purposes
 UDP tracker support
 Support for private trackers and torrents
 Support for µTorrent's peer exchange
 Support for protocol encryption (compatible with Azureus)
 Support for creating trackerless torrents
 Support for distributed hash tables (DHT, the Mainline version)
 Support for UPnP to automatically forward ports on a LAN with dynamic assigned hosts
 Support for webseeds
 System tray integration
 Tracker authentication support
 Connection through a proxy
 In addition to the built-in functionalities, there are some plugins available for KTorrent.

flathub:org.temple.Bible.name: Holy Bible
flathub:org.temple.Bible.summary: An app designed for reading and listening to the Holy Bible
flathub:org.temple.Bible.description:
The Application is multi languages, free, offline, no advertising; the graphical interface is
 available in English and other languages.
 Designed for reading, studying, and meditation, it includes notes, books, and biblical promises
 to help in daily life.
 A list of features
 Verse lookup
 Bookmarks and commentaries (download commentaries from other public authors)
 Bible reader and dramatized Bible
 Highlight Verses
 Adjust text size, font and alignment
 Quiz
 Devotionals (on the home page)
 Future features for the app
 Verse sharing
 Notifications (Daily Bread) (when enabled)
 Reading plans with goals and rewards
 Maps with historical timeline updates (tracking national territories and characters);
 Character timeline

flathub:systems.fracture.launcher.name: Fracture
flathub:systems.fracture.launcher.summary: Fracture windows then resize, modify, and use shaders with the fractured selection.
flathub:systems.fracture.launcher.description:
Fracture windows then resize, modify, and use shaders with the fractured selection.
 This application creates fractured views of other applications and desktops. A fractured view
 is just a mirrored view of a region cut (or cropped) from the original application. After a
 fractured view is created, it provides the ability to modify it by resizing, scaling, adding
 transparency, removing colors ranges, adding colors, and by using shaders on it.
 This release is an early version, if there are issues with it they can be reported with this
 this forum (https://programming.dev/c/fracture) or by posting issues on the GitHub repository.
 Note: This application provides support to launch with the active window using a keyboard
 shortcut on Gnome. On other Desktop Environments, a portal is used instead of the active
 window. Launching on the active window in Gnome is not a requirement and can be avoided by
 closing the installer window. If the installer window is closed, it will fallback to using a
 portal.

fedora-packages:gap-pkg-aclib/gap-pkg-ac.description: The AClib package contains a library of almost crystallographic groups and some algorithms to compute with these groups. A group is called almost crystallographic if it is finitely generated nilpotent-by-finite and has no nontrivial finite normal subgroups. Further, an almost crystallographic group is called almost Bieberbach if it is torsion-free. The almost crystallographic groups of Hirsch length 3 and a part of the almost crystallographic groups of Hirsch length 4 have been classified by Dekimpe. This classification includes all almost Bieberbach groups of Hirsch lengths 3 or 4. The AClib package gives access to this classification; that is, the package contains this library of groups in a computationally useful form. The groups in this library are available in two different representations. First, each of the groups of Hirsch length 3 or 4 has a rational matrix representation of dimension 4 or 5, respectively, and such representations are available in this package. Secondly, all the groups in this library are (infinite) polycyclic groups and the package also incorporates polycyclic presentations for them. The polycyclic presentations can be used to compute with the given groups using the methods of the Polycyclic package.

fedora-packages:gfs-ignacio-fonts/gfs-ig.description: As it is known, the Greek alphabet was used in majuscule form for over a millennium before the minuscule letters gradually replaced it until they became the official script in the 9th century A.D. Thereafter, majuscule letters were confined to sparse use as initials or elaborate titles until the Italian Renaissance. The new art of Typography, as well as the need of the humanists to mimic the ancient Greco-Roman period brought back the extensive use of the majuscule letter-forms in both Latin and Greek typography. Greek books of the time were printed using the contemporary Byzantine hand with which they combined capital letters modeled on the Roman antiquity, i.e. with thick and thin strokes and serifs. At the same time the Byzantine majuscule tradition, principally used on theological editions, remained alive until the early 19th century. This font family has been designed by George D. firefox-addons:3088983.name: TimeUno: Agentic Time Tracking & Productivity
firefox-addons:3088983.summary: Agentic time tracking for your browser: an automatic time tracker and productivity tracker for you and your AI tools. Tracks time on websites and in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more, even in background tabs. Add the desktop app for every other app.
firefox-addons:3088983.description: Agentic time tracking: TimeUno tracks your time and your AI's time, automatically. You hand work to AI all day. ChatGPT writes while you read email, Claude thinks in a background tab, a video plays behind your work. TimeUno sees all of it without a timer to start or stop, and turns it into a clear record of your day. WHAT IT TRACKS • Every website you work on: how long you spent on each page, and what it was about, so your time sorts itself. • AI tools in the browser: claude.ai , ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, v0, Bolt, Lovable and Replit. It knows when the AI is working, when it's waiting for you, and when it's done, even in background tabs. • Background audio and video: YouTube, a podcast or music playing behind the tab you're on. • Add the TimeUno desktop app to track your editor, terminal and every other app too. The two work together, and nothing is counted twice. AUTOMATIC TIME TRACKING, SORTED FOR YOU • Every minute lands in the right category, marked productive or not. When TimeUno isn't sure, the popup asks once: was this work? • Time goes to your projects, so timesheets fill themselves. • The popup shows today at a glance: time tracked, your productivity score against your average, and recent activity. • Pause for 15 minutes, an hour, or until you resume. A PRODUCTIVITY TRACKER THAT'S CLEAR ABOUT YOUR DATA • It sends the site, the address (with tokens, codes and other sign-in secrets removed), the tab's title and the visible text of the page you're on, which is how it knows what you were doing. Never what you type into fields. • Page text is only read from the tab in front, never from background tabs. Turn it off any time in Settings. • Offline? It keeps what it recorded and uploads later. • Your data goes to your own TimeUno account, and page text is deleted once your time is sorted. Export or delete everything any time. HOW TO START 1. Install the extension and click its icon. 2. Click Continue in browser, sign in, and connect this browser. 3. Optional: install the TimeUno desktop app to track every app on your computer, not just the browser. TimeUno requires a TimeUno plan. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. Works in Chrome, Edge, Brave and other Chromium browsers, and Firefox 128 or newer. Privacy policy: https://timeuno.io/privacy Help: https://timeuno.io/docs/install/browser-extension/

firefox-addons:3060772.name: Video Speed Controller
firefox-addons:3060772.summary: Speed up, slow down, rewind and advance any HTML5 video or audio with keyboard shortcuts. Works on YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Coursera and any site with an HTML5 player. A Firefox build of Ilya Grigorik's Video Speed Controller.
firefox-addons:3060772.description:
Video Speed Controller gives you fine-grained control over any HTML5 video or audio element, on any site — YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Coursera, podcasts, even local files.
Most players hide or artificially limit playback speed. This adds a small draggable overlay on the player plus keyboard shortcuts, so changing speed becomes effortless enough to do constantly.
 Default shortcuts 
 S — decrease speed
 D — increase speed
 R — reset to 1x
 Z — rewind 10 seconds
 X — advance 10 seconds
 G — toggle between current and preferred speed
 V — show or hide the controller
 M — set a marker at the current position
 J — jump back to the marker
 Features 
 Speed from 0.07x to 16x, in configurable steps
 Per-site speed rules — always 2x on lecture sites, for example
 Per-site disable
 Remembers your last speed across tabs and sessions
 Speed fightback: re-applies your speed when a player tries to reset it
 Every shortcut remappable, including modifier combinations
 Custom CSS for the overlay
 Privacy 
This add-on collects nothing and transmits nothing. Your settings stay in Firefox's own storage.
 About this build 
Video Speed Controller was created by Ilya Grigorik , who develops and publishes it for Chrome. The original extension is on the Chrome Web Store , and its source lives at github.com/igrigorik/videospeed .
It is Chrome-only by design. A Firefox port was considered upstream and declined , for sound reasons: it is not a manifest-only change, and it carries an ongoing release, review and site-compatibility cost that would land on its author.
This listing is an unofficial Firefox build of that work, and exists to take that cost on rather than ask him to. It takes each upstream release unmodified , applies only the Firefox-specific adjustments needed to run on Gecko, verifies the result in a real Firefox, and publishes it here. Every line of extension code is Ilya Grigorik's, under the MIT licence. This build is not affiliated with or endorsed by him.
The build tooling and the exact adjustments are public at github.com/carsso/videospeed . Please report anything about speed behaviour upstream , and packaging or Firefox-specific problems here .

firefox-addons:3072887.name: RGAA Lab — Audit d'accessibilité
firefox-addons:3072887.summary: Auditez les 106 critères du RGAA dans la page même. Assistants guidés élément par élément, vérifications automatiques, captures des éléments fautifs conservées comme preuves. Sans traceur : rien ne quitte votre poste sans compte connecté.
firefox-addons:3072887.description:
RGAA Lab pose le référentiel d'accessibilité français là où se trouve la page :
dans un panneau latéral, à côté de l'onglet que vous auditez.
Les outils automatiques couvrent environ un tiers du RGAA. Le reste demande un
œil humain — et un instrument qui pose les bonnes questions, élément par
élément, sans jamais conclure à votre place.
CE QUE FAIT L'EXTENSION
 Les 13 thématiques du référentiel, dans l'ordre, critère par critère.
 Des assistants guidés pour les images, les liens, les tableaux, les boutons,
 les cadres, les couleurs et les médias : une question par élément, pas une
 case à cocher pour tout un thème.
 Les vérifications qu'une machine sait trancher — contraste, doctype, langue,
 identifiants dupliqués — lancées seules à l'ouverture de la page.
 L'ordre de tabulation affiché sur la page, numéro par numéro.
CHAQUE ÉCART PORTE SA PREUVE
Une non-conformité déclarée sans capture est une affirmation. L'extension
photographie l'élément fautif au moment où vous le jugez et rattache l'image à
son sélecteur. Celui qui corrige voit exactement ce que vous avez vu, sans
avoir à retrouver la page ni deviner l'élément.
UN TAUX QUI NE MENT PAS
Le calcul suit la grille officielle DINUM : un critère non conforme quelque
part rend le critère non conforme partout, les non applicables sortent du
dénominateur, et aucun taux n'est affiché tant qu'un seul critère reste non
testé. Publier « 100 % » sur un audit à peine commencé serait exact au calcul
et faux au sens.
TOUT SE PILOTE AU CLAVIER
Un outil d'accessibilité qui exige la souris se disqualifie de lui-même.
FONCTIONNE SEULE
L'extension n'émet aucune requête réseau tant que vous ne connectez pas de
compte. Vos audits restent sur votre machine.
Sans compte, vous auditez une page par site : les 106 critères, les assistants,
les preuves, le rapport textuel. Avec un compte, gratuit, vous auditez autant de
pages que vous voulez, et vous pouvez en plus produire le rapport, la
déclaration d'accessibilité et la comparaison d'une campagne à la suivante, puis
retrouver vos audits d'un poste à l'autre.
AUCUN TRACEUR
Pas de statistiques, pas de rapport d'erreurs distant, aucun appel vers un
serveur autre que celui de votre compte. Le moteur d'audit travaille sur votre
machine. Rien ne quitte votre poste sans compte connecté et sans une action de
votre part.
Version du référentiel prise en charge : RGAA 4.1.2, ses 106 critères et ses
13 thématiques. Le RGAA — référentiel général d'amélioration de l'accessibilité
— s'applique aux services publics français et aux entreprises soumises à
l'article 47 de la loi de 2005.
RGAA Lab est un outil indépendant, sans lien avec la DINUM ni avec aucune
administration. « RGAA » désigne le référentiel public audité.

firefox-addons:3045489.name: Sync Tab Groups
firefox-addons:3045489.summary: Synchronizes tab groups and their content across devices
firefox-addons:3045489.description:
Sync Tab Groups keeps your Firefox tab groups, and the tabs inside them, in sync across every desktop device signed in to your Mozilla account.
It relies on Firefox's built-in Sync storage: no server of ours is involved, and no data goes through any third party. The extension collects no data.
Features:
- Share a local tab group: its title, color, collapsed state and tabs (URL, title, order) become available on your other devices
- Live two-way sync: while a synced group is open on several devices, adding, removing or reordering tabs, renaming the group or changing its color on one device is applied on the others
- Custom tab titles: right-click a tab, then "Rename tab" (or "Reset title"). The custom title follows the tab in synced groups
- Open a synced group on a device where it is not open yet, and close it there without losing it
- Delete a synced group everywhere with one click
- Same-name conflict handling: when a local group already has the name of the synced group you open, choose to rename the local one, keep local tabs, keep cloud tabs, or merge both
- "Sync now" button to re-apply on this device the data Firefox Sync already received
Requirements:
- Firefox 140 or later (desktop only, Firefox for Android does not sync extension storage)
- A Mozilla account with Sync enabled and "Add-ons" ticked in Sync settings (about:preferences#sync)
Good to know:
- Propagation speed depends on Firefox Sync, which can take up to about ten minutes. Use Firefox's own "Sync Now" to speed it up
- Conflicts are resolved as last write wins
- Firefox limits synced storage to 8 KB per item: a group with a very large number of tabs may stop syncing. Splitting it in two works around it
- Only tabs inside tab groups are synced
Permissions: access to all websites is only used to display custom tab titles on the pages you renamed. Page content is never read or sent anywhere.

bluejetty:00049153:ios.description:
SingSnap is not your ordinary singing app. Yes, it's true that we have tens of thousands of songs, professional grade audio technology and a plethora of contests and challenges (with real prizes!) to keep you busy, but that's not what makes SingSnap special! It's the community! Join SingSnap and you will make long lasting friendships that you can cherish for the rest of your life. Don't believe us? Just try it - it's free! Be warned though, it just may take over your life.
SingSnap is the world's largest online singing community. Pick your favorite song, record it, post it, and just wait for the comments to roll in. It's that easy. We can say with confidence that we have the friendliest online community on the internet. Everyone is welcome at SingSnap.
SING & SHARE
SingSnap, the world’s largest service for streaming karaoke is now available in the palm of your hand!
Sing a song, record it and play it back whenever you like. Easily find and listen to others and give and receive comments. Share your recordings with the world or keep them private. With the largest library of karaoke songs available, you’ll never run out of material!
COMMUNITY
Thousands upon thousands of karaoke singers have already discovered the daily joy and excitement of the online version. Now that community is waiting for you to join! Having a large karaoke community of willing, excited and supportive members enhances the recording experience. Communicate with friends old and new by leaving comments, direct messaging, participating in our forums or joining a community contest or challenge! It’s the perfect place to meet and interact with people from all over the world who love to sing!
FEATURES
- State-of-the-art recording technology
- Video or Audio-only recording
- Audio enhancements for a professional sound
- Easily share recordings on Facebook, Twitter, Google+ or email
- Privacy settings that let you share your recordings with the world or keep them to yourself.
- Create duets with other singers or groups with full video capability if you choose
UNLIMITED ACCESS WITH IN-APP PURCHASE OF "ONE MONTH GOLD" or "ONE YEAR GOLD"
- There are over 1000 songs to sing for free, and you can expand your repertoire and enjoy access to our entire library with an In-App Purchase of "One Month Gold".
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
- Price is equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD
Subscriptions may be managed by the user & auto-renewal may be turned off in the user's Account Settings after purchase. You can disable automatic renewal via iTunes account settings at any time.
Privacy Policy: https://www.singsnap.com/#/d/privacy
T&C: https://www.singsnap.com/#/d/termsandconditions

- This is an unofficial fan guide app, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official game creators.

- All content in this app is intended for entertainment and educational reference only, with no intent to infringe on any copyrights.

It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.

Daily, deliberate practice is the key to maintaining and improving your clinical skills. Download and play a free case today!
Interested in bringing Full Code to your organization or institution? Learn more at fullcodemedical.com!
Features:
• 300+ case library written and peer-reviewed by expert clinicians
• Over 30 diagnostic disciplines, including Emergency Medicine, OBGYN, and Pediatrics
• 25+ realistic avatars, including pediatric and adult patients
• EMS cases and ambulance environment
• Detailed scoring and full case breakdowns - learn your strengths and weaknesses
• Patient AI enables practice with history taking
• Full Code Pro + CME provides 100+ hours of accredited CME
• Frequent new cases and regular updates
TRAIN ON YOUR TERMS
Full Code’s on-demand simulation training with realistic virtual patients allows you to practice complex cases and enhance your skills whenever you get a break, wherever you happen to be, on the devices you already own.

PRACTICE MAKES THE PRACTITIONER
Frequent, deliberate practice is the key to clinical success and improving your clinical decision-making ability. Full Code can easily fit into any schedule—whether you're a med student or practicing clinician.
NEW CHALLENGES 
Every case presents a new challenge in Full Code: from routine diagnosis to rare diseases. You’re not just limited to the hospital, either—Full Code has expanded into pre-hospital and EMS content. Get out of the ED and into the ambulance for all new scenarios!
LEARN FROM TOP MEDICAL EXPERTS
Created by medical educators from some of the top hospitals in the U.S. and peer-reviewed by licensed medical professionals, our simulations are designed with industry-standard medical best practices, setting the bar high for medical students and professionals worldwide. 
EARN CME CREDIT
Complete your continuing medical education (CME) requirements with flexible and engaging simulation challenges accredited through the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME). bluejetty:00071169:ios.description:
Yasin-i Şerif — Kur’an’ın Kalbi, Cebinizde
Kur’an-ı Kerim’in kalbi olarak bilinen Yasin Suresi’ni Arapça metni, Latin harfli okunuşu ve Türkçe meali ile birlikte okuyun; profesyonel bir hâfızdan ayet ayet sesli dinleyin ve takip edin. Sade, modern ve ferah tasarımıyla her an yanınızda.
Öne Çıkan Özellikler
Yasin Suresi
Her ayet için Arapça metin, Latin harfli okunuş ve Türkçe meal bir arada. İstediğiniz ayete dokunup tek tek dinleyebilirsiniz.
Sesli Dinleme & Tam Ekran Mod
Yasin’i baştan sona sesli dinleyin. Tam ekran oynatıcıda büyük yazılarla takip edin, oynatma hızını (1x / 1.5x / 2x) ayarlayın, ileri-geri geçin. Ekranı yatay çevirerek rahatça okuyun.
Arka planda çalma & kilit ekranı kontrolü
Uygulama arka plandayken bile dinlemeye devam edin; kilit ekranından ve kulaklıktan kontrol edin.
Dualar ve Faziletler
Yasin’den önce ve sonra okunacak dualar ile Yasin Suresi’nin faziletleri hakkında derli toplu bilgiler.
Tebareke (Mülk) ve Amme (Nebe) Sureleri
Mülk ve Nebe surelerinin sayfa sayfa okunuşları ve Türkçe mealleri.
Kişiselleştirme
Açık/Koyu tema desteği ve ayarlanabilir yazı boyutu ile gözünüzü yormadan okuyun.
Kolay paylaşım
Beğendiğiniz ayeti veya meali tek dokunuşla paylaşın.
İnternetsiz kullanım
Ses dosyaları uygulamayla birlikte gelir; çevrimdışı dinleyebilirsiniz.
Reklamsız seçenek
Dilerseniz tek seferlik satın alma ile tüm reklamları kaldırın.
Yasin Suresi’ni ezberlemek, doğru telaffuzla okumak, anlamını öğrenmek veya sevdikleri için okuyup dinlemek isteyen herkes için.
Allah kabul etsin. Hayırlı okumalar ve dinlemeler dileriz.

bluejetty:00037846:ios.description:
The Three Worlds are on the brink of eternal darkness, and you are the last hope.
Dive into a thrilling strategy card game inspired by millennia old Indian lore. Join epic battles and explore a captivating universe as legendary heroes reborn in the Age of Darkness, Kalyug.
EXPERIENCE A WORLD INSPIRED BY INDIAN EPICS
Take on the role of Demigods. Command mighty melee and ranged units, unleash a variety of spells, and wield weapons inspired by ancient tales. Every card is meticulously crafted to reflect the rich lore tied to it.
Explore a growing selection of heroes and cards. Get the starter deck for FREE! Keep playing to unlock unlimited possibilities to update your decks and devise innovative strategies in this card game.
NARRATIVE-RICH SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN
Dive into our PVE story campaign, exploring a universe filled with unique factions, creatures, and forces that transcend time. Relive epic events, strategically using your cards to outwit Demons, Warriors, and Cosmic Beasts. Explore realms, make impactful choices, and face epic bosses in your quest for Dharma.
RELIVE LEGENDARY BATTLES IN PvP 
India’s land has witnessed battles between the greatest warriors to have walked the face of the earth. Arjuna’s battle with his unknown older brother Karna changed the course of the Kurukshetra war, while Bheem’s melee battle with Duryodhana ended the war and established the triumph of good over evil. These battles shaped the history of the land and even rewrote the tenets of Dharma. Recreate those epic moments on Kurukshetra: Ascension. 
INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY
Explore unique game features, mastering both Melee and Ranged Rows. Seize Free Kill opportunities to enhance your battlefield presence. Kurukshetra: Ascension's PvP draws inspiration from ancient wars, where nightfall introduces unique dynamics for strategic turn-based combat.

listings.description:
The Three Worlds are on the brink of eternal darkness, and you are the last hope.

Dive into a thrilling strategy card game inspired by millennia old Indian lore. Join epic battles and explore a captivating universe as legendary heroes reborn in the Age of Darkness, Kalyug.


EXPERIENCE A WORLD INSPIRED BY INDIAN EPICS
Take on the role of Demigods. Command mighty melee and ranged units, unleash a variety of spells, and wield weapons inspired by ancient tales. Every card is meticulously crafted to reflect the rich lore tied to it.


Explore a growing selection of heroes and cards. Get the starter deck for FREE! Keep playing to unlock unlimited possibilities to update your decks and devise innovative strategies in this card game.


NARRATIVE-RICH SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN
Dive into our PVE story campaign, exploring a universe filled with unique factions, creatures, and forces that transcend time. Relive epic events, strategically using your cards to outwit Demons, Warriors, and Cosmic Beasts. Explore realms, make impactful choices, and face epic bosses in your quest for Dharma.


RELIVE LEGENDARY BATTLES IN PvP 
India’s land has witnessed battles between the greatest warriors to have walked the face of the earth. Arjuna’s battle with his unknown older brother Karna changed the course of the Kurukshetra war, while Bheem’s melee battle with Duryodhana ended the war and established the triumph of good over evil. These battles shaped the history of the land and even rewrote the tenets of Dharma. Recreate those epic moments on Kurukshetra: Ascension. 


INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY
Explore unique game features, mastering both Melee and Ranged Rows. Seize Free Kill opportunities to enhance your battlefield presence. Kurukshetra: Ascension's PvP draws inspiration from ancient wars, where nightfall introduces unique dynamics for strategic turn-based combat. 


Discover an epic world with Kurukshetra: Ascension and become the ultimate ancient Yoddha!

White Noise Sleep Sound Machine will lull you or your baby to sleep with calming and relaxing sounds.

- 50+ perfectly looped sounds: rain sounds, bedtime fan noise, airplane cabin...
- Mix multiple deep sleep sounds.
- Awesome sleeping wallpapers.
- Play on launch to immediately start playing your favorite sound.

- Background audio support so you can use other apps while listening.
***It helps ADULTS sleep by:***
- Blocking out unwanted noises
- Forming a sleep association that cues you to fall asleep
- Helping you feel calm, relaxed, and soothed.
***It helps BABIES sleep by:***
- Providing “whooshy” noises that simulate the environment of the womb
- Forming a sleep association that cues your baby to fall asleep
- Engaging your baby’s calming reflex allows baby to sleep longer
- Blocking outside noises that may wake your baby
***It helps you STUDY and FOCUS by:***
- Improving focus and creativity by preventing outside distractions while forming a cocoon of concentration.
- Creating a pleasant and zen-like environment for meditation.

bluejetty:00098387:ios.description:
WINNER OF IPAD GAME OF THE YEAR 2023 & INNOVATION (APPLE DESIGN AWARD) 2024!
Help a brother and sister on an uplifting epic adventure to find their way home. Solving puzzles, escaping a horned beast and meeting quirky goblins are just part of the journey!
Lost in Play is a journey through childhood imagination with thoughtfully crafted puzzles and colorful characters. Play as a brother and sister duo on an adventure to find their way back home. Between reality and fantasy, the siblings explore the enchanted forest of a horned beast, start a rebellion in a goblin village, and help a team of frogs free a sword from a stone.
PUZZLES & MYSTERY
The bizarre and dreamlike world of Lost in Play is filled with mystery, unique puzzles, and mini-games. Challenge a pirate seagull to a game of clicking crabs, serve magical tea to a royal toad, and collect pieces to build a flying machine. Be a part of this modern point & click game that will reward your curiosity and leave you excited for the next piece of story.
IMAGINATION COMES TO LIFE
From what seems like a normal morning at home to a typical afternoon at the park, you'll soon find yourself on a whirlwind quest as you sneak into a goblin castle, explore ancient ruins, and soar atop a giant stork. Lost in Play takes you on a nostalgic roller-coaster!
AN INTERACTIVE CARTOON
With a hand-crafted style similar to animated shows from childhood, Lost in Play is a story meant for all. Whether you’re seeking wholesome delight or just a good time, the family can enjoy this story together.
GAME FEATURES
* A mysterious animated puzzle adventure.
* Filled with magical and magnificent creatures.
* Created with families in mind. Have your children watch you play!
* No dialogue. Everything is communicated visually in a universal way.
* Inspired by nostalgic TV shows.
* Play cards with goblins, build a dragon, and teach a sheep how to fly.
* Includes 30+ unique puzzles and mini-games.

Help a brother and sister on an uplifting epic adventure to find their way home. Solving puzzles, escaping a horned beast and meeting quirky goblins are just part of the journey!

Lost in Play is a journey through childhood imagination with thoughtfully crafted puzzles and colorful characters. Play as a brother and sister duo on an adventure to find their way back home. Between reality and fantasy, the siblings explore the enchanted forest of a horned beast, start a rebellion in a goblin village, and help a team of frogs free a sword from a stone.

PUZZLES & MYSTERY

The bizarre and dreamlike world of Lost in Play is filled with mystery, unique puzzles, and mini-games. Challenge a pirate seagull to a game of clicking crabs, serve magical tea to a royal toad, and collect pieces to build a flying machine. Be a part of this modern point & click game that will reward your curiosity and leave you excited for the next piece of story.

IMAGINATION COMES TO LIFE

From what seems like a normal morning at home to a typical afternoon at the park, you'll soon find yourself on a whirlwind quest as you sneak into a goblin castle, explore ancient ruins, and soar atop a giant stork. Lost in Play takes you on a nostalgic roller-coaster!

AN INTERACTIVE CARTOON

With a hand-crafted style similar to animated shows from childhood, Lost in Play is a story meant for all. Whether you’re seeking wholesome delight or just a good time, the family can enjoy this story together.

* Includes 30+ unique puzzles and mini-games.

bluejetty:00150960:ios.description:
ClubGrub is the leading food and drink ordering app for golf courses, private clubs, and resort communities. Members and guests at participating clubs can order on-demand wherever they are — on the course, at the halfway house, poolside, on the driving range, ToGo for pickup, or delivered to their door in participating communities. Ask your club about ClubGrub!
Order food, drinks, clubhouse cocktails, or pro shop items and have them delivered to your exact location — your cart, your lounge chair, your hitting bay, or your front door. Open your club's menu and order in seconds.
◉ ORDER ACROSS THE PROPERTY On-course delivery to all 18 holes with GPS location sharing. Order at the turn, poolside, or at the driving range and have it brought to you.
◉ TOGO & PICKUP Skip the line — place a ToGo order and pick it up when it's ready.
◉ HOME DELIVERY IN YOUR COMMUNITY Members in participating communities can have their club's food and drinks delivered to their door.
◉ PRO SHOP GEAR Forgot a glove or got caught in the weather? Order gloves, umbrellas, sunscreen, and more.
◉ TRACK YOUR ORDER Follow your order from pickup to delivery and message along the way.
◉ FEATURES
 • order food and drinks across the course, pool, range, halfway house, and clubhouse
 • preview kitchen and bar menus with photos and descriptions
 • adjust quantities and customize your order
 • share your location for delivery
 • ToGo ordering for fast pickup
 • home delivery in participating communities
 • pay in-app via credit/debit card or pay later
 • real-time order tracking
 • order pro shop gear
ClubGrub requires an account tied to a participating club to place orders. Ask your club to get started.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

listings.description:
■ Accurate Run Tracker - track your route and heart rate!
■ Improve your mind and body
■ Zen Labs Fitness has been featured on The New York Times, Los Angeles Times, The Washington Post, The Guardian, The Huffington Post, Men's Fitness, Forbes, Mashable, Glamour Magazine, Popsugar Fitness, CBS News, NBC News, Macworld, Cosmopolitan, The Verge, Lifehacker, WebMD and many more!


Goodbye to the days of stress and anxiety! With the same elements that made C25K successful for millions of first time runners (now with thoughtfully created guided meditation!), RunMate will help with both your physical and mental health!


Our devices have turned into dopamine slot machines causing the mental health epidemic. We’ll help you get back on track to healthier habits. Finding the perfect balance in your schedule.


RunMate has all the Training Plans and Guided Runs that you need to reach all your running goals. Running has never been more enjoyable and enlightening! 


Train for your next 5k, 10k or even marathon race, all the while benefiting from the guided meditation included in the training programs. 


We’ll help track your route, and provide all the tools necessary to smash all your milestones. 


Get instant STRESS RELIEF by combining the benefits of running (yay endorphins!) with guided meditation (yay serotonin!) from our experts!




≈ Track Stats ≈
Accurate GPS tracking helps you see your run route, as well as important details such as distance and calories burned. Log your stats in to the Health app! What gets measured, gets done!


≈ Mindful Running Programs ≈
Train for your next 5K race with our award winning C25K program! 
Or push yourself further with either our 10K, half marathon and marathon trainers! We’ll help get you ready! We’ve combined our award winning training programs with a little mindful meditation!


≈ Guided Runs from Experts ≈
Follow along with our audio guides to get motivated and inspired! You will leave feeling calm, focused, grateful and happy!


The guided meditation has been carefully created to work in-sync while running. Don’t worry, we won’t ask you to close your eyes while on the move.


≈ Rewards ≈
Unlock cool regards to stay motivated. Stack those wins and stats!


≈ Zen Unlimited Pass ≈
◉ Award winning music curated from top DJ's!
◉ Scientifically proven to increase motivation by 35%
◉ BONUS unlimited access to all pro features across ALL Zen Labs Fitness running apps


Questions/comments? Please email us at contactus@zenlabsfitness.com, or visit us at www.zenlabsfitness.com.


≈ Connect ≈

Hashtag: #C25K

bluejetty:00137258:ios.description:
An app designed to bring the serene ambiance of candlelight to the digital realm, this virtual candle app offers users an immersive and realistic experience of lighting and interacting with a variety of virtual candles. The app features a wide range of candle types, from classic taper candles to container candles, each with unique textures, colors, and flame movements. Users can select their preferred candle, and enjoy the flickering flame and soft glow that mimics real candlelight.
The perfect setting for relaxation, meditation, or as a gentle nightlight.
Designed for both relaxation and aesthetic pleasure, this virtual candle app is perfect for those who love the beauty and tranquility of candles but may not be able to have real ones due to safety concerns, allergies, or space constraints. It’s an innovative way to bring the calming effect of candles into any space, anytime, without the fire risk.

bluejetty:00144885:ios.description:
Is Sherlock Holmes a villain? Help Charlotte Holmes discover the secrets of the past and restore Sherlock Holmes' reputation.
Solve puzzles and riddles in this mysterious game! Find the hidden objects!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to unravel the mystery of Ms. Holmes: The Milverton Plot? Immerse yourself in the detective hidden object game, solve puzzles, explore unusual locations and find out what surprise the abandoned mansion has prepared for Charlotte Holmes?
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game. 
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
Charlotte Holmes cannot stay away when her famous ancestor is accused of crimes. The evidence seems irrefutable. Incredibly irrefutable. But what if Mr. Holmes's misdeeds are the only possible interpretation of events, even if at first it seems so incredible? Charlotte will have to find out - and even a threat to her life cannot interfere with her intentions.
FIND THE SOURCE OF COMPROMISING MATERIAL ON MR. HOLMES.
Who wrote to the newspaper about the crimes of Sherlock Holmes? What are they trying to achieve? And how is the deceased Charles Augustus Milverton connected with him?
WHY DOES THE INFORMANT HIDE THEIR IDENTITY SO CAREFULLY?
Solve engaging puzzles and complete fun mini-games to find out why someone hates Sherlock Holmes so much that they are willing to do anything to ruin his reputation.
FIND OUT HOW FAR THE VILLAIN CAN GO TO HURT THE HOLMES FAMILY.
Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO CHARLOTTE HOLMES IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Help Charlotte Holmes find Mr. Amberley's missing wife and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! 
Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find! Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!

bluejetty:00200163:ios.description:
Inward is a private, offline way of reconnecting with the thousands of photos and videos already on your phone. Inward lets you reminisce without an account, uploads, or any manual organization. Easily share with others via Messages or other apps to spark new conversations about past memories. 
Choose from different ways to browse.
The All Media view drops you into a shuffled, ever-changing feed drawn from across your library. The Latest view gives you a clean chronological view from newest to oldest. The Shared view gives you a chronological grid of all the photos and videos in your iCloud Shared Albums. Ages lets you revisit photos from specific periods of your life.
Save Photos for later and clean up your camera roll.
Like photos in your feed to see them later from the Favorites view. Liking a photo on Inward also adds it to the Favorites album. Delete photos while you scroll to clean up your camera roll.
Your library stays on your device.
Inward works entirely with your local photo library. No accounts, no uploads, no data collection. Completely private. Inward also includes the option to filter out sensitive media using the iOS sensitive content filter, so you don't have to worry about risky photos showing up. 
Requires iOS 17 or later.

bluejetty:00177068:ios.description:

Have you ever wanted to know what a sign, menu, or book written in unfamiliar language? Now it’s easier than ever with Pho2. Just take a photo, and we’ll do the rest. With powerful yet simple technology, you simply snap a picture of what you want translated, and the app instantly provides an accurate translation. The app can even recognize text within a range of backgrounds ― whether it’s on paper, a whiteboard, a packaging of products or even in television subtitles. This means no more typing words of unknown languages ― all you need is your phone! It will make your life easier when you learn a new language, work with foreign clients or travel to foreign countries. 
The powerful object recognition feature included with the app helps you find out what objects are in an image. Just take a picture and the app will tell you all about what it is in seconds. Whether you’re looking for specific items or trying to get organized, the app has you covered. This feature is particularly helpful if you're trying to identify something unknown that you spot around your home or work. 
On top of all these amazing features, we've also included several additional features with the app such as the ability to save translations for later reference and much more!

Signal Supervisor can be used for:

-Monitoring your signal booster via Bluetooth, WiFi or mobile network. 
-Monitoring remote alarm via WiFi or mobile network. 
-Managing groups of boosters. 
-Updating the software in your signal booster. 
-Configuring parameters in your signal booster

Crouch in the misty Yellowstone underbrush, finger on the trigger—this is your chance to become the apex Sniper Hunter.
A 12+ FREE hunting simulator that fuses hyper-realistic deer tracking with heart-pounding sniper PvP: master tactical shots, outsmart wild herds, and dominate global hunters—no pay-to-win, just pure hunting thrill.
◆ Hunt Across Living, Breathing Wilderness
Traverse 7+ iconic real-world hunting grounds where the environment fights back:
- Crouch through autumn Yellowstone foliage to stalk trophy bucks (watch for their ear twitches—they’ll flee at the slightest sound)
- Track white-tailed deer along Nile riverbanks at mating season—dodge crocodile-infested shallows while lining up your shot
- Brave Arctic tundra blizzards to target reindeer herds (adjust your scope for frost-induced lens blur)Every zone isn’t just a map—it’s a dynamic ecosystem: rain muddies tracks, wind carries your scent, and predators like coyotes will steal your trophy mid-hunt.
◆ Dominate Tactical Sniper Hunting (and PvP)
This isn’t just “point and shoot”—it’s a battle of skill:
- Master intuitive controls to: calculate wind drift for 300-yard shots, read deer warning signals, and 预判 herd movement
- Hyper-realistic graphics render fur textures, seasonal coat changes, and even the tremble of a spooked buck
- Clash in real-time 1v1 hunting duels: compete to take down the biggest trophy faster (climb the global leaderboard to claim the “Apex Hunter” title)
- Survive seasonal tournaments: outshoot rivals during autumn rut hunts, or hold your ground against bears while protecting your kill
◆ Build a Deer-Hunting Arsenal (Tailored to the Hunt)
Collect Weapon Tokens to unlock loadouts made for every scenario:
- Fit a suppressor to your rifle for silent ambushes in dense forests (no more spooking the herd)
- Swap to a lightweight build to sprint after fleeing deer across desert dunes
- The ballistic system rewards precision: use deer-specific ammo to take down a distant buck through foliage, or rapid-fire rounds to scatter a wary herd
◆ Endless Free Challenges (No Pay-to-Win)
Dive into rotating seasonal content that keeps the hunt fresh:
- Win limited-edition camo patterns in autumn rut challenges
- Unlock rare antler trophies by surviving winter snowstorm hunts
- All cosmetics (and core gear) are earnable—no paywall between you and the top of the leaderboard
Whether you’re a veteran hunter chasing realistic tracking mechanics, or a newbie aiming to bag your first trophy buck—this is the ultimate sniper hunting experience.
Download now to grip your rifle, hold your breath, and claim your place as the apex Sniper Hunter.

bluejetty:00150394:ios.name: PursueCare
bluejetty:00150394:ios.summary:
PursueCare provides virtual, judgment-free addiction recovery services for individuals struggling with alcohol, opioids, stimulants, and other addictive substances. We also provide support for co-occurring mental health conditions.
Same-da
bluejetty:00150394:ios.description:
PursueCare provides virtual, judgment-free addiction recovery services for individuals struggling with alcohol, opioids, stimulants, and other addictive substances. We also provide support for co-occurring mental health conditions.
Same-day admissions are available so you can connect with care and start treatment right away. You’ll receive immediate access to a team of addiction and mental health specialists including physicians, psychiatric providers, counselors, pharmacists, and case managers. Our in-house pharmacy, PursueCareRx, can fill your prescriptions and deliver them directly to you. 
We accept many private insurances as well as Medicare and Medicaid.
What’s Inside the App
- A personalized treatment plan tailored to your recovery for alcohol and/or other substances.
- Private video appointments with licensed medical and counseling staff that fit your schedule.
- Access to FDA-authorized digital therapeutics for 24/7 recovery support.
- Low-cost medications shipped directly to you.
- Ability to access details of your treatment plan and chat with your care team.
How to Get Started
1. Download the app and create an account. Fill out your profile by answering some basic questions.
2. A Patient Access Specialist will contact you to complete your profile, discuss insurance and/or payment options, and set up your first appointment.
3. Meet with your clinical team. They will assess your needs, create a personalized treatment plan, and write any necessary prescriptions.
4. Meet with your Case Manager who can help keep you on track and connect you with helpful tools and resources to support your recovery.
5. Start your journey to better health and a better life.
What to Expect
Treatment happens on your time, when and where it is convenient for you. You will have access to on-demand check-ins with your Case Manager, at-home drug screening, self-assessments, and regular therapy and MAT appointments. During these appointments, we encourage you to bring up any questions or concerns you might have.
PursueCare does not let any third parties track user data, and we do not disclose protected health information for any reason other than to facilitate care. We do not collect and sell any data to third parties for advertising or other similar purposes. We do not record patient visits or store data from patient video visits on their device.
PursueCare has earned The Joint Commission’s Gold Seal of Approval® for Accreditation by demonstrating continuous compliance with its performance standards.

bluejetty:00178910:ios.summary:

Log a mood and tag your activities, mood triggers, and even the weather. Add a note and/or a photo if you're so inclined. Moody makes jou
bluejetty:00178910:ios.description:
Moody lets you track your moods and keep a private journal with just a few taps. No typing required! 
Log a mood and tag your activities, mood triggers, and even the weather. Add a note and/or a photo if you're so inclined. Moody makes journaling effortless.
Moody's simple journal feed contains a FILTER that will allow you to see only entries that contain a certain activity/trigger, mood, rating, or weather. 
Moody's powerful summary page will give you a tally of moods, activities/triggers, ratings, and more over a span of time (1 day, 7 days, 30 days, 365 days). 
Moody is a simple, fully customizable tool to help you learn more about yourself, your actions, and your behaviors. 
Moody Features:
• Log a mood in seconds. Optionally log a note, photo, activities, and the weather as well.
• 1000+ icons to choose from to make your own mood, activity, and weather icons.
• Totally customizable. Create an icon for any mood, activity, and weather that you choose.
• A journal FILTER can show only entries with a certain mood, rating, weather, or activity.
• A powerful STATS page will show you a tally of your moods, activities, weather, and a graph of your moods over time.
• Set reminders and never forget to log an entry.
• Dark/Light background mode.
Moody is FREE to try for 15 entries. For unlimited entries, upgrade to PREMIUM.
Moody PREMIUM Features:
• Unlimited entries.
• Set a private passcode to keep your entries private.
• Export your data as a CSV file that you can open in any spreadsheet program.
• Backup your data to iCloud or Dropbox.
MOODY contains subscriptions for the Growth Bundle, which is an optional monthly or annual subscription. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, for the chosen plan's price. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes/App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Read more about our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy here:
• Terms of Service: https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use
• Privacy Policy: https://kodeon.ai/privacy-policy

GOAL Live Scores is the ultimate soccer hub for all your match-day scores and betting needs. With real-time scores, up-to-the-minute stats, and exclusive access to the latest odds and offers, our app provides a one-stop-shop for all of the needs of a soccer fan on a match-day. Even better — personalised updates and notifications put you in control of your favourites. GOAL Live Scores immerses you in the world of soccer, enhancing the experience for fans across the globe.

- Live Match Feed: Real-time updates from the top leagues in the world
- Tables and Standings: Immediate access to all the latest tables and standings.
- Betting Content Hub: Match previews, tips and odds for all the biggest games across the soccer calendar

- Instant Alerts: Custom notifications for match kick-offs, goals, lineups, breaking news, and more.
- Head-to-Head Data: Dynamic comparisons help you measure your team against rivals.
- Player pages: All new current and historical data for all the biggest names.
- Exclusive Content: Access GOAL's latest articles, breaking news, in-depth analysis, and opinion on the biggest leagues in soccer.
Download the GOAL Live Scores App now and never miss a moment, no matter where you are in the world!
Responsible Gambling
GOAL is committed to responsible gambling. Underage gambling is an offence. Please gamble responsibly and only bet what you can afford. For help, advice and support for a person struggling with gambling, please contact the National Gambling Helpline on 0808 8020 133 or via the NetLine. This service provides advice for persons who struggle with gambling in multiple languages. If you’re worried about your gambling or a friend’s please visit begambleaware.org

bluejetty:00128282:ios.description:
Note: This free version is supported by ads. To remove advertisements, either use the in-app purchase or buy Rhythm Pad Pro from the App Store. 
Play drums and compose beats using high-quality, professionally sampled drum kits with Rhythm Pad. Create drum recordings by tapping on the pads or using the sequencer and export them as audio files. Play drums along with the songs from your Media Library and Apple Music. Rhythm Pad is the smartest way to play drums on your mobile device.
Introducing the Sequencer
Quickly put together drum patterns of up to 8 bars using the sequencer. You can also record your live performance directly on to the sequencer and edit your sequence to your liking. Save your sequences and export them as audio files.
Top features of Rhythm Pad
• High-quality stereo sampled sounds with maximum polyphony.
• Realistic Open and Closed Hi-Hats function.
• Recording feature - Record by playing on the pads or create new patterns using the sequencer.
• Quantization - Fix imprecisions during recording by enabling the quantization feature.
• Export your recordings as audio files (AAC or WAVE) and use it in other audio applications. 
• Apply built-in reverb and compression effects to process the drum sounds.
• Custom drum kits - Create new drum kits with sounds from other factory drum kits.
• Smart Levels - Pads sound louder at the center and softer at the edges.
• Optimized layout for maximum playability on iOS devices.
• Precise metronome powered by the Metronome M1 engine.
• Configure the volume level of individual pads.
• Rearrange pad positions to your preference.

bluejetty:00026597:ios.description:
Get the trustworthy news you need everywhere you go with the Los Angeles Times app. 
Receive instant access to our award-winning journalism, breaking news, politics, the best in food, entertainment, events and more for Southern California and the world. 
Updated with a new design, the L.A. Times app gives you the option of browsing our digital content or paging through the eNewspaper. Our content includes in-depth coverage of Los Angeles, California and the West; exclusive narrative storytelling such as “Column One”; revitalized reporting on the latest in food and dining; a unique take on politics and the 2020 campaign; comprehensive coverage of the arts, pop culture and the entertainment industry; on and off-season reporting on L.A.’s home teams and major sports events. New tools include “My Library,” to save your own reading list, and a video section to access the latest short documentaries and other videos. 
Download the iOS app to experience our new digital publishing platform. 
APP FEATURES:
• Top News: Scan a curated feed of the most important news as it happens
• Push notifications: Get the latest news from our newsroom as soon as stories break
• eNewspaper experience: Download today’s issue for offline reading and browse archives of past issues
• Video section: Enjoy exclusive video
• My Library: View saved stories and view your recent activity
• Share content easily with Twitter, Facebook, or email
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
• If you’re a current digital subscriber, sign in with your email address and password to get unlimited access to the app’s content.
• Non-subscribers, download the app a select number of stories stories each month. For full access, try a free month of Unlimited Digital Access to the app, the L.A. Times website, and our eNewspaper; then it's only $15.99 a month. Make sure to create a registration while in the app so you'll be able to log in to the website and eNewspaper when you visit them in web browsers.
• Your subscription automatically renews each month unless auto-renew is turned off within your Account Settings at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Your iTunes account will be charged $15.99 for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• You can read our Privacy Policy here: https://www.latimes.com/privacy-policy
• You can read our Terms of Service here: https://www.latimes.com/terms-of-service
• CA Notice of Collection - https://www.latimes.com/privacy-policy#california-notice-of-collection
• Do Not Sell My Info - https://membership.latimes.com/privacy-settings
• Questions about your subscription, including adding or removing access to the L.A. Times website from your app access, can be directed to Customer Service: 213-347-5300.
TECHNICAL HELP AND ASSISTANCE:
If you ever have questions about how the app works, want to provide helpful feedback, or experience crashes or freezes after installing an update, please contact us at mobile@latimes.com. A quick email to our support team helps our developers identify and resolve issues faster. We work hard to make sure you have the best experience using our app.

2. ‘Clip’ coupons for free items and extra savings 
3. Give the cashier your phone number OR Present your digital loyalty card to the cashier to scan at the register! 
With the Lowe’s Market App you can claim as many specials and digital coupons on items you buy, in a single transaction! We look forward to serving you better!

bluejetty:00100207:ios.name: Offline Music Player MP3Player
bluejetty:00100207:ios.developer: Muhammet Yalcın Ozdemir Halil Ibrahim Karahan Mustafa Ayten Kupertino Bilisim Yazılım K.S
bluejetty:00100207:ios.summary: Hear your music the simple way: stored on your phone, ready to play, no WiFi required. Offline Music Player is a clean, focused audio player made for people who keep their tracks as files and just want a reliable way to listen. Pick the son
bluejetty:00100207:ios.description:
Hear your music the simple way: stored on your phone, ready to play, no WiFi required. Offline Music Player is a clean, focused audio player made for people who keep their tracks as files and just want a reliable way to listen. Pick the songs and folders you want with an easy file picker, then press play and enjoy. No accounts, no streaming, no noise. Just your music.
From your downloaded songs to complete music folders, Offline Music Player lets you enjoy your tracks with smooth and reliable playback. Open the app, select the songs or folders you want, and start listening instantly. Use classic music controls—play, pause, next, previous, shuffle, and repeat—to shape your listening flow wherever you are. Whether you’re on a flight, commuting, or simply trying to stay offline, all your music plays seamlessly because everything is stored directly on your device.
The design puts clarity first: large buttons, a minimal layout, and a distraction-free now playing screen keep you focused on what you’re hearing, not what you’re tapping. You can keep the music going in the background while you chat, browse, or lock your phone, and control playback from the notification shade or lock screen for quick access. Lightweight and battery-friendly, Offline Music Player is built to stay out of the way and let your audio take center stage.
What you can do:
- Play offline audio: Listen to local music and sound files with no internet or data usage.
- Manual file selection: Choose the songs and folders you want with a simple file picker.
- Simple playlists: Group tracks into listening sessions that match your mood or activity.
- Classic controls: Use play, pause, next, previous, shuffle, and repeat to control playback.
- Background listening: Keep your music running while you use other apps or lock your phone.
- Lightweight experience: Enjoy smooth performance without heavy battery drain or bloat.
Style, clarity, and control in one:
- Minimal interface: Clean, focused design with no unnecessary menus or distractions.
- Instant start: Open the app, pick your files, and start listening right away.
- Fully offline: No streaming, no sign-ups, and no uploads—your audio stays on your device.
- Privacy by default: Everything plays locally, so your listening habits remain yours alone.
Note: Offline Music Player is a local audio player. It does not search the internet, download songs, or stream from online music services. It plays only the files you select from your device.
Privacy Policy: https://kupertinolabs.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://kupertinolabs.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00079150:ios.description:
Engage in adrenaline-fueled aerial combat in "Drone Shooter War 3D." Take command of a variety of cutting-edge aircraft, including drones, planes, and bombers, as you embark on thrilling missions to obliterate enemy installations and safeguard allied assets. With intuitive controls and stunning 3D graphics, immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of modern warfare like never before.
How to Play:
-Choose your aircraft: Select from a diverse arsenal of drones, fighter jets, and powerful bombers, each with unique capabilities and weapons.
-Strategic maneuvers: Plan your approach and execute precise aerial maneuvers to outmaneuver enemy defenses and launch devastating attacks.
-Target prioritization: Identify high-value enemy targets and prioritize your attacks to maximize efficiency and minimize collateral damage.
-Protect allies: Defend friendly installations and convoys from enemy threats, ensuring their survival is paramount to mission success.
-Upgrades and customization: Enhance your aircraft with upgrades and customize them with different skins and weapon loadouts to suit your playstyle.
Game Features:
-Intense aerial combat: Experience exhilarating dogfights and bombing runs in immersive 3D environments.
-Varied missions: Take on a wide range of missions, including reconnaissance, airstrikes, and escort missions across different landscapes.
-Realistic aircraft controls: Master the handling of drones, fighter jets, and bombers with intuitive touch and tilt controls.
-Stunning visuals: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals and dynamic weather effects that bring the battlefield to life.
-Progression system: Earn experience and rewards as you complete missions and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate ace pilot.
Gear up, take to the skies, and become the hero your team needs in "Drone Shooter War 3D." Command the skies and dominate the battlefield in this action-packed aerial combat game.
