bluejetty:00146054:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00146054:ios.summary:
Diccionario Bíblico Católico
Nunca ha sido más fácil de estudiar la Biblia con este Diccionario Bíblico Católico. Descárguelo ahora y podrá tener acceso a la mejor y más completo diccionario Católico de la Biblia para su dispositivo móvil
bluejetty:00146054:ios.description:
Diccionario Bíblico Católico
Nunca ha sido más fácil de estudiar la Biblia con este Diccionario Bíblico Católico. Descárguelo ahora y podrá tener acceso a la mejor y más completo diccionario Católico de la Biblia para su dispositivo móvil y tablet.
Aprovecha esta aplicación para sentirte más cerca de ti mismo y de Dios, Gran herramienta de Estudio Bíblico en su smartphone.
¡ Diccionario católico para usarlo diariamente, hecho para usted que desea aprender más sobre la palabra del Señor! 
¿Por qué la religión Católica es la verdadera?
Porque es la única religión fundada por Dios mismo. Así de simple y sencillo. Todas las demás religiones, monoteístas y politeístas, cristianas y no-cristianas, anteriores y posteriores a Cristo, han sido fundadas por hombres, no por Dios.
Católico: del Griego "kath'holon" que significa "de acuerdo con el todo", "universal".
1-Se llama "Católica" a la Iglesia fundada por Cristo, para diferenciarla de las iglesias cristianas que no reconocen la primacía del papa.
2-La Fe Católica que nos viene de Cristo por medio de los Apóstoles.
3-Lo que es verdaderamente de la Iglesia, para diferenciarlo de lo que es herético o cismático.
Catolicismo (del griego καθολικός, katholikós, 'universal, que comprende todo') es un término que hace referencia a la principal rama actual del cristianismo, surgida tras el Cisma de Oriente en 1054. Los católicos son fieles a la Iglesia católica, como así también a la teología, doctrina, liturgia, principios éticos y normas de comportamiento derivadas, al igual que al conjunto de sus seguidores como un todo, a quienes se les denomina «católicos».
La Iglesia católica considera que en ella subsiste la única Iglesia que Cristo fundó y encomendó al apóstol Pedro para que la apacentara, confiándole a él y a los demás apóstoles su difusión y gobierno.
El término griego katholikós, que llegó al latín tardío como catholĭcus y luego al castellano como católico, puede traducirse como “universal”. Este adjetivo, que alude a aquello que resulta común o que abarca a todos, fue utilizado por la Iglesia de Roma para referirse a sí misma.
Es importante tener en cuenta existen dogmas compartidos por los católicos y otros cristianos. Entre los principales dogmas católicos, que están basados en la Biblia, aparecen la Santísima Trinidad (hay único Dios que es Padre, Hijo y Espíritu Santo), la Inmaculada Concepción (María, la madre de Cristo, fue concebida sin pecado), la Maternidad Divina (el embarazo de María fue obra del Espíritu Santo, siendo ella siempre virgen) y la Eucaristía (el pan y el vino que se transforman en el cuerpo y la sangre del hijo de Dios).
Recursos bíblicos católicos que encontrarás:
- Diccionario católico offline: consulte todas las definiciones sin necesidad de conexión a internet
- Acerca del Catolicismo, aprenda todo sobre el catolicismo
- Biblia Católica Latinoamericana completa offline
- Estudio del antiguo y Nuevo Testamento 
- Imágenes Católicas
… y más recursos católicos
¡ Descargue ya el Diccionario Bíblico Católico y comparta con nosotros su experiencia !

Nunca ha sido más fácil de estudiar la Biblia con este Diccionario Bíblico Católico. Descárguelo ahora y podrá tener acceso a la mejor y más completo diccionario Católico de la Biblia para su dispositivo móvil y tablet.

Aprovecha esta aplicación para sentirte más cerca de ti mismo y de Dios, Gran herramienta de Estudio Bíblico en su smartphone.

¡ Diccionario católico para usarlo diariamente, hecho para usted que desea aprender más sobre la palabra del Señor! 

¿Por qué la religión Católica es la verdadera?

Porque es la única religión fundada por Dios mismo. Así de simple y sencillo. Todas las demás religiones, monoteístas y politeístas, cristianas y no-cristianas, anteriores y posteriores a Cristo, han sido fundadas por hombres, no por Dios.

Católico: del Griego "kath'holon" que significa "de acuerdo con el todo", "universal".

1-Se llama "Católica" a la Iglesia fundada por Cristo, para diferenciarla de las iglesias cristianas que no reconocen la primacía del papa.

2-La Fe Católica que nos viene de Cristo por medio de los Apóstoles.

3-Lo que es verdaderamente de la Iglesia, para diferenciarlo de lo que es herético o cismático.

Catolicismo (del griego καθολικός, katholikós, 'universal, que comprende todo') es un término que hace referencia a la principal rama actual del cristianismo, surgida tras el Cisma de Oriente en 1054. Los católicos son fieles a la Iglesia católica, como así también a la teología, doctrina, liturgia, principios éticos y normas de comportamiento derivadas, al igual que al conjunto de sus seguidores como un todo, a quienes se les denomina «católicos».

La Iglesia católica considera que en ella subsiste la única Iglesia que Cristo fundó y encomendó al apóstol Pedro para que la apacentara, confiándole a él y a los demás apóstoles su difusión y gobierno.

El término griego katholikós, que llegó al latín tardío como catholĭcus y luego al castellano como católico, puede traducirse como “universal”. Este adjetivo, que alude a aquello que resulta común o que abarca a todos, fue utilizado por la Iglesia de Roma para referirse a sí misma.

Es importante tener en cuenta existen dogmas compartidos por los católicos y otros cristianos. Entre los principales dogmas católicos, que están basados en la Biblia, aparecen la Santísima Trinidad (hay único Dios que es Padre, Hijo y Espíritu Santo), la Inmaculada Concepción (María, la madre de Cristo, fue concebida sin pecado), la Maternidad Divina (el embarazo de María fue obra del Espíritu Santo, siendo ella siempre virgen) y la Eucaristía (el pan y el vino que se transforman en el cuerpo y la sangre del hijo de Dios).

Recursos bíblicos católicos que encontrarás:

- Diccionario católico offline: consulte todas las definiciones sin necesidad de conexión a internet
- Acerca del Catolicismo, aprenda todo sobre el catolicismo
- Biblia Católica Latinoamericana completa offline
- Estudio del antiguo y Nuevo Testamento 
- Imágenes Católicas
… y más recursos católicos

¡ Descargue ya el Diccionario Bíblico Católico y comparta con nosotros su experiencia !

bluejetty:00177558:ios.description:
Number Match is an addictive puzzle game with simple rules: match pairs and clear the board to succeed. Playing Number Match is a useful pastime for your brain. Train your logic and concentration skills, and try to beat your high score!
Try a mobile version of the pen and paper game from your childhood. Now you can take your number game with you wherever you go. Solving free Number Match puzzles on mobile is much easier than using a pencil and paper.
How to play:
• The goal is to clear the board.
• Find pairs of equal numbers (1 and 1, 7 and 7) or pairs that add up to 10 (6 and 4, 8 and 2) on the number grid.
• Tap on the numbers one by one to cross out them and get points.
• You can connect pairs in adjacent horizontal, vertical and diagonal cells, as well as at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.
• When you run out of moves, you can add extra lines with the remaining numbers to the bottom.
• Speed up your progress with Hints if you are stuck.
• You win after all numbers are removed from the number puzzle grid.
There are a lot of ways to solve the puzzle. But it’s not as easy as it seems. Tease your brain and get the engaging experience!
What you get:
• Easy to learn logic puzzle
• Hours of gameplay for you to enjoy
• Daily challenges to win unique trophies
• Seasonal events to get unique medals
• Hints to help you reach the goal faster
• No time limit, so no rush, just relax
• New numbers game from a top developer!
Challenge your brain with Number Match puzzles and have fun! Play number games anywhere, anytime!

bluejetty:00178841:ios.name: Classic Bridge Card Game
bluejetty:00178841:ios.summary:
Practice Contract Bridge at your own pace with smart computer opponents, Standard American bidding, optional hints, and traditional Rubber Bridge scoring.
Whether you’re learning the auction or sharpening your declarer and defensive play,
bluejetty:00178841:ios.description:
Practice Contract Bridge at your own pace with smart computer opponents, Standard American bidding, optional hints, and traditional Rubber Bridge scoring.
Whether you’re learning the auction or sharpening your declarer and defensive play, choose your difficulty and play complete rubbers without waiting for other players. No account or sign-up is required, and the game works offline.
Standard American bidding
• Standard American Yellow Card (SAYC) bidding
• AI players use Stayman, Jacoby Transfers, and Blackwood
• Optional bidding hints during the auction
• Suit and Notrump contracts
• Doubles and redoubles
• Small and Grand Slam bidding
Play your way
• Easy, Medium, and Hard computer opponents
• Play both the declarer and dummy hands when your partnership wins the contract
• Defend contracts alongside your computer partner
• AutoPlay when only one legal move remains
• Claim the remaining tricks when they are guaranteed winners
• Continue an in-progress game later
Review and improve
• Review the auction and completed hands
• Replay a hand from the bidding or card play
• Reveal every player’s starting hand after the round
• Track games played, games won, and win percentage
• View statistics for all time, the current session, and each difficulty
Customize your table
• Choose traditional two-color or four-color suits
• Select different card faces, decks, and table themes
• Adjust play speed and card controls to suit you
Traditional Rubber Bridge
Bid in an auction to choose the contract, trump suit, or Notrump. After the opening lead, dummy is revealed and declarer plays both hands.
Make your contract to score below the line, earn bonuses for overtricks and slams, or collect undertrick penalties when defending. Win two games to complete the rubber, with traditional vulnerability, double, and redouble scoring.
Classic Bridge Card Game gives you a complete Rubber Bridge table for relaxed play, regular practice, and learning at your own pace.

bluejetty:00073983:ios.name: Golf GPS Range Finder: ForeFun
bluejetty:00073983:ios.summary:
A clean, focused experience - trusted by millions. Switch between Apple Maps and Google Maps for accurate, up-to-date map views. Customize every course detail including pin positions to match your game.
1. Built for Apple Watch – Check GPS
bluejetty:00073983:ios.description:
A clean, focused experience - trusted by millions. Switch between Apple Maps and Google Maps for accurate, up-to-date map views. Customize every course detail including pin positions to match your game.
1. Built for Apple Watch – Check GPS distances, view satellite & green heatmaps, track shots, and record scores – right from your wrist.
2. 300,000+ AI-powered Green Contour Maps – Detailed contour and heatmap data to help you read every green with precision.
3. Dynamic Front/Back Yardages – Shows the real front and back from your angle, rather than just the fixed points.
4. Dispersion Patterns & Shot Tracking - Track every shot and see your dispersion patterns projected in real time on the rangefinder.
5. Elevation, Wind & Smart Club Suggestions – Combine slope, wind, temperature, altitude, pressure, and humidity for precise, real-time club recommendations.
6. Strokes Gained Analysis – Compare your performance across driving, approach, short game, and putting to understand exactly where you gain or lose strokes.
7. Golf Tracers – Quickly create polished shot and putt tracing videos from your clips, with easy tracing, fine-tuning, and unlimited edits and saves.
8. Engineered for all-day play – ultra-efficient GPS technology keeps your battery powered through 36 holes and beyond.
9. Dual Map Support – Switch between Apple Maps and Google Maps to avoid outdated layouts and low-res imagery.
10. Fully Customizable 40,000 Courses – Edit GPS points, tee locations, hole layouts, or build an entire course in minutes - every detail is yours to control.
11. Advanced Score Tracking – An expert-level scorecard that captures strokes, putts, fairways hit, penalties, bunkers, and greens in regulation (GIR) for complete stat analysis
12. 24 Performance Charts – Visualize everything from round stats to long-term trends like putting, GIR, and scoring averages.
13. Measure Distance to Hazards, Water, and Layup Spots – Instantly see distances to bunkers, water, carries, and other key course targets so you can plan every shot with confidence.
14. Digital Scorecard & Live Sharing – Supports up to six players and four game formats (stroke, match, Stableford, or skins). 
15. Smart Hole Auto-Advance – Automatically jumps to the next hole in both GPS and scoring views.
16. Ultra-light app – just 30.4 MB with no junk packed in, lightning-fast, smooth to use, battery-efficient, and far smaller than 300 MB alternatives.
17. Calligraphy Scorecard – A handwritten-style scorecard that turns every round into a beautiful keepsake, perfect for saving or sharing.
…and much more for you to explore.
Terms of the in-app purchases:
Golf GPS Rangefinder Annual Membership with advanced features can be purchased from Apple App Store. Payment for in-app upgrades will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription amount. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are located at: http://www.infotalkcorporation.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00098423:ios.description:
ReelMe is an all-in-one AI photo and video generator that transforms your selfies into stunning portraits, creative videos, and shareable visual stories. Whether you want to create trending AI content, generate unique profile photos, or turn images into engaging videos, ReelMe makes creativity effortless with powerful AI tools.
TRENDING TEMPLATES, UPDATED EVERY WEEK
Open the app and see what people are making right now. No prompts to write,
no settings to learn.
- Trending video and photo templates
- Seasonal and occasion looks
- Aesthetic and glow-up styles
- New templates added regularly
- Tap a template, add your photo, done
TURN A PHOTO INTO A VIDEO
Animate a still image into a short clip you can post.
- Dance videos from a single photo
- Birthday and celebration videos
- Motion effects that bring a still image to life
- Before-and-after transformation clips
- Works with photos of people or pets
- Vertical short videos and reels, ready to share
GENERATE REALISTIC PHOTOS & PORTRAITS
One selfie, many results. Explore styles without moving a photo between tools.
- Realistic AI portraits
- Couple and two-person portraits
- Travel and scenic photo styles
- AI avatars in art and illustrated styles
- Beauty looks with adjustable strength
- Backgrounds you can change
- Retry any style with a different photo
ALSO INSIDE
- Hairstyles and hair colors
- Outfit of the day looks and fashion styles
- Glasses, hats, and accessories
- Studio-style headshots and profile pictures
- Future Baby: combine two photos to generate a possible future child's face
WHY REELME
- One photo is enough. No long upload sets, no model training, no waiting for a batch to finish.
- Templates instead of prompts. You do not need to know how to describe a style to get one.
- Photos and video in one app, so you are not moving a file between tools.
- Results stay recognizably you - the goal is a different look, not a different person.
- Free to download, with a clear credit balance before every generation.
Create a new look. Bring a photo to life. Try a trend. Make your next photo a ReelMe.
Subscription details:
Subscribe to unlock premium features and content.
- Plans available: weekly, monthly, yearly
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation
- Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto‑renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends
- You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in Account Settings on the App Store
- If you cancel, your subscription remains active until the end of the current period; no refunds are provided for unused time
- Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you start a subscription
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/reelme-privacy-policy/home
Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/reelme-term-of-service/home

bluejetty:00124330:ios.summary: Dropbox lets you upload, save, and transfer photos and files to the cloud. Backup and sync your pictures, videos, documents, and other files to cloud storage and access them from any device, anywhere. With advanced sharing features, it’s ea
bluejetty:00124330:ios.description:
Dropbox lets you upload, save, and transfer photos and files to the cloud. Backup and sync your pictures, videos, documents, and other files to cloud storage and access them from any device, anywhere. With advanced sharing features, it’s easy to share and send photos or files to family, friends, and co-workers.
Features:
• Automatically upload videos and photos from your camera roll to cloud photo storage - all in the background - for easy video sharing and photo sharing.
• Access any file in your account - even offline - and preview over 175 different file types with no special software required.
• Easily send large files by copying and pasting a link you can give to anyone, even if they don’t have a Dropbox account.
• Scan documents, receipts, IDs, photos, and more using your mobile device and transform them into high-quality PDFs, so you can view and send anywhere.
• Sync folders on your PC or Mac to Dropbox with computer backup, and recover older versions or restore deleted files with version history and file recovery.
Sign up now for your free Dropbox Plus trial. You’ll get 2 TB (2,000 GB) of storage space - that’s enough room to save files from all your linked devices. And with Dropbox Rewind, you can roll back any file, folder, or your entire account, up to 30 days.
Before starting a trial or completing payment, you’ll see the plan price. This amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase and on renewal and will vary by plan and country. Dropbox subscriptions renew monthly or yearly, depending on your plan. Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of your current billing period. To avoid auto-renewal, turn it off within at least 24 hours before your subscription renews. You can turn off auto-renewal anytime from your Apple ID account settings. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Dropbox is a secure cloud solutions leader trusted by Fortune 500 companies for their most sensitive data. Over 14 million paid users choose Dropbox because they know they can count on a company that’s also dedicated to their security and privacy—no matter what they do or where they are. Let Dropbox be your all-in-one file storage, file organizer, file transfer, and file sharing solution for all your devices.
We’d love to hear from you! Join the Dropbox community: https://www.dropboxforum.com
Terms of Service: https://www.dropbox.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.dropbox.com/privacy

bluejetty:00146686:ios.summary:
Film Story is an app that lets you create a wonderful movie by putting your favorite music on your memorable photos and videos.
It's easy to use, just select the photos and videos you took from your camera roll or shoot directly within the
bluejetty:00146686:ios.description:
Film Story is an app that lets you create a wonderful movie by putting your favorite music on your memorable photos and videos.
It's easy to use, just select the photos and videos you took from your camera roll or shoot directly within the app, and use your favorite music as background music. This alone will make a wonderful movie. You can use the editing filter to create a stylish video (movie) with any photo.
Share your memories of important events such as a friend's wedding, a child's growth record, a trip with family and loved ones, and a birthday message in the form of a video (movie) with Film Story!
In addition to saving to your camera roll, you can also post your videos (movies) to Facebook, YouTube, and other social media apps.
□■ Full-fledged functions ■□
Add subtitles, music, and processing filters for an impressive finish. Film Story has the following features so that you can create a memorable video (movie) and enjoy it even after you make it.
[Import of photos]
- You can specify the number of seconds you like from 0 to 10 seconds and play it.
- You can import multiple copies of the same photo.
- You can add subtitles.
[Import of videos]
- You can cut and play any part of the video you like.
- You can import multiple copies of the same video.
- You can adjust the playback volume.
- You can add subtitles.
[Shooting feature]
- You can shoot photos and videos directly within the app.
- A project is automatically created after shooting.
[Stamp feature]
- You can add cute stamps to your videos.
- You can use your own photos as custom stamps.
- You can freely adjust the position, size, rotation, and opacity of stamps.
[Transition]
- 7 different transition effects are available.
- You can select the length of the effect from 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, or 2.0 seconds.
- There is a convenient modification function that allows you to change all transitions at once.
[Subtitles]
- You can place it up, down, left, right, or in any position you like.
- You can specify the style of the text, such as font and font color.
- You can also choose cute Japanese fonts.
[Music]
- You can choose your favorite music from iPod/iTunes as background music.
- It contains more than 40 soundtracks that you can use at your disposal.
- You can use multiple pieces of music in any order you like.
- You can adjust the playback volume of the music.
- You can cut and use any part of the music you like.
[Export video]
- You can choose from 4 sizes to export, from low resolution to high resolution.
- Supports MOV and MP4 formats.
- 12 different filter effects are available.
- Filter effects can be recreated as many times as you like.
[Video sharing]
- AirDrop
- Save to Camera Roll
- Email
- Message
- Facebook
- YouTube
- Other social media apps that handle videos
※ About the free version
The free version has the following restrictions, but they will be lifted if you purchase the Pro version from within the app.
- Movie export is limited to 30 seconds for guest users.
- Movie export is limited to 60 seconds for logged-in free users.
- There are limits on the number of movies you can create (Guest: 2, Free: 3).
- The words "Film Story" will appear in the movie.
- Ads are displayed within the app.
※ About the Pro version
The Pro version offers the following plans:
- Monthly plan
- 6-month plan
- Annual plan
With the Pro version, video length restrictions are removed, the watermark disappears, and ads are hidden.
※ About individual items
You can also purchase individual features as needed.
- Hide ads: Hides ads within the app.
- Export length extension tickets (3-pack): Tickets that remove video length restrictions. One ticket allows you to export one video with unlimited length.
- Watermark removal tickets (3-pack): Tickets that remove the watermark from videos. One ticket removes the watermark from one video.

Add subtitles, music, and processing filters for an impressive finish. Film Story has the following features so that you can create a memorable video (movie) and enjoy it even after you make it.

[Import of photos]
- You can specify the number of seconds you like from 0 to 10 seconds and play it.
- You can import multiple copies of the same photo.
- You can add subtitles.

[Import of videos]
- You can cut and play any part of the video you like.
- You can import multiple copies of the same video.
- You can adjust the playback volume.
- You can add subtitles.

[Shooting feature]
- You can shoot photos and videos directly within the app.
- A project is automatically created after shooting.

[Stamp feature]
- You can add cute stamps to your videos.
- You can use your own photos as custom stamps.
- You can freely adjust the position, size, rotation, and opacity of stamps.

[Transition]
- 7 different transition effects are available.
- You can select the length of the effect from 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, or 2.0 seconds.
- There is a convenient modification function that allows you to change all transitions at once.

[Subtitles]
- You can place it up, down, left, right, or in any position you like.
- You can specify the style of the text, such as font and font color.
- You can also choose cute Japanese fonts.

[Music]
- You can choose your favorite music from iPod/iTunes as background music.
- It contains more than 40 soundtracks that you can use at your disposal.
- You can use multiple pieces of music in any order you like.
- You can adjust the playback volume of the music.
- You can cut and use any part of the music you like.

[Export video]
- You can choose from 4 sizes to export, from low resolution to high resolution.
- Supports MOV and MP4 formats.
- 12 different filter effects are available.
- Filter effects can be recreated as many times as you like.

[Video sharing]
- AirDrop
- Save to Camera Roll
- Email
- Message
- Facebook
- YouTube
- Other social media apps that handle videos

※ About the free version
The free version has the following restrictions, but they will be lifted if you purchase the Pro version from within the app.
- Movie export is limited to 30 seconds for guest users.
- Movie export is limited to 60 seconds for logged-in free users.
- There are limits on the number of movies you can create (Guest: 2, Free: 3).
- The words "Film Story" will appear in the movie.
- Ads are displayed within the app.

※ About the Pro version
The Pro version offers the following plans:
- Monthly plan
- 6-month plan
- Annual plan
With the Pro version, video length restrictions are removed, the watermark disappears, and ads are hidden.

※ About individual items
You can also purchase individual features as needed.
- Hide ads: Hides ads within the app.
- Export length extension tickets (3-pack): Tickets that remove video length restrictions. One ticket allows you to export one video with unlimited length.
- Watermark removal tickets (3-pack): Tickets that remove the watermark from videos. One ticket removes the watermark from one video.

bluejetty:00187879:ios.description:
Leverage the power of your business phone through your iPhone or iPad - anywhere, anytime. By using your iPhone or iPad, you can make and receive calls from your business phone, access your voicemail, business directories, recent calls, conference bridges and other valuable features, such as virtual attendant. 
Some key benefits of the mobile app include the following: 
· Making calls using your business calling plan and your business caller ID
· Receiving calls made to your business phone number on the app
· Being able to extension dial co-workers
· Using the shared contacts directory and having access to all extensions in the company
· Viewing recent calls 
· Clicking to dial back any of your recent callers
· One-click to dial your conference bridges as a moderator or attendee
· Listening to your voicemail
· Updating your voicemail greetings
· Managing virtual attendant schedules, including the ability to override your current schedule
· Updating your virtual attendant greetings
To Use this App:
· Download and install the app on your iPhone or iPad
· Sign-in using your phone system portal username and password
NOTE: If you need more information or can’t log in, check with your service provider to see if you have the necessary permissions to use this application.

bluejetty:00024434:ios.name: Zookeeper World
bluejetty:00024434:ios.summary:
Weekend-exclusive multiplayer events are underway!
 Zookeeper, the definitive action-puzzle game played by more than 30 million people, is now available as a Apple Arcade exclusive!
 Solve simple match-3 puzzles to create your own zoo. Ma
bluejetty:00024434:ios.description:
Weekend-exclusive multiplayer events are underway!
 Zookeeper, the definitive action-puzzle game played by more than 30 million people, is now available as a Apple Arcade exclusive!
 Solve simple match-3 puzzles to create your own zoo. Make it the only one of its kind in the world!
 Get through a variety of puzzles and collect Coins to fill your zoo with cute animals, plants and more! They’ll increase your zoo’s Charm and attract all sorts of visitors!
 As you complete requests from these visitors as well as the Boss, your zoo rank will increase. Before long, you'll be expanding and customizing your zoo with various designs and decorations! You just might come across a family of ducks or a calico cat, or even cruise around in a UFO! With endless ways to spice things up, there’s never a dull moment as a zookeeper!
 You can upgrade the animals you’ve collected, too. Increase their Charm and turn them into cosplay animals!
 Hula Dance Rabbit, Punk Monkey, Tanned Giraffe, Afro Panda, Santa Fennec, Tuxedo Penguin, Franken-Lion, Muay Thai Polar Bear, Sailor Crocodile, Pancake Elephant, Witch Flamingo… Can you collect them all?
 To upgrade your animals though, you’ll need gems. You can get them by defeating MECHA BOSS, who will occasionally attack your zoo!
 There are lots of puzzle stages with innovative gimmicks like "One Move All Challenge," where you have to match all the animals in one move, and "MECHA BOSS Challenge," where you go all out against MECHA BOSS!
 You can get gems in several ways, such as by scoring EXCELLENT in "Star Collection Quest." All you have to do is complete the puzzles and collect stars!
 New animals, puzzle stages and events will be added and updated on a regular basis. Come join the fun!
 Don't forget to feed your animals when they get hungry!

bluejetty:00042072:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest news and weather in the Tyler area on the all-new free KYTX app from CBS 19. 
Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video
LOCAL WEATHER
• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from KYTX
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates
Other Features:
• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen.
This is the official app of KYTX and cbs19.tv, the CBS affiliate serving the Tyler, TX area.
Got feedback? Let us know how we can make this the best app experience for you! Send us a note at appfeedback@tegna.com.
Privacy Policy: https://www.cbs19.tv/privacy
Do Not Sell My Information: https://www.cbs19.tv/do-not-sell-my-information
Terms of Service: https://www.cbs19.tv/terms

bluejetty:00171452:ios.description:
EMS Guidebook allows the user to view the medical protocols of specific EMS agencies. This guidebook is meant to be a replacement of the traditional flip book guides that EMTs and Paramedics carry for reference on emergency calls.
The specific agencies protocols require passwords to download. Those passwords are available from the agency's Training Officer. The Generic Protocols are available without a password.
As part of the base program, each set of protocols contain references such as pediatric vital signs, burn references, c-spine clearance charts, 12-lead guidelines, American Heart Association (AHA) guidelines, START and JumpSTART triage guides. There are also guides to several common cardiac rhythms with examples.
If you wish to have your protocols put into this system contact us through the app

Work out through the arenas and reach the Hall of Fame to reap glory as you show off your healthy achievements to the world.
MoveQuest app integrates with the Apple Health App where you give permission to read your movement and activity data.

You can use the free logo maker to create professional logos, even if you don't have any design skills or experience.
AI Logo Generator provides you with icons and shapes in the form of templates. You can use these templates to create a unique logo for your brand. A logo should always look catchy and should portray the personality of the brand. Our business logo features numerous amazing templates that can be used and customized to create a stunning vector.
With this logo creator, you can design logos in a few minutes. Creating a logo manually with professional design programs requires a significant amount of time and effort. Still, with our app, you can achieve the same high-quality results in just minutes. Our app offers logo design and advanced editing features, allowing you to add layers, branding elements, and filters that will help capture a unique brand value.
Hiring an expert for logo design can be costly and difficult, especially when you don't know what kind of logo would work best for your brand. But you can get as many logos as you want without any hassle. The app not only allows you to make your logo, but it also helps you learn how to create a relevant logo for your brand.
How is our logo maker app better than others?
You might come across dozens of logo creator apps on the store today. Before trying them, read out some of the reasons why our utility is better than any other logo maker:
AI logo generator feature
Designing a professional logo has never been easier with the AI Logo Generator. Whether you're launching a new business, rebranding, or creating a personal project, our powerful AI-driven tool helps you craft a unique and eye-catching logo effortlessly. 
More than 3,000 predesigned templates
Our logo maker app provides not hundreds but thousands of pre-designed templates. These templates are categorized into distinct sections. Our logo template collection is divided into distinct sections related to specific niches. Users need to find the category that matches the nature of their business and select a suitable template from there. Our vintage logo category provides the best old-themed designs.
More than 1000 free design resources
Another notable feature of our app is that it provides thousands of helpful design resources. These resources encompass a wide range of elements, including symbols, icons, shapes, backgrounds, fonts, and more. You can use these resources to edit already-designed templates. You can customize a single template in thousands of different ways with our app.
Easy editing and customization options
Our graphic design logo creator app for iPhone and iPad is popular due to its easy-to-use editing features. You can edit a logo design as many times as you want. The design can be saved in your personal cloud storage space. From there, you can access it on multiple iOS devices and modify the saved template according to your requirements.
Autosave and undo/redo options
Once you select a template from a specific category and move to the editing dashboard, your design will be automatically saved to your device. You don’t have to worry about completing the design in one go. Moreover, our application provides unlimited undo and redo options, allowing users to correct their mistakes.
We offer high-resolution export
Once you make your logo, you can save the logo in PNG, JPEG, SVG, and other HD formats.

∙ Optionally share your game scores with your friends.
Watch and read interviews:
∙ Watch the latest videos with Glenn Kessler in a constantly updating grid.
∙ Read the latest interviews with Glenn Kessler.
And even more:
∙ Learn more about Glenn Kessler, the Fact Checker column, and his book, The Confidante.
∙ Email Glenn Kessler.
∙ VoiceOver support.

bluejetty:00064216:ios.description:
Do you remember classic games like Qix, JezzBall, Styx, or Xonix? Or maybe you're a fan of arcade games that require a strategic approach? If so, you've come to the right place.
During the game the player controls the spider. On each level the goal is to create a sufficiently large spider web. However, this task is not easy because the hungry snake is just waiting for an opportunity to eat the spider.
The game offers an infinite number of increasingly challenging levels, allowing you to enjoy hours of gameplay. A global leaderboard lets you compare your scores with friends. You can also join forces in two-player mode and play on one device, working as a team to defeat the snake that stands in your way.

◆だれでもおいしく簡単に作れる料理レシピ動画アプリ
デリッシュキッチンでは、毎日の料理に役立つ、だれでもおいしく簡単に作れるレシピ動画をお届け！レシピ動画を見ながら料理を楽しく。
掲載しているレシピは、管理栄養士、調理師、料理研究家をはじめとする食の専門家が作ったオリジナル料理レシピなので、大切なご家族の健康にも安心です。
◆作りたい料理が見つかる！
特集があるから、お弁当のおかずレシピ、節約・時短レシピ、おうち時間を充実させるごはんレシピ、ダイエットにうれしい野菜たっぷりのレシピなど、きっと食べたい料理、作りたいレシピが簡単に見つかります。
初めて作るレシピでも、動画だから作り方がわかりやすい！簡単に作れるので料理が楽しくなるはず。
◆毎日の献立を自動提案！「今日のごはん、どうしよう」の悩みもなくなるかも？
カスタム献立機能では、主菜・副菜・汁物をまとめて自動提案！
献立に使いたい食材の指定もOK！冷蔵庫の余りものを入力するだけで献立が決まります。
1週間分の献立を事前にカスタマイズして献立を考えるお悩み時間をぐっと減らせます。
■ユーザーの声（一部抜粋）
「Facebookでデリッシュキッチンの料理動画を毎日観て、レシピを参考に夜ご飯の献立を考えていました！アプリでは作りたいメニューを簡単に検索できるので便利で重宝しています」
「文字より動画の方が頭に残るので、作る時もサラッと流して見ながら出来るのが、とても助かります。簡単に手軽に楽しみながら出来るのもいいですね」
「料理が苦手な私でも動画で分かりやすく、手順も少なくて良いので楽しく見てます」
「子どもと一緒に作ってみようかなと思うデザートがたくさん！」

・管理栄養士、調理師、料理研究家が作ったオリジナルレシピを掲載！

・レシピ動画だから、料理の手順がわかりやすい！
・お気に入りのレシピ動画を保存できる！
・時短・簡単レシピを多数公開！
・「今日の人気ランキング」見放題！

・レシピ動画だけじゃない！近所のスーパーのチラシ情報やクーポンも充実し、お買い物から料理までトータルでお助け！
・お得なクーポンを多数掲載！
・ご近所のスーパーの特売情報を確認して食費を節約！さらに、今日のお得な食材から今日の献立が決まる！

デリッシュキッチンでは、毎日の料理に役立つ、だれでもおいしく簡単に作れるレシピ動画をお届け！レシピ動画を見ながら料理を楽しく。
掲載しているレシピは、管理栄養士、調理師、料理研究家をはじめとする食の専門家が作ったオリジナル料理レシピなので、大切なご家族の健康にも安心です。

◆作りたい料理が見つかる！
特集があるから、お弁当のおかずレシピ、節約・時短レシピ、おうち時間を充実させるごはんレシピ、ダイエットにうれしい野菜たっぷりのレシピなど、きっと食べたい料理、作りたいレシピが簡単に見つかります。
初めて作るレシピでも、動画だから作り方がわかりやすい！簡単に作れるので料理が楽しくなるはず。

◆毎日の献立を自動提案！「今日のごはん、どうしよう」の悩みもなくなるかも？
カスタム献立機能では、主菜・副菜・汁物をまとめて自動提案！
献立に使いたい食材の指定もOK！冷蔵庫の余りものを入力するだけで献立が決まります。
1週間分の献立を事前にカスタマイズして献立を考えるお悩み時間をぐっと減らせます。

「料理が苦手な私でも動画で分かりやすく、手順も少なくて良いので楽しく見てます」
「子どもと一緒に作ってみようかなと思うデザートがたくさん！」

bluejetty:00062063:ios.name: Aktiv Learning
bluejetty:00062063:ios.summary: Aktiv Learning is an active learning platform built specifically for college-level chemistry and mathematics. Say goodbye to static content and generic multiple choice questions and hello to dynamic problems that are designed to help studen
bluejetty:00062063:ios.description:
Aktiv Learning is an active learning platform built specifically for college-level chemistry and mathematics. Say goodbye to static content and generic multiple choice questions and hello to dynamic problems that are designed to help students learn and visualize abstract concepts in STEM.
Aktiv Learning allows chemistry instructors to ask students engaging questions, such as drawing Lewis structures, and receive real-time information on what structures the class is drawing. The app features a custom-built tool that allows students and instructors to quickly and intuitively draw Lewis structures on mobile devices. Additionally, both students and instructors have access to over 250 built-in questions related to Lewis structures, resonance, molecular geometries, VSEPR, hybridization, sigma and pi bonding, and molecular polarity.
Features:
• Intuitive Lewis structures drawing tool built specifically for mobile devices - Use as engaging demonstration for your students to show example Lewis structures and reinforce concepts such as the octet rule, formal charge, and VSEPR. Students can take advantage of the drawing tool to visualize the relationship between Lewis structures and molecular shapes. 
• Create in-class or homework assignments - Perfect for clicker, recitation, or review problems. Students receive push notifications to alert and remind them of pending assignments.
• Assign or practice with over 250 built-in questions related to Lewis structures, resonance, molecular geometries, VSEPR, hybridization, sigma and pi bonding, and molecular polarity. 
• Real-time class results - Quickly find common incorrect structures to address student misunderstanding before exams.
• Isoform recognition - Aktiv’s technology recognizes correct answers independent of the drawn structure orientation.
• Export student activity - Student participation and performance exported in a tap of a button.
• Easy sign-up - Students and instructors can create accounts and join courses all within the app in a few steps.
• School IT and device independent - Assign, work, and review from any mobile device and over any network connection.
More content and features coming soon!

bluejetty:00137223:ios.description:
〖Reverse Challenge〗
“Reverse Challenge” is an app that records and reverses your voice for playback.
It’s one of the most popular games on TikTok, loved by millions of users!
Whether you’re hanging out with friends or just looking to pass the time, gather your companions and start a “Reverse Challenge”! Each participant records a voice message as the “answer,” and then our app will reverse it. The fun begins as you take turns guessing the original message. If you can’t figure it out, try mimicking the reversed voice and use the app to reverse it again to see how close you can get. The better your mimicry, the closer you’ll be to the original “answer”!
We offer a variety of fun sound effects to make your recordings even more interesting.
You can also reverse text—no recording required. Just type your message, and we’ll read and reverse it for you.
Our built-in Hot Words module features a collection of popular phrases, so you’ll never run out of ideas.
〖Instructions〗
1. Tap Record and say the message you want to reverse, then end the recording.
2. Tap Reverse and play it for your friends.
3. Ask your friends to mimic the reversed message and record it again.
4. Let your friends guess the original message by listening to the reversed version.A simple yet endlessly fun game awaits! Download “Reverse Challenge” and enjoy a great time with your friends!
〖Music Reversal〗
The all-new “Music Reversal” is here! Have you ever wondered what your favorite songs sound like in reverse? Now, search and play your favorite tracks in reverse right within the app, explore music from a new perspective, and enjoy a unique auditory experience!
〖Subscription Details〗
• Subscribe to unlock all features and content.
• Subscriptions are billed annually based on your selected plan. You can also choose a one-time purchase (non-subscription).
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The fee will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. After purchasing, you can manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your account settings. Per Apple’s policy, current subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active period, and no refunds will be given for unused portions.
• Terms of Use: https://hcninsaf3hn8.feishu.cn/wiki/P9vXwk64qivb0ekldHucLvmMnuc
• Privacy Policy: https://hcninsaf3hn8.feishu.cn/wiki/WhACwACd9iI6VGkSsB4crdyPnWc
〖Feedback〗
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to contact us:
Email: feedback@onedium.tech

bluejetty:00150108:ios.description:
The AI-powered, FREE Yacht and Boat Management App for Boat Owners & Yacht Managers. YACHTWAVE® is the easiest, most effective way to store, view, and share the information you need at your fingertips, on and off the water. YachtWave is dedicated to making boat management simple and accessible. Best of all, YachtWave is, and always will be, free for personal use.
YACHTWAVE was created by seasoned boaters and captains who sought a simpler, more effective way to organize their boat data without the hassle of complicated software or spreadsheets. With features such as maintenance tracking, task management, inventory control, and checklists, YACHTWAVE offers an ideal solution for managing your boat. Now, boat owners and managers—both large and small—finally have a tool that automates the administrative side of yacht and boat management and ownership.
Key Features:
 • Vessel & Mechanical Specs: Access a comprehensive engine and equipment specifications database whenever needed.
 • Task Management: Effortlessly create, assign, and track tasks to organize your boating routine.
 • Custom Checklists: Design personalized lists for departures, arrivals, safety checks, shopping, and more.
 • Maintenance Logs: Maintain an accurate, easily accessible log of all maintenance activities.
 • Inventory Management: Use categorized and location-based tracking to keep track of every item onboard, including filters, anodes, and spares.
 • Equipment Records: Store detailed records for all onboard equipment, from life vests to navigation systems.
 • Manuals & Photos: A centralized space to store and share equipment manuals, documents, and photos.
Boat Checklist, Boat Maintenance, Boat Tasks, Boat Work Order, Boat Inventory

bluejetty:00115317:ios.description:
Kpop Quiz & Prank – Enter the Dark Side of Kpop 
Are you ready to test your knowledge, challenge your friends, and have some fun with the ultimate Kpop demon experience?
With Kpop Quiz & Prank, you’ll dive into the mysterious world of Kpop demons, explore trivia quizzes, unlock stylish collectibles, and even pull off hilarious pranks!
This app isn’t just another quiz game – it’s a dark, stylish, and entertaining experience created for Kpop fans who love to laugh, play, and discover new sides of their idols.
Features You’ll Love:
Kpop Demon Quizzes
Take on tons of fun quizzes all about Kpop demon characters. From easy questions to tricky trivia, test your knowledge and prove you’re a true fan of the demon side of Kpop!
Trivia Challenges
Think you know everything? Challenge yourself with difficult Kpop demon trivia quizzes that will put your memory and fandom skills to the test.
Which Kpop Demon Character Are You?
Find your true alter ego! Answer fun personality-style questions and discover which Kpop demon character matches your dark energy. Will you be the mysterious one, the funny one, or the ultimate trickster?
Scratch Card Collection
Unlock a huge library of stylish scratch cards! Each card is unique, beautifully designed, and perfect to save as your wallpaper or share with your friends. Collect them all and show off your ultimate Kpop demon collection.
Funny Video Pranks
Trick your friends with hilarious prank videos featuring your favorite Kpop demon characters. Watch them laugh, scream, or get totally confused when the prank begins. Perfect for sharing and having fun at parties!
Beautiful Stylish Design
Enjoy a sleek, modern, and aesthetic interface that brings the dark demon vibe to life. Everything from the quiz screens to the scratch cards is designed to feel immersive and stylish.
Why You’ll Get Addicted:
- Endless fun quizzes to keep you playing.
- Unique demon-themed Kpop content you won’t find anywhere else.
- A mix of gaming, pranking, and collecting in one single app.
- Perfect for sharing laughs and wallpapers with your friends.
- Regular updates with new quizzes, cards, and pranks to keep the experience fresh.
- Whether you’re here to test your Kpop demon knowledge, find out your demon personality, collect stylish wallpapers, or just have a good laugh with funny video pranks, this app has it all.
- Step into the dark side of Kpop and see if you can handle the challenge.

ASWB Exam Prep Practice 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have professionally categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice in a more targeted manner for your situation.

* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 2,600 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.

Don't get confused or frustrated with preparing for the ASWB BSW, MSW or LCSW exams anymore, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of ASWB Exam Prep Practice 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started now!

Why choose Vocabulary Builder by Learning?
- Daily Word of the Day
Discover a fresh word each morning—complete with definitions, synonyms, and real-life usage. Perfect for quick vocabulary boosts.
- 20,000+ Word Library
From business, marketing, finance, and technology to SAT and GRE word lists, we offer curated collections for every goal. Whether you’re aiming for career growth or academic success, you’ll find the right words here.
- Personalized Learning & Goals
Set up custom daily goals and let our reminders keep you on track. Our app caters to your interests—choose from 40+ categories like management, health, culture, and personal development to shape your learning path.
- Interactive Quizzes & Vocab Score
Assess your knowledge with adaptive quizzes that challenge your current level. Watch your vocab score rise as you master essential words. Great for native speakers who want to refine advanced English or for exam prep.
- Motivating Learning Plans & Games
Pick a category, set your plan, and start learning.
Learning Plans guide you step by step so new words become part of your vocabulary.
- Widgets & Reminders for Busy Schedules
Short on time? Our home screen widget serves bite-sized word updates throughout the day. Even if you’re juggling a hectic routine, you can still learn new words easily.
- Shareable Flashcards
Make learning social by creating and sharing flashcards or quizzes with friends and colleagues. Turn vocabulary building into a fun group activity!
- Privacy & Security
All data is stored locally. We never share your information. Learn with peace of mind.
Who Will Benefit?
- Professionals
Impress clients, colleagues, and hiring managers by speaking with clarity and precision.
- Students
Conquer the SAT, GRE, or any standardized test with targeted vocab lists that help boost test scores.
- Lifelong Learners
Expand your vocabulary just for the joy of it, or dive into specialized topics like innovation, economics, or literature.
- English Enthusiasts

Backed by Research & Expert Insights

HBR shows professionals with stronger vocabulary often earn more and communicate clearly.
- Educational Testing Service
Studies from ETS link strong vocabulary to higher GPAs and better exam performance.
- U.S. Department of Defense 
US DOD findings indicate that improved verbal skills can add up to $10,000 to annual income.
- American Psychological Association 
APA highlights how broader word knowledge reduces mental load, improving creativity and problem-solving.
With Vocabulary Builder by Learning, you’ll discover:
- Confidence in meetings, interviews, and social settings.
- Deeper comprehension of challenging books, articles, and discussions.
- Continuous inspiration as you meet daily learning targets and watch your vocabulary flourish.
Ready to Start?
Give Vocabulary Builder by Learning a try today and turn your “What if” into real results. Whether you’re aiming for career growth, academic success, or sharper conversations, it all begins with that first new word. See how quickly your communication can evolve!

bluejetty:00115029:ios.description:
Blue Protocol: Star Resonance is an anime-style multiplayer adventure MMORPG set in the world of Bandai Namco’s PROJECT SKY BLUE IP. Blending anime-inspired visuals with engaging social features, 9 unique classes, and cooperative multiplayer dungeons, the game invites players to explore the vast world of Regnus.
The 1st Anniversary celebration is officially underway! Season 4 “Lightchase Oath” brings a massive wave of new content and rewards.
Log in to claim Rose Orbs ×1,111, a Lv. 320 Epic Gear Chest, and more! The limited-time Seabreeze Festival Celebration is also available, featuring fun activities including Starlight Fireworks and Fireworks Trivia!
▶ New Map: Montegnor Valley
Discover breathtaking canyon landscapes, spectacular waterfalls, and untouched natural beauty. Ancient ruins lie scattered deep within the valley, waiting for adventurers to uncover the secrets of a forgotten past.
▶ New Main Story: “Daydreams & Songs of the Night”
A distress letter from Fafala, strange phenomena in the village, and a mysterious melody that echoes through the night… Follow the clues and uncover a truth far deeper than you imagined. A brand-new mystery awaits—will you be the one to reveal what lies behind the song?
▶ New Dungeons
From “Mirror Judgment” to “Cavern Zero,” six brand-new dungeons will be released progressively throughout the season. Challenge yourself, earn Lv. 320+ gears, and collect exclusive seasonal cosmetics!
▶ "Eternal Radiance" Weapon 
A brand-new weapon system featuring two ways to obtain new weapons and stunning new weapon skins. Upgrade your existing weapons or forge new ones from scratch to create the ultimate weapon for your adventure.
▶ Seasonal Progression: Matrix Manifestation System
Psychoscopes receive brand-new designs, alongside the introduction of the Imprint system. Choose from a variety of Psychoscope effects and freely customize your build to create the combat style that suits you best.
▶ 14 New Battle Imagines
New Montegnor Valley bosses join the Battle Imagines roster, bringing new skills, combinations, and strategies to the battlefield.

bluejetty:00123990:ios.description:
Mind Equation Puzzles
Kakuro & Matchstick Logic
Challenge your brain with Mind Equation Puzzles, a smart collection of Kakuro (Cross Sum) and Matchstick Logic puzzles designed to sharpen your reasoning, calculation, and problem-solving skills.
This app brings together two classic logic puzzle styles in one clean, focused experience—perfect for daily brain training or deep logical challenges.
Kakuro (Cross Sum) Puzzles
Fill the grid using numbers 1–9 so that each row and column adds up to the given sums.
No repeated numbers, no guessing—just pure logic.
- Carefully designed Kakuro grids
- Increasing difficulty from beginner to expert
- Improves calculation speed and logical thinking
Matchstick Puzzles
- Move, rotate, or remove matchsticks to fix equations and create correct statements.
- Creative equation-based challenges
- Encourages flexible thinking and insight
- Multiple solutions and clever tricks to discover
Why You’ll Love Mind Equation Puzzles
- Two logic puzzle types in one app
- Clean, distraction-free design
- Offline playable—no internet required
- Great for adults who enjoy math, numbers, and logic
- Ideal for short breaks or extended brain workouts
- Free to play
Perfect For
- Fans of Kakuro, Cross Sum, and number puzzles
- Players who enjoy matchstick puzzles and equation logic
- Anyone looking for meaningful brain training
Train your mind, sharpen your focus, and enjoy the satisfaction of solving elegant number puzzles.
Download Mind Equation Puzzles today and put your logic to the test!

bluejetty:00087631:ios.description:
# Bounce Defense – A Physics-Powered Tower Defense by Voodoo!
**Every bounce is a blast!**
Step into the most addictive physics-based **tower defense strategy game** where every ricochet matters. In **Bounce Defense**, you’ll drop into a world of chaotic fun, clever positioning, and explosive chain reactions. Built by **Voodoo**, this game delivers the perfect blend of **easy-to-learn gameplay** and **deep tactical challenge** that fans love.
## Think Fast. Bounce Smarter.
Enemies are coming in endless waves—and your only weapon is a bouncing ball that unleashes destruction wherever it goes. Place bouncers and weapons on a **tactical grid** to guide your ball, **trigger attacks**, and build unstoppable defenses. It’s **tower defense meets pinball** in the most satisfying way possible.
## Game Features
**Physics-Based Strategy**
Use bounce mechanics to chain together hits, ricochet around defenses, and take out entire waves with a single move.
**Grid-Based Defense Building**
Place bouncer blocks, turrets, lasers, and explosive weapons to craft the perfect path of destruction.
**Satisfying Chain Reactions**
Trigger smart combos—each weapon has unique cooldowns, effects, and timing. Master your setup for maximum mayhem.
**Upgrade Everything**
Unlock new weapons, improve damage, tweak bounce patterns, and push your strategy to the limit.
**Endless Enemy Waves**
Face off against increasingly tough enemy hordes. The longer you survive, the more intense the action becomes!
**Neon Visuals + Explosive FX**
Bright, stylized visuals with screen-shaking blasts and smooth, satisfying destruction that feels amazing every time.
## Built for Voodoo Fans
If you love **Voodoo’s signature games**—fast, fun, and deeply addictive—**Bounce Defense** is your next obsession. Whether you’re into **idle shooters**, **physics puzzles**, or **tower defense strategy**, this game hits all the right notes.
## Why You’ll Love It
Easy to pick up, hard to master
Offline-friendly gameplay
Quick sessions with deep replayability
Great for fans of **Ball Blast**, **Pinball Tower Defense**, and **bounce puzzle games**
New content, upgrades, and weapons added regularly!
# Download Bounce Defense Now!
Start bouncing, blasting, and building your way through **bounce-fueled chaos**!
Only the smartest survivors will build the perfect battlefield and hold off the endless swarm.
**Ready to bounce your way to victory?** Tap install and join the action now!

bluejetty:00141661:ios.description:
A daily journal that grows into a garden.
Write a few lines, snap a photo, record a voice note, or doodle your day. Every memory becomes a hand-drawn plant, and over the year your entries grow into a memory garden that's all yours.
One Year makes journaling feel light, visual, and easy to keep up with.
"This is the first time I've actually stuck with journaling every day."
Why One Year
• Truly remember each day of your year
• Write as much or as little as you want
• No pressure, no streaks
• Built for consistency, not perfection
Journal your way
• Write: a few words or a whole page
• Talk: record a voice note and your day is saved
• Snap: take photos with digicam, film and black & white looks
• Doodle: draw your own flower, then hear it play
• Feel: color each flower to remember your mood
Find any memory, just ask
• Search your whole year by what happened, not just by date
• Look up a feeling, a place, or a moment, like "happy summer days"
• Results bring back your words, photos and voice notes together
• Revisit any day, any moment
Your garden
• Every day you add a memory, a new plant grows
• 365 hand-drawn plants and animals, one for each day (no AI)
• Watch the year grow day by day, and scroll through the whole thing
• Option to show plants only on days you wrote
Share your day
• Turn any day into a little story
• Share it as a video or a still, with your words, drawing, photos and music
Widgets & sync
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Quick camera access from the Lock Screen
• Full garden view or simple progress dots
• Works across iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, including your garden and today side by side on iPhone Duo
• Everything stays in sync
Your privacy comes first
• Private by default
• Stored on your device and encrypted in the cloud
• No feeds
• No ads
Use One Year for free
• Write about any day
• Some of the widgets
• The Doodle Clock in landscape mode
• Multiple devices and syncing
Get One Year Full Access
• Add up to 5 photos to every day
• Voice notes
• The Doodle Camera for in-app photos
• Daily mood tracking
• All the widgets
• Available as a subscription or lifetime purchase
Every day counts.
Support & feedback:
hi@wndn.studio

bluejetty:00036100:ios.description:
Access best-in-class AI care from the comfort of home and break the cycle of pain and discomfort with Sword Health. Sword Health combines clinical expertise and AI care to support pain recovery, healthy movement habits and women’s health.
Whether you’re dealing with persistent back, shoulder or neck pain, mobility limitations, bladder leaks, menopause symptoms and more, Sword Health offers personalized care that you can do anywhere, anytime with Sword’s solutions: Thrive (Physical Therapy for Pain and Injury), Bloom (Women’s Health Care), Move (Whole-Body Movement) and Mind (Care for Mental Health)
Sword’s personalized AI care programs are available at no cost through thousands of employers and health plans. Check to see if you’re covered at https://meet.swordhealth.com/eligibility-check.
WHY SWORD HEALTH?
- Over 800,000 members have signed up for relief across dozens of countries
- Personalized programs tailored specifically for you
- Expert care when you need it most from a team of clinicians
- Immediate access to care, no waiting rooms, no wait times
- The only solution of its kind with FDA-listed devices
- Accessible at no cost to the vast majority of members
Care that fits your schedule: Improve your health with at-home sessions in as little as 10–15 minutes a day. Complete guided sessions with real-time feedback through Sword Health’s mobile app.
Pain relief: 72% of Sword Health’s members are free of limiting pain by the end of the program.¹ Sword Health solutions can help you prevent pain, address persistent physical pain, build strength and find relief all on your schedule so you can get back to what you love. Get immediate access to care without the waiting rooms.
Educational content: Access easy-to-understand lessons on sleep, pain prevention, pelvic health, posture and nutrition, all created by world-class clinical experts.
OUR SOLUTIONS:
Thrive – AI physical therapy: Whether you’re dealing with back, joint or muscle pain, Thrive delivers personalized recovery plans designed to relieve pain anywhere in your body, from the comfort of home. Complete guided sessions in the app with motion-tracking technology and real-time conversational guidance to ensure proper form. You’ll work with a Doctor of Physical Therapy who will design and adjust your plan based on your needs and goals, and you can message them anytime for support.
Bloom – AI women’s health: A personalized program to support you through every stage of life—pregnancy, postpartum, menopause and beyond. Find relief from bladder leaks, period cramps, painful intimacy, menopause symptoms and more with discreet, at-home care. Your dedicated women's health specialist tailors your program to your goals and stays by your side whenever you need them.
Move – AI whole-body movement plans: Best-in-class movement plans tailored to your unique needs. Move can help increase activity levels, build strength and improve physical health and balance through personalized, targeted exercises and stretching routines. Move integrates with Health Kit to track activity and step goals.
Mind – AI care for mental health: Stress and anxiety don’t wait for a weekly appointment—and neither should support. Access personalized, 24/7 support for your mental health with expert clinicians and AI, all in one place.
ABOUT SWORD HEALTH:
Helping more than 800,000 people access care and available to over 10,000 employers and health plans across three continents, Sword is redefining healthcare by delivering unparalleled recovery from pain to its members.
Visit www.swordhealth.com for more information.
¹of members who enroll in our programs with moderate to severe pain and that, by the end of program, have no or only mild pain, or decrease their pain level by 30%. Sword member base, 2025 data, 127K engaged members.

建てる（注文住宅）　：工務店・ハウスメーカーを探す、モデルハウスを探すなど

Gomez売買不動産情報アプリランキングで総合第1位獲得！※2026年2月時点
ユーザーの立場からアプリの評価・比較を行うブロードバンドセキュリティ社が発表した「Gomez売買不動産情報アプリランキング」において、不動産情報アプリ「アットホーム」は総合第1位を獲得しました。
「アプリの使いやすさ」と「安定性と信頼感」で高く評価され、日々の物件探し・お部屋探しをスムーズにする操作性と、安心して利用できる安定性の両面が支持されています。
●アプリの主な機能
・地図検索機能
地図をなぞって探せたり、通常の地図に加え航空写真でも賃貸物件・不動産を確認できたり、周辺施設や駐車場検索をしながら住まい探しができます。
施設名や建物を基点に検索できるため、住みたいエリアや月極駐車場付き物件の家探しにも便利です。
・並び順機能
「賃料が安い順」「築年月が浅い順」などで並び替えができ、効率よく家探し・部屋探しができます。
・メモ機能
賃貸物件や売買物件ごとにメモを保存でき、内見時や不動産会社への質問にも役立ちます。
・検索条件の保存
検索条件を保存することで、毎回入力する手間を省き、家探し・賃貸物件探しがより簡単に。
・プッシュ通知
新着物件情報やお気に入り物件の更新情報をプッシュ通知でお知らせ。

bluejetty:00039251:ios.description:
Conheça o aplicativo médico criado para facilitar sua rotina de trabalho, otimizar decisões clínicas e trazer mais segurança para cada plantão.
A CalcMed é o aplicativo de medicina criado por médicos para médicos, desenvolvido para quem vive a rotina real do plantão, da urgência, da emergência e da UTI, em adulto e pediatria, garantindo que você tome decisões rápidas, seguras e baseadas em informação confiável.
Aqui, você tem acesso fácil e descomplicado a calculadora médica, prescrição médica prática, protocolos clínicos e ferramentas para atendimento de emergência. Toda a ajuda que você precisa para ganhar agilidade, reduzir erros e tomar decisões com mais segurança, mesmo sob pressão, está aqui.
Seja no pronto-socorro, na UPA, na enfermaria ou na terapia intensiva, a CalcMed foi feita para transformar a complexidade do plantão em decisões clínicas mais rápidas e eficientes.
Pare de perder tempo com contas manuais e cálculos inseguros, dúvidas sobre dose, diluição e prescrições, informações soltas em conversas e aplicativos, passagem de plantão desorganizada, decisões críticas sem suporte rápido. Quem usa CalcMed conta com um assistente inteligente na palma da mão. 
Confira as principais funcionalidades que você irá encontrar:
- Calculadora médica completa para adultos e pediatria
- Calculadora pediátrica com doses por peso
- Cálculo automático de doses, medicações e diluições
- Prescrição médica prática e organizada
- Alerta de doses para maior segurança
- Protocolos clínicos para urgência e emergência
- Ferramentas para pronto atendimento e UTI
- Passômetro para evolução clínica e passagem de plantão
- Recursos para medicina intensiva e atendimento hospitalar
- Conteúdo objetivo para uso na beira do leito
Mais segurança clínica. Menos improviso. Chega de decoreba!
A CalcMed foi criada para apoiar o raciocínio médico, aumentar a produtividade no plantão e oferecer mais confiança em decisões clínicas complexas.
Nosso app é ideal para:
• Médicos plantonistas
• Médicos de pronto-socorro e emergência
• Profissionais de UPA
• Médicos de enfermaria e UTI
• Recém-formados em medicina
• Pediatras e emergencistas
• Profissionais que buscam eficiência, organização e segurança clínica
Com uma interface rápida, intuitiva e desenvolvida para o dia a dia hospitalar, a CalcMed entrega as ferramentas que você precisa para prescrição, cálculo, protocolos e decisões em medicina de emergência.
Pare de improvisar no plantão, ganhe rapidez na prescrição médica, tenha mais segurança em urgência e emergência e use a calculadora médica feita para a rotina real.
Baixe a CalcMed e tenha calculadora médica, prescrições, protocolos e suporte clínico em um único app.
Todas as funcionalidades estarão disponíveis após escolher uma das seguintes assinaturas:
1) Plano Mensal
Acesso completo a todas as funcionalidades
Duração: 1 mês (renovação automática)
Valor: R$ 34,90 / mês
2) Plano Anual
Acesso completo a todas as funcionalidades
Duração: 1 ano (renovação automática)
Valor: R$ 334,90 / ano.
Para mais informações acesse nosso Termo de uso: https://calcmed.com.br/files/terms.pdf e Política de Privacidade: https://calcmed.com.br/files/policy.pdf.

bluejetty:00187465:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00187465:ios.description:
Create meeting minutes that hold up after the meeting.
MinuteTaker helps you create structured minutes with decisions, action items, owners, due dates, notes, and attachments. Start from a blank meeting, a calendar event, or a transcript. When you paste a transcript, AI drafts the first version so you can review, refine, and share faster.
Available since 2012 and used by professionals, teams, clubs, and associations who need reliable records and real follow-up.
STRUCTURED MEETING MINUTES
• Capture agenda, notes, decisions, and action items in one place
• Turn discussions into tracked follow-up
• Set assignees, due dates, and status
• Follow up meeting after meeting so nothing gets lost
TRANSCRIPT TO MINUTES
• Paste any transcript; no recording needed
• Works with transcripts from any meeting tool
• AI drafts agenda, decisions, and action items
• Review and edit before sharing
• 10 AI summaries per month included with MinuteTaker Pro
BUILT FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Document-based: each meeting series is its own file
• Store and sync documents in iCloud or any cloud provider available in Files, including Google Drive and OneDrive
• Clean, structured PDF export that looks professional right away
• Customize exported PDFs with logos, attachments, and layout options
• Rich text notes, attachments, and photos
• Presets for recurring meetings so you can start faster
• Export to PDF, email, or share as a document
• Works beautifully on iPad with split view and Apple Pencil
WHO IT'S FOR
Team leads, project managers, consultants, architects, lawyers, teachers, council members: anyone who needs meeting minutes that hold up under scrutiny and drive real follow-through.
PRIVACY
Your meetings are yours. Store documents in your own iCloud Drive or cloud storage provider of choice. Transcripts sent for AI drafting are processed and discarded. We don't store them, and we don't train models on your data.
SUBSCRIPTION
MinuteTaker Pro unlocks all features on all your devices, including Transcript to Minutes. Monthly and yearly plans are available, with a 14-day trial.
QUESTIONS?
Contact support@minutetaker.app if you have questions or suggestions.
Terms: https://minutetaker.app/terms
Privacy: https://minutetaker.app/privacy

bluejetty:00031601:ios.description:
It's time to know your mind, love your body and navigate your life with purpose.
The Soul Sanctuary features thousands of classes taught by Cat Meffan, world-renowned yoga and meditation teacher, as well as a variety of guest teachers.
This is a space for you to show up, connect, and take time for yourself. Grow both your inner and outer confidence through the power of yoga and meditation.
Every month we add new classes for you to grow your yoga practice, confidence, authority, authenticity, and soul. Are you ready to take the first step to taking your life to the next level?
FEATURES
· Thousands of full length classes
· New content every month
· Easily search for a specific flow/style, or try the “pick for me” feature to try something new
· Flow by mood - access curated classes based on how you're feeling in that moment
· Your own private journal – track your progress and look back on your thoughts as you gain confidence
· Join the Soul Sanctuary community in our members forum.
· Save videos in your own personal library for quick access.
· Watch classes from your iPhone or iPad or cast to your TV via AirPlay and Chromecast.
· Download videos to watch offline. Great for going on vacation.
· Premium membership with a free trial. Cancel any time.
“I believe every human deserves to enjoy a happy and fulfilled life doing the things they love, whilst making a positive impact on the planet and those around them. Yoga has taught me so much about who I am as a person, how to treat my body and also how to treat those around me. I want to share those learnings with you right here.” – Cat Meffan
Premium membership requires a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription that can be purchased within the app. If you’re new to the Soul Sanctuary, you will receive a free trial with nothing to pay up front. All payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current billing cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing cycle. Your subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy & Terms and Conditions: https://soulsanctuary.co/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00045646:ios.summary:
Sleep deeper, focus longer and find calm in minutes. Shimmr brings together guided journeys, breathing exercises, binaural beats and rich soundscapes, crafted by audio professionals.
JOURNEYS
• Guided sessions with a calm voice that takes
bluejetty:00045646:ios.description:
Sleep deeper, focus longer and find calm in minutes. Shimmr brings together guided journeys, breathing exercises, binaural beats and rich soundscapes, crafted by audio professionals.
JOURNEYS
• Guided sessions with a calm voice that takes you deeper, one step at a time through weight, breath and sound.
• The tones, the soundscape and the voice move together as you go deeper, then bring you gently back.
• Choose how present the voice is, from soft to clear, or turn it off.
SHIFTS
• Sessions that move you from where you are to where you want to be, like Busy to Quiet or Awake to Asleep.
• The sound changes slowly as you go, so the change feels natural.
BREATHE
• Guided breathing exercises in the player, like box breathing, 4-7-8, coherent breathing and long exhale.
• A voice teaches the first breaths, then a soft cue and a glowing orb lead the way.
• Set the length from one minute, and add rain, ambient sound or music underneath.
MAKE IT YOURS
• The mixer: adjust tones, music and ambient layers while they play, then save your own mix.
• Add music to any soundscape.
• Sound Canvas: drag and drop sounds to build immersive, layered spaces.
• A visual EQ in the mixer: drag the curve for a warmer or softer sound, or pick a preset.
SOUNDS FOR EVERY GOAL
• Binaural beats and isochronic tones for Delta, Theta, Alpha and Beta states.
• Solfeggio frequencies, including 432 Hz and 528 Hz.
• White, pink, brown, green and orange noise to mask distractions.
• Rain, ocean, forest and more, in high quality.
TRACK YOUR PRACTICE
• A heat map, streaks and mindful minutes show your consistency at a glance.
• Your session history shows which sounds work best for you.
• Save mindful minutes to Apple Health, and share your milestones with beautiful stats cards.
BUILT FOR LONG SESSIONS
• Every sound is built into the app, so it works offline, on flights and anywhere without signal.
• Optimized playback uses far less memory, so long sessions keep playing with the screen locked.
• iCloud keeps your mixes, favorites and progress in sync across your devices.
• No ads and no account needed.
SHIMMR PREMIUM
Premium unlocks every journey, shift and sound, plus custom mixing and full tracking.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://shimmr.app/legal/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00080850:ios.description:
Oficiálna aplikácia pre vyhľadávanie v cestovných poriadkoch vlakovej, autobusovej a mestskej hromadnej dopravy ZDARMA.
Aplikácia Cestovné poriadky CP pracuje on-line, takže používa vždy aktuálne cestovné poriadky vrátane informácií o prípadných meškaniach a výlukách.
Hlavné funkcie:
• vyhľadanie vlakových, autobusových a MHD spojov (a ich prípadných kombinácií),
• zobrazenie odchodov/príchodov z/do vybranej zastávky s možnosťou filtrovať na konkrétny spoj,
• inteligentné našepkávanie zastávok a predvyplňovanie smerov podľa histórie hľadania či obľúbených položiek,
• široké možnosti nastavenia parametrov pre rozšírené hľadanie (napr. voľba dopravných prostriedkov, minimálny čas na prestup, nízkopodlažné spoje, spojenia pre cestujúcich s bicyklom a pod.),
• podrobné informácie o spoji vrátane nástupišťa, koľaje, prípadné meškania, aktuálnej pozície spoja, výlukách, orientačnej cene cestovného a radenia vlakových vozov,
• kontextové prepojenie do predajných systémov tretích strán pre rezerváciu/zakúpenie cestovného dokladu,
• šesť položiek off-line histórie hľadania, možnosť uloženia až 6 obľúbených spojení či sledovanie až 6 rôznych spojení v notifikačnej lište,
• zobrazenie trasy spojenia na mape,
• široké možnosti zdieľania výsledkov hľadania,
• Šepkár - sprievodca aplikáciou.

- Rome
- London
- Granada
- San Sebastián
- Mexico City
- Paris
- Brussels
With the City Tour Worldwide app, you won’t have to choose between panoramic sightseeing tours, guided visits, or exploring the main attractions of each city — City

Collecting cards is fun, but keeping track of them can be overwhelming. You pull a rare card, but don’t know its current price. Your binder is full, but you can’t remember which cards you already own. That’s where this app helps.
With fast scanning and up-to-date card info, you can easily identify, value, and organize your collection—all in one place.
SCAN & IDENTIFY IN SECONDS
Just snap a photo, and we instantly recognize your card. See details like name, set, rarity, and card number in seconds. No more manual searches or guesswork.
GET INSTANT PRICE INFO
Check the current market price right when you scan your card. Whether you’re trading, selling, or just curious, you’ll always know what your card is worth at that moment.
ORGANIZE YOUR COLLECTION
Turn messy binders and boxes into a clean digital collection. Save your scans, group them by sets or decks, and keep track of duplicates and favorites. Your whole collection is always accessible and organized.

WHY CARD COLLECTORS LOVE IT

Download it today and take the stress out of collecting. Every scan gives you clarity, every card has its place, and your collection stays organized.

The most downloaded pain app on the Store - clinically-validated to help you!
