bluejetty:00136618:ios.description:
The most downloaded pain app on the Store - clinically-validated to help you!
Don't let chronic pain stop you from living your life and doing the things you love. Manage My Pain has helped over 100,000 re-take control over their conditions like back pain, neck pain, fibromyalgia, headaches, and arthritis.
Created in partnership with global experts in pain management, Manage My Pain has been clinically-validated to improve outcomes in peer-reviewed research studies.
Manage My Pain will help you:
• Track your pain & activity: Reflect on your day in less than 60 seconds to see patterns and trends
• Analyze your pain: Graphs and charts make it easy to figure out what makes your pain better or worse
• Share your pain: Our reports, created by doctors for doctors, will help you tell your story
• Learn from pain experts: Explore content about how pain works and strategies to manage it (for subscribers only)
Your data is safe with us! We take privacy and security seriously and never sell or disclose your Personal Health Information without explicit consent.
Our app is free to use with absolutely no ads. Insights in the app and in the reports that are generated by our app are limited to 30 days and can be unlocked with an in-app purchase or through credits. A monthly subscription is also available to gain access to our Pain Guide - a set of educational content developed by pain experts that can teach you about pain and coping strategies to manage it.
Use this pain management app to replace your hand-written: 
• pain diary 
• pain journal 
• pain log 
• pain tracker
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Manage My Pain offers 6 auto-renewing subscription options:
Starter - $4.99USD per month or $49.99USD per year
Essential - $11.99USD per month or $119.99USD per year
Complete - $19.99USD per month or $199.99USD per year
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Your Manage My Pain subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
You can find our End User Licence Agreement here:
https://managemypainapp.com/eula
You can find our Privacy Policy here: 
https://managemypainapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00019361:ios.name: Racing Limits
bluejetty:00019361:ios.summary: Racing Limits defines the mobile standards of infinite arcade type racing games. Based on racing and overtaking vehicles both in city and highway traffic, this game features 5 enjoyable modes of racing: carrier mode, infinite mode, against-
bluejetty:00019361:ios.description:
Racing Limits defines the mobile standards of infinite arcade type racing games. Based on racing and overtaking vehicles both in city and highway traffic, this game features 5 enjoyable modes of racing: carrier mode, infinite mode, against-time mode, free mode and a multiplayer mode. You can choose between one-way and two-way traffic and choose among three times of day periods, namely “Morning”, “Sunset” and “Night”. 
There are no limits in Racing Limits but only your racing skills! So drive as fast as you can, make sharp overtakes, do what you cannot do in real life, and finally race to your limits..
FEATURES:
-REALTIME MULTIPLAYER: You can compete with your friends or with other co-racers from around the world in multiplayer mode. This game implements the best real-time multiplayer racing in mobile devices. 
-MULTIPLE CAMERA ANGLES: There are 4 camera angles. Helicopter, back, hood and cockpit. All vehicles you can opt to drive come also with high quality interiors to offer the best possible cockpit camera experience. 
-VERY SENSITIVE AND EASY CONTROLS: Racing Limits has very easy and sensitive game controls for you to make great fun out of it.
-DRIVING PHYSICS: All cars in Racing Limits have realistic power, torque and gear ratios. The acceleration process and top speeds are based on a complete simulation. Vehicle body weight, gear ratios, engine power and torque ratios are all taken into account.
-LOTS OF VERY HIGH DETAILED VEHICLES: Lots of vehicles with high levels of graphical detail are waiting for you to drive! The graphical details of cars present in Racing Limits are the bests of its category.
-TUNINGS AND UPGRADES: You can customize your car by changing gear ratios, ride heights and wheel camber angles. You can upgrade your engine, brakes, and handling for better performance. Several body and rim colors are also available for you to choose.
-REALISTIC GRAPHICS: Racing Limits features lots of optimizations on very high detail and realistic graphics. 
-LOTS OF RACE EVENTS: You will never get bored while playing Racing Limits. It has lots of carrier mode levels, 3 race tracks, 3 time of day periods and 5 different game modes. 
-LANGUAGES: Six languages are currently supported in Racing Limits and lots of others are yet to come in future versions.
FOLLOW US:
* https://www.facebook.com/racinglimitsgame/
* https://twitter.com/RacingLimits
* https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMThWAiBM_EBZWJ8l3OyCtg

bluejetty:00128301:ios.name: World Empire
bluejetty:00128301:ios.summary:
World Empire is a turn based strategy game where you take control of one of 180 countries and strive to build an empire. Use diplomacy, war, and economic might to conquer your foes and become the supreme leader.
With a highly intelligent A
bluejetty:00128301:ios.description:
World Empire is a turn based strategy game where you take control of one of 180 countries and strive to build an empire. Use diplomacy, war, and economic might to conquer your foes and become the supreme leader.
With a highly intelligent AI system and real-world economic and military conditions, World Empire offers endless replayability.
Game story
The year is 2027 and the world is in chaos.
The world markets collapse and with it world order. NATO and old alliances are no longer relevant while everyone is fighting for resources.
The United States newly-elected president decides to focus on home affairs focusing on the economy and rebuilding the country's economy.
The United States starts pulling back its forces from around the world.
Europe with huge floods of refugees and weak Euro cannot affect global affairs while America is in crisis.
The world is left to deal with razing powers and tension become extremely high in east Europe, south China sea and Middle East...
A big uprising overthrew the existing government in your country.
As leader of the uprising you got unlimited authority in the country to lead and rebuild. 
The parliament nominated you and your way to make the country into an empire.
As the new leader, your goal is to ultimately become the supreme leader.
Using everything from diplomacy to war, you must strive to build an empire, both economically and militarily superior to all others.
Are you ready to lead, Supreme Commander?
Select your country and start to play.
Game Features
* Turn-Based Strategy: Strategize, plan, and outmaneuver your rivals.
* Global Empire Building: Conquer nations, grow your economy, and build a mighty military.
* Real-World Conditions: Experience current world events and country statuses.
* Intelligent AI: Face challenging AI opponents.
* 40+ supported languages: Play in your preferred language.
The game offers a wide range of features, including access to global Weapons Suppliers, a Spy Center, a War Room, Diplomats, the United Nations, an Economy system, Technology, and World News Distribution (Economy, Relations, Spy, and War). All this is powered by advanced Artificial Intelligence.
Arm yourself with an arsenal of weaponry, including Mercenaries, Armored Personnel Carriers (APCs), Tanks, Artillery, Anti-Air Missiles, Helicopters, Fighter Jets, Ships, Submarines, Fighting Robots, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Aircraft Carriers, and Ballistic missiles.
Multiplayer
Challenge friends and players worldwide with online multiplayer and local play options for up to 8 players. Each player manages their country and communicates through private messages. 
Accessibility
VoiceOver users can enable accessibility mode by tapping three times with three fingers upon launching the game. Play with swipes and double-taps. (Please ensure TalkBack or any voice-over programs are closed before starting the game).
Take on the mission, Commander, and lead your chosen country to become the supreme empire. Best of luck from the iGindis Team!

bluejetty:00026567:ios.summary:
MyNetDiary is the calorie tracker you'll actually stick with: fast, accurate, and ad-free. Log meals in seconds with the free barcode scanner, Meal Scan (just photograph your plate), or quick search. Then get on with your day.
Trusted by 3
bluejetty:00026567:ios.description:
MyNetDiary is the calorie tracker you'll actually stick with: fast, accurate, and ad-free. Log meals in seconds with the free barcode scanner, Meal Scan (just photograph your plate), or quick search. Then get on with your day.
Trusted by 32 million people. Named the top weight loss app by Forbes Health (2025). Scored highest of 30 apps for behavioral strategies in the American Journal of Preventive Medicine. The New York Times called it simpler, quicker, and better-looking than the competition. Featured in Today's Dietitian.
WHY PEOPLE SWITCH
Accuracy: MyNetDiary runs on a staff-verified food database of over 2 million foods with up to 108 nutrients per entry, built on USDA and NCC research-grade sources, the same databases used in clinical research. Most apps rely on crowdsourced data full of duplicates and errors. Our team reviews and updates 2,500-3,500 foods every day. An independent 2026 study in Nutrition and Health found MyNetDiary's calorie totals within 5 calories of the reference records and rated it highest of 17 apps for overall quality.
Speed: In our January 2026 test, we logged the same 127 foods in every major app over a week. MyNetDiary took 31% fewer taps than the most popular calorie tracker.
Results: In a peer-reviewed JMIR study of 5,132 MyNetDiary users (2026), those who tracked food 6-7 days a week lost 11.33% of body weight on average over 6 months.
Value: The free version is generous, with barcode scanning, full macro tracking, 108 nutrients, and water tracking. No ads, no account required, no paywall tricks.
WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE
• Unlimited food diary with search, favorites, recent meals, and copy-from-day.
• Free barcode scanner with accurate nutrition data from the verified food database.
• Voice logging.
• Macro tracking, planning, and protein tracking.
• 108 nutrients - deep, accurate nutrition tracking (vitamins, minerals, omegas, amino acids).
• Exercise tracking.
• Water tracking.
• Calorie calculator.
• Customizable dashboard.
• Weight loss progress charts and reports - no chart caps.
• Custom foods and recipes.
• Food sharing with friends and family.
• Apple Watch app and widgets.
• Apple Health sync: writes 51 data types, reads 14.
• Coaching tips, meal reminders, shopping list.
• Logging streaks to keep you going.
• Professional Connect: share your diary with a dietitian, coach, or doctor. Used by dietitians and health professionals at no cost.
• In-app Community.
• Articles by Registered Dietitians.
• Works offline.
PREMIUM
• Meal Scan: snap your plate and log it, matched against the staff-verified database.
• GLP-1 Companion: nutrition-first support for Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, and other semaglutide or tirzepatide medications, with protein targets and muscle protection while you lose weight.
• Calorie and macro cycling.
• Autologging: your regular meals logged automatically.
• Intermittent fasting.
• Advanced Autopilot, adaptive TDEE: estimates your actual energy expenditure from logged food, exercise, and Trending Weight and updates calories and macros weekly.
• Health tracking: measurements, blood pressure, blood glucose, A1C, ketones, and more.
• Medications and diabetes tracking.
• Sync with Fitbit, Garmin, and Withings.
• Trend Analysis to spot patterns and optimize.
• Meal Planner.
• Recipe import.
• 600+ recipes and diet plans by Registered Dietitians: High-Protein, Low-Carb, Keto, and more.
PREMIUM PLUS: AI COACH
AI Coach is built on 20 years of nutrition expertise.
• Daily guidance based on what you actually ate, not just what you planned.
• AI voice logging: describe your meal out loud.
• Meal suggestions matched to your calorie budget and preferences.
• AI Restaurant Menu Scan: find the best options when eating out.
Results may vary. MyNetDiary does not provide medical advice.
All product names, logos, and brands are the property of their respective owners.
Research: www.mynetdiary.com/research.html
Terms of Use: www.mynetdiary.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00073009:ios.description:
Enjoy this all-in-one puppy daycare - the cutest game ever!
Let's show some virtual pet puppy love.
Here, we can do some amazing activities in sweet dog daycare to enjoy the best pet care games for you.
we have included all the tasks you wish to have in a perfect puppy daycare game.
we are sure that you will enjoy performing each and every tasks whether it would be rescuing or grooming or preparing pet's house etc....
Be a part of this amazing animal game to discover your inner skills when it comes to handling an injured puppy!
The puppy, here, requires serious attention of yours. If you want to make him happy, you are going to offer him special treatment once with the nurse.
Be the great Vet for your little pet and perform the medical tasks accurately. Please, don’t miss any of them because each one has an essential role for this poor pet that will cure it and make it happy.
Oh no! puppy's head is stuck with a bucket. Rescue it smartly.
A cute little puppy is injured. Take care of it. Heal wounds, do nail care, ear cleaning, and tail triming by using various tools like bandages, cotton, antiseptic cream, nail cutter, razor, etc.....
Build and construct a new beautiful home for your pet. Enjoy puppy house cleaning and house decoration. Don't forget to serve food and water near the house.
puppy daycare is all about dress up your pet.
Accessorize your little puppy with beautiful dresses , necklaces , goggles and caps and do it's makeover. You will get different options for puppy's food utensil and toys also.
Puppy' s teeth are hurting. Let’s help him in cleaning teeth and kill the germs bacteria. Same as human teeth treatment, remove all the cavities from the puppy's mouth and perform teeth replacement procedure.
Little pet is injured while playing . It needs immediate surgery. Get ready with your surgery room! Learn about all the medical tools used in first aid treatment. Make sure the little puppy feels less pain.
Start with essential check ups like bp and heartbeat and then perform other surgical tasks. Remove wood stuck on body, dressing of wounds, apply ice on swelling head and so on.
puppy' s tail bone is injured. Perform bone replacement surgery and plaster the tail for fast recovery.
prepare some delicious food and feed for newborn pet.
You will get a chance to cook variety of foods like sandwitch,soups and egg custard for a puppy animal.
Make sure he eats well and gets enough energy for playing.
Grooming is very important for good health. Give your furry puppy friend a warm bath and a nice hair treatment
to make it look adorable. Don' t forget to apply a cute tattoo on it' s body to make puppy look more cool and dashing.
Like us, our pets also prefer their rooms tidy and clean.A beautiful room with comfortable bedding will help them get a better sleeping experience. Clean and wipe its messy room,re- rack items on its proper place and then prepare a cosy bed for this little pet. Start slow music and turn off the lights, then wish it a good night's sleep.
Oh! my my! puppy is dreaming while sleeping! what is he seeing in its dreams?! I won't tell you that. you have to find out a secret about dreams by playing the game yourself.
Even our pets need a beautiful garden to play there.It s our duty to do makeover of garden area and make it suitable for a puppy. First of all, you need to clean the garden thoroughly. Repair the fountain by playing a mini-game and keep beautiful decorative plants.
Repair fence for safety of dog.
At last, light decoration will enhance the beauty of the garden.
You will get fun while learning experience by performing every activity. This is a very engaging game for sure!
Go for it and enjoy this beautiful journey!

bluejetty:00042506:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00042506:ios.description:
Your treatment journey is complex. Wave Health makes it easier.
Track symptoms, management treatments, and take a more active role in your health – all in one place.
Wave Health empowers you to be proactive in reporting symptoms and staying connected to their care team between appointments. By identifying trends early, Wave Health uncovers patterns in your health, helping you better understand and manage your well-being.
Log how you’re feeling, record ongoing symptoms, manage medications with automated alerts, and monitor important daily activities like sleep, water, steps and vitals. Through personalized guidance, educational resources, and tailored insights, Wave Health helps you navigate treatment and walk into appointments with a record instead of a recollection.
Two ways to use Wave Health
Wave Health works as an independent app, or connected to your hospital and care team.
Key App Features:
Symptom Logging: Track your daily symptoms and keep a log to bring to your care team – sleep, water, moods, physical activity, mental health, mindfulness, journal entries, and more.
Medication Tracking: Stay on schedule with medication reminders to never miss a dose.
Custom Trackers & Quick Logs: Capture symptoms, vitals, body functions, and activities unique to your journey, not just what's on a standard list.
Tailored Insights: Your logged data becomes actionable insights showing how your daily habits affect your wellbeing.
Automatic Data Syncing: Enable automated tracking by syncing your Fitbit, Apple Watch, Oura Ring, or other wearable devices through Apple Health and Apple Health Kit
For hospitals and care coordinators who want to monitor their patients using the app:
Scheduled Symptom Reviews: Submit check-ins reviewed by clinicians via a risk-ranked action list.
Urgent Symptom Alerts: Urgent symptoms trigger an immediate in-app alert to the care team.
Patient-Initiated Symptom Reporting: Report significant symptom worsening between scheduled reviews.
Review Notifications: Get notified when a submission is reviewed, with any clinician message.
Risk-Ranked Auto-Sorting: Automated triage routes low-risk reports away from the queue, with at-risk patients on top.
Auto-Close: No-risk submissions close automatically and are hidden from the default inbox, accessible only via filter.
Expired/Superseded Logic: A new submission automatically expires any prior unreviewed one, preventing task buildup.
Secure Messaging & Follow-Up: Clinicians follow up on submissions for e-prescriptions, treatment changes, and structured escalation.
Created from a Real Life Cancer Journey
Our founders underwent a cancer journey 7 years ago, which sparked the idea of Wave Health. We understand what it’s like to be faced with a major health diagnosis, and all that comes with it.
Certifications & Standards UKCA & CE Class 1a SaMD (MHRA) · DTAC compliant · ORCHA 90% · ISO/IEC 27001 · ISO 13485 · ISO 14971 · ISO 9001 · DCB 0129 · Cyber Essentials Certified · HIPAA & GDPR-compliant (AWS London)
Wave Health is configured per cohort and supports 220+ conditions: Prostate Cancer, Breast Cancer, Lymphoma, Lung Cancer, Fibromyalgia, Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Hypertension, Ehlers-Danlos, Inflammatory Bowel Disease, Chronic Pain, Chronic Graft-versus-Host Disease (cGVHD), Migraines, Anxiety, Depression, and more.
Get In Touch
We’re dedicated to improving our app through feedback from our community. If you have questions, feedback, suggestions, or just want to get in touch — please email support@tti.care.
Learn more at https://www.wavehealth.app, or email support@tti.care for feedback or partnership questions.
Private & Secure
Privacy Policy: https://www.wavehealth.app/privacy-en
Terms of Use: https://www.wavehealth.app/terms-en
Wave Health does not give medical advice — please consult your doctor before making any changes to your health plan.

bluejetty:00089657:ios.summary:

The list of currently su
bluejetty:00089657:ios.description:
Explore the most unique destinations on our planet with Fyno — an all-in-one adventure travel planner. Get inspired, research, and plan your entire trip with curated content in a powerful, beautifully designed app.
The list of currently supported destinations (more guides coming soon!):
EUROPE: Iceland (Reykjavik, Ring Road), Italy (Dolomites, Tuscany, Florence, Rome, Cinque Terre), Switzerland, Norway (Lofoten Islands, Tromsø), Paris.
ASIA: Japan (Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka), Bali, Jordan (Amman, Petra).
NORTH AMERICA: Alaska, Yellowstone, Colorado, Grand Circle (Grand Canyon, Zion, and 5 more national parks in Utah and Arizona).
ALSO AMERICAS: Costa Rica, Patagonia (both Chilean and Argentinian sides), Peru (Lima, Machu Picchu, Ica, Iquitos), Mexico (Yucatan peninsula).
AFRICA: Morocco, Namibia.
OCEANIA: New Zealand.
Here is how Fyno will make your next adventure planning a breeze:
UNIQUE, INSPIRING DESTINATIONS
Fyno is dedicated to the most unique locations around the globe — from stunning nature of Iceland to unique heritage of Japan, with dozens of equally incredible places in between and each one worthy of your bucket list. These are usually the ones that require lots of planning, but not anymore!
READY ITINERARIES FROM EXPERTS
Access perfectly balanced, day-by-day travel itinerary crafted by our travel experts who have researched and traveled to each of our destinations to make your life easier.
VISUAL AND EASILY CUSTOMIZABLE
Top sights, hidden gems, and recommended hotels are neatly organized in our trip planner by city or region, both on the map and on the list. What's left is to personalize trip itinerary to unique you by extending or reducing time in every region and adding, removing, or re-arranging activities based on your travel style.
MUST-SEE SIGHTS AND HIDDEN GEMS
We vet every activity mark them as must, great, or nice to visit based on multiple factors including expert's personal experience. Each activity features tips from our experts like recommended time to spend, logistics considerations, time of day to visit, and notable restrictions to keep in mind.
WHERE TO STAY IN EVERY REGION
Our experts check thousands of hotels in every destination to bring you the Top 1% stays. From charming hostels to boutique hotels to luxury resorts, we analyze it all through reviews, location, noise levels, and value for money, all to make sure you have a memorable stay within your budget.
FULL LOGISTICS SUPPORT
Be confident in getting around in each destination with Fyno's cutting-edge Logistics Engine — optimized travel itinerary route with driving times between activities for regular road trips, and support for region-specific transfers based on expert insights like a train to Machu Picchu or a ferry between New Zealand's islands.
HOTEL PRICING AND AVAILABILITY
Quickly check pricing and availability on Expedia, Booking.com, Airbnb, or the hotel's official website for your specific dates, right from the app! While our experts stayed at many of them, we are not affiliated with any single one, just researching the best options so you don't have to.
ALL-IN-ONE TRIP ORGANIZER
You will never mix up the dates again or forget to book anything for your itinerary with Fyno's Trip Organizer — just select your start date and it will auto-magically augment your Expedia, Booking, Viator, and GetYourGuide links with the right dates according to your plan. It will also remind you about activities that need to be booked in advance.
Fyno PRO gives you full access to the app features and expert content, including a free consultation about your upcoming trip.
If you choose to upgrade to Pro, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://fyno.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://fyno.com/terms/

The evil
bluejetty:00032293:ios.description:
==Background Story==
After a millennium dream, chaos arises all of a sudden. Lucifer is attempting to open the gate of the Demonground and create a passage between the two worlds, in order to launch an endless war of extinction.
The evil power in the Temple of Hades is quietly awakening, and the world's demons are stirring. The roars of demons in hell make the earth tremble! The holy feathers are once again unfurled. If you don't fight, heaven will collapse and the beautiful world will be destroyed. So join the battle! Go through hardships to fill the world with hope!! Join the battle! In the name of light! And fight to the top!
You, born from the light, are the hope of the world and the terminator of strife. As a descendant of god, you are determined to navigate this miraculous continent with courage, wisdom and perseverance to collect soul cards and accumulate power, preparing to defeat the evil enemies and let the light of dawn shine on the world again!
Who will excel this time? Good? Or evil?
==Features==
[A Dark Art Style that Recreates the Era of Magic]
Exquisite 3D modeling throughout the game that reproduces the classic dark art style.
An immersive adventure in an amazing magical world that brings an unprecedented experience.
Travel the mysterious continent of angels as the hero to find treasure and be a part of epic myths.
[An Inexpensive AFK Game with High Drop Rates]
One-click AFK and free VIP10. Rake in 100K Dia on your first day and enjoy AFK earnings. Trade advanced items as you wish at the open market. Sell equipment for money and become a top player without spending a cent.
Say goodbye to slow grinding. Hunt frenzied bosses to get L.E. gear, enjoy chance of rare bling skins increased to 1000% and obtain mounts and wings effortlessly. Your CP will skyrocket.
[Hundreds of Appearances and Unique Soul Card Morph]
Majestic armors, elegant gowns, casual swimsuits... Feel free to match various costumes.
Holylight Wargod, Queen of Blades, Scarlet Nightmare... Hundreds of mounts, followers, and magical creatures are at your command. Send them to collect soul cards, so that you can match skills as you like, transform into gods and demons in the battle, and smash the opponent!
[An Exciting Adventure and a Rich Gameplay]
A special boss progression system in which you can use Demoncores to evolve Infinite Bosses, boosting drop rates significantly.
Abyssal Trial, Devil Sniper, Royal Duel... A variety of random dungeons that you can clear in no time with high CP. Parkour, Fisher King, Fruit Workshop... Numerous interesting gameplay modes will keep you engaged!
[Team with Friends to Fight Thrilling Battles]
Team up to join raids, whole server brawls, and a variety of PvP modes and stage spirited fights.
When the world server siege is on, occupy the Shrine on behalf of your server to challenge powerful enemies of the Golden City in cross-service mode!
==Follow Us==
Facebook Fan Page: https://www.facebook.com/DemonHunterRebirth
Email: demonhunter.rebirth@gmail.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/2UY96jchDd
VK: https://vk.com/demonhunterrebirth
Telegram: https://t.me/DemonHunterRebirthRU

bluejetty:00136762:ios.description:
Looking to make reaching your weight goals easier and faster? Welcome to Calorie Counter by Numify — your all-in-one nutrition companion for smarter eating, healthier habits, and lasting results.

bluejetty:00165819:ios.description:
Welcome to Bubble Bling, your portal to a glittering world of bubble‑popping fun!
Bubble Bling transforms the classic bubble‑shooter into an epic adventure. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them, rack up points and complete each level’s mission. Tap wherever you want to aim, shoot and watch as chains of bubbles burst in a rainbow of colors.
Power‑ups and levels
With more than 100s hand‑crafted levels, Bubble Bling stays fresh and challenging. Each stage brings a new layout and mission. Unlock power‑ups like the Rainbow Bubble (matches any color), Hammer (smashes clusters) and Fireball (vaporizes everything in its path). Every level has unique objectives; hitting a target score, freeing stars or breaking blockers and a bonus shell.
Tickets, gems and mining
Completing levels and earns tickets Tickets let you upgrade your personal Atlantis, an underwater city that generates tickets automatically while you’re offline. Invest tickets in building and levelling houses to earn more every hour.
Along the way you’ll collect pink gems, earned or purchased. Gems allow you to buy extra power‑ups and even purchase extra moves when you’re one shot away from victory. They’re your secret weapon for tricky stages.
Whether you’re a seasoned bubble‑shooter veteran or a newcomer looking for a relaxing way to disconnect, Bubble Bling has something for you. With vibrant graphics, intuitive controls and a rewarding progression system, every level feels like a step deeper into a sparkling treasure cave.
Download Bubble Bling now and start popping bubbles, mining gems and building your underwater kingdom. Play for fun, your adventure awaits!
Join the fun with Bubble Bling, the ultimate bubble shooter for entertainment, relaxation and real rewards.

Bubble Bling transforms the classic bubble‑shooter into an epic adventure. Match three or more bubbles of the same color to clear them, rack up points and complete each level’s mission. Tap wherever you want to aim, shoot and watch as chains of bubbles burst in a rainbow of colors.

Power‑ups and levels

With more than 100s hand‑crafted levels, Bubble Bling stays fresh and challenging. Each stage brings a new layout and mission. Unlock power‑ups like the Rainbow Bubble (matches any color), Hammer (smashes clusters) and Fireball (vaporizes everything in its path). Every level has unique objectives; hitting a target score, freeing stars or breaking blockers and a bonus shell.

Tickets, gems and mining

Completing levels and earns tickets Tickets let you upgrade your personal Atlantis, an underwater city that generates tickets automatically while you’re offline. Invest tickets in building and levelling houses to earn more every hour.

Along the way you’ll collect pink gems, earned or purchased. Gems allow you to buy extra power‑ups and even purchase extra moves when you’re one shot away from victory. They’re your secret weapon for tricky stages.

Whether you’re a seasoned bubble‑shooter veteran or a newcomer looking for a relaxing way to disconnect, Bubble Bling has something for you. With vibrant graphics, intuitive controls and a rewarding progression system, every level feels like a step deeper into a sparkling treasure cave.

Download Bubble Bling now and start popping bubbles, mining gems and building your underwater kingdom. Play for fun,  your adventure awaits!

Join the fun with Bubble Bling, the ultimate bubble shooter for entertainment, relaxation and real rewards.



Don’t forget to review our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

· Terms of Use: https://prizes.gamee.com/terms-of-u

· Privacy Policy: https://www.gamee.com/privacy

The game is in no way sponsored, endorsed or administered by Apple.

bluejetty:00144172:ios.description:
Precision 2D vector drawing and design on the iPad & iPhone.
Make professional quality designs, illustrations and technical drawings on the move using your fingers at last! iDesign has unique features and offset controls which allows you to draw accurately with your finger not getting in the way or blocking your view.
Full feature compatibility and automatic sync of designs via iCloud with XDesign (Mac version).
User Guide (PDF) available at www.touchaware.com/apps/idesign/userguide
FEATURES 
- A universal app for both iPad and iPhone which adapts to the native screen size of the device.
- An unobtrusive icon based visual and context driven user interface with a full screen board view
- Toolbars and panels with easy access to frequently used functions for a fast work flow 
Standard Tools & Functions
- Line, polyline, square, rectangle, circle, arc, ellipse, polygons, stars & path tools
- Copy and paste selected shapes and groups
- Group and ungroup shapes hierarchically to create complex designs 
- Edit points, convert shapes to path, close shapes, add and remove points, break, weld, explode and join 
- Precise rotation with ability to rotate at user defined center 
- Object alignment tools
- Fill color and pen color swatches with opacity controls, custom RGB mixer 
- Stroke width, line style, line caps and corner join styles, arrow ends and dash patters 
- Text insertion with fonts, styles, sizes, paragraph alignments, multilingual, rotate/resize
- Set a background image for tracing/marking over it
- Insert images, copy, paste, move, resize and position them accordingly
- Multilevel Undo/Redo for all edit operations
- Create multiple layers to organize & separate design components
- Connector tools for drawing charts and flow diagrams
Unique Features for Touch Based Editing
- Offset handles for moving and positioning without your finger blocking the view 
- Nudge controls, allows precise movement of selected shapes or selected points 
- Delta transformations to apply incremental values by keyboard
Advanced Tools for Graphics Design
- Advanced path editing options for corner, smooth and symmetric control points, straighten and curve segments 
- Text to path conversion
- Boolean operations on shapes, unite, intersect, subtract, exclude
- Freehand drawing, auto smoothened paths
- Gradients / color blends
Advanced Tools for Technical Drawing
- Circle and Arc tool based on center, start/end point, radius and angle of arc
- Dimensioning tools, length as well as angular with customisable settings
- Support for Feet+Inches+Fractions (U.S & older unit system) - Architectural formatting option for Dimensions - Dynamic grid supporting feet, inches and inch fractions at different zoom levels
Units & Board Setup
- Support for standard and custom board sizes.
- Set a drawing scale
- Full set of standard unit systems.
- Unit aware Grid with customisable settings
- Snap to grid, snap to object and points
- Unit aware rulers
Shape libraries to organise and reuse shapes
- Add, remove and organise shapes in your own libraries
- A set of standard shapes for creating floor plans included
Export/Import & Print
- Export designs to JPEG, PNG, PDF & SVG formats
- Import SVG files 
- Share your designs with other iDesign users via Email
- Dropbox support for Export, Import 
- AirPrint Support
iDesign is available as a monthly or yearly subscription and includes a free trial period that begins once your purchase has been confirmed with your Apple ID account. At the end of the trial your subscription will start and renew automatically. Your Apple ID account will be charged for the upcoming period unless you disable auto-renew or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Terms of Use: http://www.touchaware.com/apps/termsofuse
Privacy policy: http://www.touchaware.com/apps/privacy

bluejetty:00076705:ios.name: Kinomap: Bike, Run, Row
bluejetty:00076705:ios.summary: Kinomap is an interactive training app for indoor cycling, running, walking, and rowing, compatible with exercise bikes, home trainers, treadmills, ellipticals or rowing machines. The app provides access to the largest geolocated video shar
bluejetty:00076705:ios.description:
Kinomap is an interactive training app for indoor cycling, running, walking, and rowing, compatible with exercise bikes, home trainers, treadmills, ellipticals or rowing machines. The app provides access to the largest geolocated video sharing platform with thousands of routes around the world. We take control of the equipment and automatically change the resistance of the bike or the inclination of the treadmill according to the chosen stage. This isn't 'at-home training', this is the real thing!
Stay active all year long with a motivating, fun and realistic sports application! Ride, run, walk or row alone or with others on the 5 continents. Explore new destinations from home, and join virtual challenges. Progress and reach your goals with structured training. 
TRAINING MODES 
- Scenic Videos 
With thousands of real-life videos, explore the best world stages. You'll be able to experience both scenic routes and exotic landscapes, or even test your skills on challenging courses. 
- Coaching videos 
Follow the advice of our community of coaches and train on their training programs to progress. 
- Structured workout 
Reach your goals by customizing your own sessions or by choosing the sessions suggested by Kinomap and the community. 
- Map Mode 
Train on your own GPS tracks or any public track. 
- Free ride
Keep track of your sessions because Kinomap records your activity directly from the connected console. 
- Multiplayer 
Challenge live your friends or the other users on the app. Schedule your private sessions with your followers or join public sessions.
WHY CHOOSING KINOMAP?
- Over 70,000 videos to train with an average of 30 to 40 new videos uploaded every day
- Compatible with any equipment
- The most realistic indoor cycling, running and rowing simulator that almost makes you forget you're training from home
- 5 training modes to reach your goals and desires
- Suitable for everyone: cyclists, triathletes, runners, fitness or weight loss
- Free and unlimited version
OTHER FEATURES
- Synchronize your Kinomap activities with our app partners like Strava or adidas Running.
- The app is optimized for iPhone and iPad. It is possible to display the videos on an external screen with an Apple TV or an HDMI adapter. A remote display is also possible from a web browser from the page https://remote.kinomap.com.
- Kinomap is compatible with the Apple Watch to receive heart rate data.
UNLIMITED ACCESS
The Kinomap application now offers a free version, with no time or usage limitation. The Premium version is available from 11,99€/month or 89,99€/year. The subscription is automatically renewed, unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
APPLE HEALTH
Record your data activity in Apple Health, such as distance, heart rate and calories.
COMPATIBILITY
Kinomap is compatible with over 220 brands of machines and 2500 models. Visit https://www.kinomap.com/compatibility to check compatibility. Your equipment is not connected? Use a Bluetooth/ANT+ sensor (power, speed/cadence) or the optical sensor of your smartphone or tablet; it detects the movement and simulates the cadence.
Find the conditions of use on: https://www.kinomap.com/terms
Confidentiality: https://www.kinomap.com/privacy
A problem? Please contact our support team at support@kinomap.com.
Do not hesitate to share your suggestions for improvement, requests for new features or questions.

bluejetty:00073521:ios.name: Hotels.com: Book Hotel Deals
bluejetty:00073521:ios.summary: Hotels.com® is a hotel booking app for finding and reserving hotels worldwide—from city-center rooms and beach resorts to budget motels and luxury stays. Members save up to 20% instantly with Member Prices* and earn rewards** for future tri
bluejetty:00073521:ios.description:
Hotels.com® is a hotel booking app for finding and reserving hotels worldwide—from city-center rooms and beach resorts to budget motels and luxury stays. Members save up to 20% instantly with Member Prices* and earn rewards** for future trips. Search, compare, and reserve your stay in a few taps.
WHY TRAVELERS CHOOSE HOTELS.COM
- Over 500,000 properties worldwide, from budget rooms to 5-star and luxury stays
- Earn rewards on every stay, use them like cash, no blackout dates
- Compare places side by side in the app and get alerts when prices drop
- Book work trips faster with your saved business travel preferences
- The price you see is the price you pay—no hidden fees, plus free cancellation on most hotels***
SAVE WITH MEMBER PRICES AND EARN REWARDS
Become a member for free and save up to 20% instantly on select hotels with Member Prices. Then earn rewards on every eligible booking and use them like cash toward your next stay—with no blackout dates. Plus, unlock mobile-exclusive deals in the app.
FIND YOUR KIND OF STAY
Browse over 500,000 properties worldwide and find the right room for your trip, whether you want a place tonight, a weekend getaway, or an extended stay. Whatever the trip calls for, find it here: resorts and all-inclusive resorts, boutique hotels, bed and breakfasts, city hotels, budget motels, and luxury stays—with hotel deals for every kind of trip.
BUSINESS TRAVEL ON HOTELS.COM
Traveling for work? Create a business profile once and save your must-have preferences, from fully refundable stays and Wi-Fi to breakfast, star ratings, and guest ratings. Every time you select "business trip," we show work-ready stays with reviews from fellow business travelers.
- Earn rewards on eligible work stays and use them on future trips
- Keep your work and leisure travel together in one account
LAST-MINUTE DEALS & FLEXIBLE BOOKING
Need a room tonight? Find last-minute deals and reserve a place for tonight, this weekend, or months ahead. If your plans change, cancel for free on most hotels. Reserve now and pay later at many places, and change or cancel your reservation right in the app.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN THE APP
- See prices, guest ratings, and amenities for different places side by side
- Search and filter by price, location, guest rating, and amenities, and see every stay on a map with verified guest reviews
- Set price alerts on rooms you're watching and get notified when prices drop
- Use Trip Planner to save your favorite hotels and resorts and share them with friends and family
- Access your booking details anytime—even offline—and contact us or the hotel directly from the app
Download Hotels.com to find and reserve your next room.
In short: Hotels.com is the hotel booking app to find, compare, and reserve hotels and rooms worldwide for leisure and work trips, save instantly with Member Prices, and earn rewards for future trips.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
*Member Prices are available on select hotels to logged-in members and app users. Savings vary by membership tier; up to 20% requires Gold or Platinum status. The discount will be applied to the price of select hotels (excluding applicable taxes and other fees). Subject to terms and conditions, see site for details.
**Rewards are not redeemable for cash and can only be used on eligible bookings.
***Free cancellation on most hotels; some hotels require you to cancel 24–48 hours before check-in. See property pages on our app for details.
The Hotels.com app uses information for analytics, personalization, and advertising.

Become a US army transporter in an all new addition of army transport games which is an ultimate combination of army plane flying from cargo plane games and intense army mission from army games. In this army simulator, your army base is attacked by enemy military troops unlike other military games. You will drive multiple US army vehicles including army truck, military tanks, missile truck, army planes and cruise ship with the target of saving your military base. Combining the thrill of us army games with the skill of truck driving from army truck games, this army transporter game takes us army transport to a completely different level. Leave no army mission unsolved in this time sensitive military simulator. Very realistic army base environment, along with challenging us army transporter duties makes the army transport simulator in which you have to compete with the challenges of army games. 
So get ready for real army mission in this version of army transport games. Challenge yourself and strategize your army transportation. US Military Transport Games 3d lets you plan all your army troops’ movement but saving your forces from enemy airstrikes and attacks is your responsibility. In this army transport simulator, load your missile truck and army tanks into the cargo plane and transport them to a secret army base. Steer your cruise ship to safe harbors as well. As a US army transporter, take your military troops to the secret island as well. If you like playing cargo plane games and army truck games, you would love army transporter game. Enemies might come in military helicopters as well but you will have the ammunition to shoot them with your army plane, unlike any other army games. Defend your military base and become a hero in this us army simulator. The missile truck and carrier ship that you get in this game are one of its kind and the military tank and army plane shooting with all military might will make you fall in love with this army game.
Add to your portfolio of us army games with this unique military simulator. You might have played many army truck games but this addition to cargo plane games will engage you to battle in out in every army mission. Become a real US army transporter by completing all levels of this army transport simulator. Have a real experience of army action in this transport game. So what are you waiting for? Enjoy this mil

bluejetty:00159370:ios.summary:

Instead of turning off Wi-Fi or mobile data for everything, LetMeBe lets you choose which apps
bluejetty:00159370:ios.description:
LetMeBe is an app blocker that helps you stay focused by blocking internet access for distracting apps without disconnecting your entire iPhone.
Instead of turning off Wi-Fi or mobile data for everything, LetMeBe lets you choose which apps should lose network access when you need to focus. It is built for people who want a cleaner way to reduce distractions from social media, chat apps, and other time-consuming services while still keeping the rest of the device connected.
LetMeBe helps you:
- Block distracting apps from accessing the internet
- Add custom IP and host blocking rules
- Stay focused without disabling all internet on your phone
- Keep blocked apps available offline
- Update blocking rules directly from the app
Whether you want to block social media during work, reduce interruptions while reading, or make messaging apps less available during focus time, LetMeBe gives you more control over when apps can connect.
Why people use LetMeBe:
- Productivity and focus sessions
- Reducing social media distractions
- Limiting messaging app access
- Blocking app connectivity without airplane mode
- Custom network blocking with IP and host rules
LetMeBe uses an on-device VPN profile so iOS can apply your selected blocking rules. It blocks network access for the apps and custom rules you choose. It does not disable the entire device connection, and blocked apps can still be opened offline.
If you want more control, premium plans unlock blocking for multiple apps at the same time, more custom IP and host rules, and unlimited daily blocking toggles.
For more information, please visit:
Terms of Use: https://letmebe.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://letmebe.app/privacy

- Create PDF documents from many file types, including: DOC, XLS,
bluejetty:00128948:ios.description:
Power PDF is a powerful tool to create, secure and view PDF documents on iPad/iPhone. 
Power PDF lets you create PDF documents on your iPhone/iPad with ease. It supports: 
- Create PDF documents from many file types, including: DOC, XLS, PPT, TXT, RTF, XML, HTML and all text files. 
- Convert photos to a PDF document. 
- Scan to a PDF document using your Camera. 
Power PDF lets you modify PDF documents on your iPhone/iPad with ease. It supports: 
- Combine PDF documents. 
- Split a PDF document into two or more documents. 
- Delete pages in a PDF document. 
- Re-arrange pages in a PDF document.
- Add password protection to a PDF document. 
Power PDF lets you view PDF documents with ease. It supports: 
- View PDF documents in thumbnail or full screen modes. 
- Extract text from a PDF document. 
- Add bookmarks on a PDF document. 
- Search within a PDF document. 
- Fast Navigate within a PDF document. 
- Zooms in/Zooms out on a PDF document. 
- Annotate in a PDF document.
Power PDF also has a File Manager, which supports the following features: 
- Import files from your Camera Roll, Email or another App through “Open In”. 
- Manage Files including: rename, delete, move, create folder and sort. 
- Search file name in Local Files and Camera Roll. 
- Open many document types, including: DOC, EXCEL, PPT, TXT, image files, and audio files. 
With its simple interfaces, Power PDF provides the easiest way to manage PDF documents on iPhone and iPad. 
If you have more questions, please visit: http://www.comcsoft.com/Portfolio/our_apps/PowerPDF/PowerPDF_overview.php.

bluejetty:00041240:ios.description:
Create AI Videos and Images for Marketing, Stories & Design
Pollo AI is an all-in-one creative app for marketers, online sellers, small businesses, and creators. It brings an AI video generator, AI image generator, AI ad maker, and built-in design tools together in one place.
Turn ideas, scripts, photos, product images, URLs, or reference videos into polished, publish-ready content for ads, social media, online stores, and creative projects.
AI MARKETING & E-COMMERCE
Create professional marketing content without filming, complex editing, or a full production team.
• AI video ads for social media and paid campaigns
• UGC ads, testimonial videos, and product reviews
• Product demos, product showcases, and unboxing videos
• Virtual try-on and product-in-use videos
• Brand stories, promotional videos, and campaign creatives
• Multiple hooks, angles, and ad variations for testing
• Product photos, posters, banners, and store visuals
• Background removal for clean product images
STORY VIDEOS & CREATIVE CONTENT
Bring characters, stories, and original ideas to life with AI.
• AI story videos and cinematic short films
• AI music videos, anime videos, and stylized content
• TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
• Character-driven scenes and visually consistent stories
• Multi-scene videos with cinematic motion and audio
• Reference-based videos and creative remixes
• Video effects, transformations, and viral templates
FROM IDEA TO PUBLISH-READY CONTENT
Pollo AI goes beyond generating individual AI clips.
• AI Agent: Turn a simple brief into a complete video with a compelling hook, clear script, and cohesive scenes
• 200+ AI Apps: Explore guided workflows for ads, product contents, stories, images, and videos
• Clone & Remix: Recreate a reference video’s structure and style with your own content
• Create for Every Format: Make vertical, square, or landscape content for social media, ads, and online stores
AI VIDEO GENERATOR
Create videos using:
• Text to video 
• Image to video 
• Reference to video 
• Video to video 
• Frames to video 
• AI avatars and voices 
• Video effects and motion tools
AI IMAGE GENERATOR & DESIGN TOOLS
Create and refine visuals using:
• Text to image 
• Image to image 
• AI posters and promotional graphics 
• Product photography and marketing images 
• AI photo editor and image enhancer 
• Image upscaler 
• Background remover
LEADING AI MODELS IN ONE APP
Access a growing collection of AI video and image models, including Pollo, Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, Kling, Wan, Hailuo, Vidu, PixVerse, Luma, Pika, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, Seedream, Flux, Midjourney, Ideogram, Recraft, and more.
Choose the right model for cinematic storytelling, realistic motion, native audio, consistent characters, accurate text, product photography, posters, and professional design.
BUILT FOR
• Small business owners and online sellers
• Performance marketers and social media managers
• E-commerce brands and agencies
• Filmmakers, designers, and storytellers
• Influencers, freelancers, and content teams
Launch products, promote services, produce paid ads, create organic social content, bring original stories to life, and explore new creative possibilities with Pollo AI.
Create your next ad, product video, story, poster, or social post with Pollo AI.

bluejetty:00115722:ios.description:
Mecharashi Version 2.4 [Chasing Illusions]: Now Live!
"Mecharashi is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game.
The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle. When any part of a mecha is destroyed, its battle efficiency will diminish significantly. By focusing attacks on the most critical enemy parts, you can gain a clear strategic advantage.
As a mecha commander, your task is to achieve victory through strategic insight and journey through a world shaped by war, where profound stories of dire conflict and unassailable hope are born!"
The Most Visually Stunning Mobile Mecha Game to Date
The game is designed to meet the highest standards for mobile platforms. Every detail, from the design of each environment to the mecha models, is designed with a serious, realistic approach for maximum visual expression.
Story Stages Combining Engaging Narratives and Tough Challenges
Surrounded by the immersive environments of Milkhama, players command a mercenary unit, exploring the world and shaking up the political machinations behind the scenes, becoming key players in a story that will shape history.
Build and Customize Your Mecha Squad
On Milkhama Island, countless mecha factories vie for supremacy, leading to the creation of classic mechas with diverse designs and performance features, along with an array of corresponding weapons. You can customize the bodies, arms, legs, and weapons of your mechas to form a mecha squad tailored to each battle's needs, then outfit them with elite pilots, each boasting a unique personality and backstory. You can also customize the paintwork of your mechas and weapons down to the finest details, with over 120 free colors available by default.
Revolutionary Turn-Based "Part Destruction" Gameplay
The hit points of different mecha parts are calculated separately in battle, allowing for individual part destruction. This feature opens the doors to a world of infinite strategic possibilities. Destroying the torso, the part with the highest hit points, will directly neutralize the target, while breaking the arms or legs will impair weapons and mobility. Your every choice must be considered in advance, based on the current situation on the battlefield.

bluejetty:00159283:ios.summary: **AMERICAN REGISTRY OF RADIOLOGIC TECHNOLIGISTS® and ARRT® are registered trademarks owned by The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists. This app is not licensed by, endorsed by, or affiliated with The American Registry of Radiologi
bluejetty:00159283:ios.description:
**AMERICAN REGISTRY OF RADIOLOGIC TECHNOLIGISTS® and ARRT® are registered trademarks owned by The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists. This app is not licensed by, endorsed by, or affiliated with The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists.**
If your goal is to become a Computed tomography (CT) technologist, you need to earn American registry of radiologic technologist® (ARRT®) credentials in Computed Tomography (CT). The purpose of ARRT® certification and registration in CT is to recognize individuals who are qualified to perform the role of CT technologist. The education requirements to earn the credential to become a CT technologist include being ARRT® certified, meeting the structured education requirement, and meeting the clinical experience. In the structure education requirement is where an applicant will master the discipline specific knowledge and cognitive skills you will need to obtain your credential. This app will help you to strength your foundation by testing your knowledge with over 900 questions in the ARRT® registry format.
The ARRT® examination content consists of 165 question base in four major categories such as patient care, safety, image production, and procedures. In addition, to 20 unscored (pilot) questions. The ARRT® scoring scale range from 1 to 99, and you’ll need a total score of 75 to pass the exam.
Features:
A test section to test your knowledge in a random order, as similar as possible to the ARRT® examination. It allows user to know if the correct answer was selected and if not a pop-up button will appear with access to the correct answer's explanation.
A notes section to allow you to study and prepare for the test. The different note’s categories allow you to study the area where you feel you need to strength your foundation.
A Review Test question that allow user to go back and review the last test they took in each category to review the test.
An All Question Section that allows the user to see all the questions with the answers. The questions can be adjusted by content category as listed in the ARRT®. 
A Statistics section that help the user to keep track of all the statistics such as general score, number of questions taken, number of tests taken, and much more.
A protocols section that allows user to see a step by step guideline in how to perform the different types of protocols that are regularly done in a clinical setting.
If you have any question or concern, please feel free to contact me via edunorth07@gmail.com, to find the best solution possible.
I want to take this line to thank each of you that chooses to use my app, please take a moment to review the app and to let me know in which areas I can make any improvements. Thanks in advance for all the reviews and ideas of improvement. If you really like the app and you feel the app really help you to become a CT technologist, I will be more than happy and my goal will be achieved. Please feel free to share the app with family and friend so they can use it if they are getting ready for the CT examination.
Email me via edunorth07@gmail.com if you have any question or ideas you like to see included.

bluejetty:00128985:ios.description:
Welcome to the supermarket. It's time to go shopping and fill the basket with delicious food and various interesting things. Such store games is a great way to have fun. Do you like animal games? Then you will become an assistant for animals and accompany them during all purchases.
Our supermarket has many departments: grocery, toy and clothing stores. There is even a cafe and an amusement park. In the grocery store, you will need a shopping basket, in which you must put everything you need according to the list. In the toys store, you will have the opportunity to put together puzzles for children and buy many interesting things. Of course, for all purchases made in stores, you will need to pay at the cash register. You can have even more fun in a cafe and in an amusement park. In the cafe, you will have the opportunity to prepare orders for visitors yourself. For example, a cake for the New Year or Christmas. In the amusement park, fun games are waiting for you on attractions.
So don't waste time, come to our supermarket and have fun to your heart's content.
And for the parents of our young users, we would like to note that such children's supermarket games will allow your child to learn such an important event in adult life as going to the store to make purchases and gain new knowledge. Also, toddler games can not only entertain a child, but also teach him to make decisions.
P.S. We will be very thankful if after playing the game you leave reviews with your ideas and recommendations regarding the game. It will help us to make our games better and to create interesting content for you.

bluejetty:00063153:ios.name: CLZ Games: collection database
bluejetty:00063153:ios.summary:
Easily catalog your video game collection, your gaming hardware and Toys-to-life figures (amiibo, Skylanders, etc..).
Just scan barcodes or search our CLZ Core online game database by platform and title. Automatic game details, cover art an
bluejetty:00063153:ios.description:
Easily catalog your video game collection, your gaming hardware and Toys-to-life figures (amiibo, Skylanders, etc..).
Just scan barcodes or search our CLZ Core online game database by platform and title. Automatic game details, cover art and up-to-date game values from PriceCharting.
CLZ Games is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
== Two easy ways to catalog games: == 
1. Scan game barcodes with the built-in camera scanner. Guaranteed 99% success rate.
2. Find games by title and platform, then select the edition you own.
For amiibo, scan their NFC code with your phone.
Our CLZ Core online video game database will automatically provide cover art and full game details, like release dates, publishers, developers, descriptions, trailer videos, etc... including automatic game pricing from PriceCharting (updated daily!).
== Edit all fields ==
Edit all automatically provided details from CLZ Core, like titles, release Dates, publisher/developer details, descriptions, etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). Add personal details like completeness, condition, location, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc.. 
Create your own Custom Fields so that you can catalog information for which the app does not have a built-in data field.
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate physical from digital games, to keep track of games you sold or have for sale, etc... 
== Fully customizable ==
Browse your game inventory as a list with small thumbnails or as cards with big images.
Sort any way you want, e.g. by title, release date, date added , or group games into folders by platform, completeness (loose / CIB / New), genre, etc...
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
Sync your data to the CLZ Cloud, to:
* Always have an online backup of your game organizer database.
* Sync your game library between multiple devices
* View and share your game collection online
== Got a question or need help? ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "Club CLZ forum" from the menu.
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. We're always working to bring you regular updates for the apps and software, and to keep our Core online databases up-to-date with all weekly releases.
Our other CLZ apps:
* CLZ Movies, for cataloging your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
* CLZ Books, for organizing your book collection by ISBN
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Comics, for your collection of US comic books.

bluejetty:00027076:ios.description:
This application is designed to provide up to date information about bush fire data in Victoria, Australia for iPhone, iPad and iPod users.
It utilises data from the Victorian Country Fire Authority/Victorian Department of Sustainability data feeds on fires, wind data from the Bureau of Meteorology with your current location provided by the iPhone GPS.
Using this information the application is able to provide a list of fires showing the nearest ones first, helping you to understand your current situation.
The information is reliant on both the accuracy of the iPhone GPS and the data recorded on the CFA's website. 
This application does not cache any data, so Internet access (either Wireless. 3G or GPRS) is required to access the data. 
We have enabled this application for the iPod Touch as well, but note that the GPS location and therefore distance from the fire may be unreliable.
Be aware that while P4G has utilised "best efforts" to provide this information to you, it is not intended to replace other sources of information on the fire situation near you. Also remember that fire and weather can change quickly.
All data is provided Copyright from the Victorian Country Fire Authority and the Victorian Department of Sustainability.
Follow P4G on twitter at P4G_Apps

bluejetty:00024749:ios.description:
"Don't be fooled, these simple questions can captivate you until your brain is humming. Decide if your skill is numerical, verbal or spatial." - The Telegraph 
"The Most Comprehensive IQ Test on the App Store."
Included in "500 Mus Have Apps".
Improve your IQ with this innovative app.
In addition to measuring your general IQ, our exclusive test assesses your performance in 13 different areas of intelligence, revealing your key cognizant strengths and weaknesses.  These areas are:
 Analogy
 Blood Relationship
 Classification
 Coding - Decoding
 Direction Sense
 Logical Reasoning
 Mathematical Operations
 Number, Ranking and Sequence
 Pattern Recognition
 Series
 Statement & Conclusions
 Venn Diagrams
 Visualization
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Check out Full Version with 930 test questions
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
TEST RESULTS WITH EXPLANATION:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
A summary of the test is presented at the end of each test. It shows you the time you took, the score, which questions you answered correctly and where you were wrong, explanation for almost every question. 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
PROGRESS METER:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
The app records your progress as you start practicing different areas of intelligence. 
It shows you a beautifully animated bar chart so that you can track your weak areas and retry the questions you answered incorrectly.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
VERY EASY TO USE:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
The sleek user interface allows you to choose from possible answers. 
You don't need to press too many buttons or encounter any alert messages. 
The app is very interactive and needs minimum user input. Innovative use of iPhone's small screen real estate.
~~~~~~~~~~~
FEATURE LIST:
~~~~~~~~~~~
• Choose number of questions you would like in each test.
• Beautiful pie chart and bar chart keeps track of how you are performing in a particular topic, and retry the questions you answered incorrectly.
• Choose your own timer settings.
• Cool sound effects. (You can turn them off if desired.)
• Special algorithm that randomizes questions every time you take a test.
* Privacy Policy: http://www.webrichsoftware.com/privacy.html
* EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Ever thought that office drones are destined for a monotonous life? Think again! 
Or that a disheartened young person can't make a dramatic move right where they stand? You're wrong!
A mysterious spaceship crash-lands in the city, triggering a catastrophic event. The city's inhabitants are infected, transforming into round-headed zombies that wreak havoc everywhere.

- Immerse yourself in the excitement of battling zombies with straightforward and easy controls. Enjoy the adrenaline as you face continuous challenges to stay alive.
- Discover and activate a variety of new items. These enhancements will bolster your combat capabilities, helping you fend off relentless zombie waves.
- Develop your own characters, craft distinctive equipment, and prepare to tackle increasingly difficult challenges.
- Engage in diverse levels and confront formidable bosses. As you progress, unlock hidden secrets and piece together the story behind this apocalyptic world.

General Ed Diploma Test 2026 not only helps you gain insight into conc
bluejetty:00178067:ios.description:
General Ed Diploma Test 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the High School Equivalency (HSE) Diploma test with a high score on your first attempt.
General Ed Diploma Test 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to the high school equivalency diploma test, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing thousands of questions similar to those on the actual exam.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In General Ed Diploma Test 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by test experts that cover the scope of the high school equivalency diploma test requirements. Depending on the exam requirements, you will need to master 4 subjects, each containing 3-4 subdivided content areas. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
### Key Features ###
- Over 2,000 questions to practice, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized exercises by content area with the flexibility to switch at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the high school equivalency diploma test is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the test. You will find that each time you practice on General Ed Diploma Test 2026, your knowledge of the test increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high on not only the high school equivalency diploma test, but any other test!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Privacy-Policy/
Disclaimer:
GED® is a registered trademark owned by GED Testing Service. This product is not approved or endorsed by them.
Note: This app is not affiliated with any government entity.

bluejetty:00134260:ios.name: Blitzkrieg Fire
bluejetty:00134260:ios.summary: Blitzkrieg Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in the European and North African theaters of World War II. Take command of the land, air, and naval forces of Britain, Germany, the USSR, the United States, Italy, France, Poland, Finla
bluejetty:00134260:ios.description:
Blitzkrieg Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in the European and North African theaters of World War II. Take command of the land, air, and naval forces of Britain, Germany, the USSR, the United States, Italy, France, Poland, Finland, Romania, and many other nations in the largest conflict in history.
Experience the entire war through 20 historically accurate campaigns, from the Spanish Civil War to the downfall of Germany. Command squadrons of more than 350 types of aircraft, from iconic warbirds like the Spitfire and Bf 109 to less well-known types like the Soviet I-16 and Polish P.24. Control the seas with more than 250 types of warships including submarines, battleships and aircraft carriers. 
Blitzkrieg Fire is powered by a detailed and realistic simulation of WW2 air, naval, and ground combat. Fight against an intelligent AI which constantly adapts its strategy to ensure every game is challenging and unique. Challenge a friend in hotseat multiplayer (pass-and-play).
Blitzkrieg Fire contains no in-app purchases or ads of any kind, and an internet connection is not required to play. Buy the game once and get access to all current and future content. 
The game features 20 campaigns, including:
- Blitzkrieg Fire: Fight the whole of WW2 month-by-month on a map spanning from the United States to the Ural Mountains.
- Invasion of Poland: Lead German or Polish forces in the opening acts of WWII.
- Battle of Britain: Defend the cities of Great Britain from the Luftwaffe onslaught.
- Operation Barbarossa: Command millions of German or Soviet troops in the largest invasion in history.
- Western Desert: Lead the infamous 'Afrika Korps' or 'Desert Rats' in the legendary campaign for North Africa.
- Operation Overlord: Command a massive Allied invasion of Fortress Europe.

bluejetty:00153444:ios.description:
First Team Manager: Season 26 (FTM26)
Step Into the Dugout and Lead Your Team to Glory
Welcome to First Team Manager.
Have you ever dreamed of managing your favourite soccer club, crafting the perfect squad, and leading them to victory on the grandest stages? Now’s your chance. First Team Manager (FTM26) is the ultimate soccer management mobile game that puts you, the manager, at the heart of the action. Take control of real football clubs and experience the thrill, strategy, and drama of managing a soccer club.
Designed for soccer enthusiasts and strategy lovers alike, this mobile game combines realism, depth, and accessibility to deliver the most immersive managerial experience ever.
From taking training and setting match-day tactics to recruiting players and dealing with the press, First Team Manager gives you total control. Whether you’re starting with an underdog team or a powerhouse club, every decision is yours to make, and every success is yours to claim.
Key Features
1. Manage Real Soccer Clubs
Choose from a wide array of real-world football clubs across leagues and nations. Whether you want to restore glory to a fallen giant or build a dynasty with a small club, the choice is yours.
2. Realistic Gameplay
FTM26 has an advanced simulation engine that ensures every match feels authentic, with tactics, player form, and opposition strategies all influencing the outcome. Watch highlights of key moments or match commentary to see how your decisions play out on the pitch.
3. Build Your Dream Squad in FTM26

bluejetty:00040565:ios.description:
Twig - The shared journal for couples.
Social media is too public and scrapbooking is too hard - share your memories with your partner in one place, just for the two of you. Each memory has a place for you to upload photos and each add a note about your special moment. 
Twig makes it easy to document even the smallest of sweet moments. Plus, it's completely free. 
The story behind Twig:
Both my fiancé Kassidy and I have gifted each other various forms of scrapbooks. While that definitely has its place, we wanted something that could be used any time something special happened. So I set out to make this app. Now we've got a rolling memory of all sorts of special moments we've shared! 
I hope it's just as useful for you as it has been for us. 
Enjoy!

bluejetty:00200098:ios.name: KidHub by Unleashed Brands
bluejetty:00200098:ios.summary: KidHub brings your family's favorite experiences from Unleashed Brands together in one app. Discover, book, and track activities at The Little Gym, Urban Air Adventure Park, Snapology, Sylvan Learning, Water Wings, Class 101, and Premier Ma
bluejetty:00200098:ios.description:
KidHub brings your family's favorite experiences from Unleashed Brands together in one app. Discover, book, and track activities at The Little Gym, Urban Air Adventure Park, Snapology, Sylvan Learning, Water Wings, Class 101, and Premier Martial Arts, all from your phone. 
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH KIDHUB 
Browse and book activities near you 
Find nearby classes, camps, birthday parties, and open play sessions across all of our locations. Search by activity, location, or your child's interests. 
Manage your family's schedule 
Keep track of classes and events in one calendar, across all of our brands. Sync to your phone's calendar and share with friends so everyone knows what's next. 
Track skills and milestones 
Watch your kids grow with skill-tracking, class history, and special milestones for every child in your family, each with their own unique profile. 
Capture and celebrate moments 
Get photos and videos of your kids in class, at events, and at the park. Highlights from instructors come right to your phone. 
Smart check-in
Enjoy faster check-in so you can get to the good stuff sooner at many of our locations. 
Discover what's next 
Explore activities perfect for your kids — recommended based on their ages, interests, and what's near you. As your kids grow and explore more, KidHub adjusts recommendations to meet their evolving needs and goals. 
WHO IT'S FOR 
KidHub is built for parents and caregivers balancing hectic family schedules with multiple child-enrichment activities. Whether you're booking a birthday party at Urban Air or The Little Gym, scheduling a tutoring session at Class 101, or signing up for a Snapology robotics class, KidHub keeps it all together. 
PART OF THE UNLEASHED FAMILY OF BRANDS 
Urban Air Adventure Park, Snapology, The Little Gym, Class 101, Sylvan, Premier Martial Arts, and Water Wings. 
PRIVACY & SAFETY FOR FAMILIES 
KidHub is built with families in mind. Your information is encrypted in transit. We do not sell data to advertisers. Parents have full control over photos, profiles, and data — including the ability to request deletion at any time. 
QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK? 
Visit our support page or email us — we'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00134332:ios.description:
Track your local forecast for the Atlanta area quickly with the free FOX 5 Weather app. The improved design gives you radar, hourly and seven day weather information just by scrolling. Our weather alerts will warn you early and help to keep your and your family safe during severe weather. 
Why download the FOX 5 Team Weather Radar app? 
 • Get your current forecasts at a glance, with fully integrated GPS to 
 give you accurate conditions wherever you are located. 
 • Receive severe storm alerts from the National Weather Service so 
 you and your family can stay safe.
 • Get school closing information quickly.
 • Interactive radar map includes the past hour of a storm's 
 movement and future radar to see where severe weather is headed. 
 Regional lightning data and high resolution satellite cloud imagery 
 are also included. Radar is optimized for in-network and WiFi 
 performance.
 • Daily and Hourly forecasts update from our computer models. 
 • Add and save your favorite locations, anywhere in the world.
 • Video forecasts and live streaming from the FOX 5 Storm Team 
 Weather Center, so you can stay informed even during power 
 outages. 
 • Live traffic map for the greater Atlanta area.
 • Share you weather photos and videos easily with FOX 5. Look for 
 them on during the news on TV!

bluejetty:00005933:android.name: Children motivation – kids 24
