bluejetty:00005933:android.description:
The Kids 24 application is based on a well-known and appreciated reward system that you personally define (for example, going to the cinema). Rewards are to shape the right attitude. It is worth remembering that rewards are more effective than punishment. If you need parental control over your child's behavior, you've come to the right place.
It all consists of 3 simple steps:
1. First, you need to create people who will participate in the schedule.
(Tests have shown that children also need a role model, so it is recommended to include parents in the schedule)
2. Then create a schedule, specifying the number of days, the number of possible bad behaviors in the entire schedule and describe the reward.
(For younger children, it is recommended to create a schedule no longer than 7 days, because it is known that younger children are impatient)
3. Now it is enough to start adding good or bad signs to the schedule (for good behavior of the kid we put a sun sign, for bad behavior of the child we put a cloud sign) until the last day, and then finish the schedule. You will see who received and who did not receive a reward. Parents should explain well to their kids why they are receiving a reward. Finally, of course, we start a new schedule.
The Kids 24 app is simple and intuitive so that all users know why they received or did not receive a reward. Motivation is very important. If a kids does not have the right motivation, it means that the reward was chosen incorrectly. If the reward is chosen correctly, you will notice that the kids motivation will increase.
For every good behavior, the kids receives a sun sign, and for every bad behavior, the child receives a storm cloud sign (Behavior signs can be changed). If the child does not exceed the set number of bad behaviors after all the days have passed, they will receive the designated reward (the reward is set by the parent). Parental control is very important in terms of a kids behavior.
When the child or parent wins the first reward, they will understand that it is worth being good. If the child exceeds the allowed number of bad behaviors and loses motivation, you can end the schedule early and start over from the beginning or set a new threshold of possible bad behaviors to keep the kids motivated. It is a good practice to give a lot of good signs which helps with motivation. Parental control over the child's behavior will make the children know what he should do and what he should not do. However, parental controls should not be abused.
The Kids 24 app is also great for household chores. For each household chore performed, the child can receive a sun sign, for not performing a household chore, they can receive a cloud sign. The child will have the appropriate motivation to perform household chores as well as school chores.
But that's not all, the app also has a ton of features, such as:
• Viewing behavior change statistics
• Posting your own photos for the created personas
• Changing the appearance of good and bad signs from the gallery or a photo taken directly from the camera
• Changing the color of the entire app
• You can send us a question if something is unclear
• Instructions to make it easier to use the app
The app allows parents to see what progress their children has made. If you are looking for parental control app and want to improve your child's behavior, this app is for you.

bluejetty:00077247:ios.summary: Mixbook is a photo book app, rated #1 by Wirecutter and Digital Camera World, that turns the photos on your iPhone into curated Stories and prints them as premium photo books, photo albums, and magazines-style books. Every Story can also be
bluejetty:00077247:ios.description:
Mixbook is a photo book app, rated #1 by Wirecutter and Digital Camera World, that turns the photos on your iPhone into curated Stories and prints them as premium photo books, photo albums, and magazines-style books. Every Story can also become a digital creation you can share — a movie, a digital magazine, or Memory Art, Mixbook's custom AI art generated from the memory itself, pulling in the details that matter.
Mixbook is the easiest and fastest way to make a photo book from your iPhone. Your camera roll is organized into Stories, each with a narrative you can edit, so the print or digital creations start from the context of your memory.
THE #1-RATED PHOTO BOOK APP
Wirecutter named Mixbook the best online photo book service after building 23 books and reviewing them with a master printer. In fact, Mixbook has been Wirecutter's #1 book six years running (2021-2026). Digital Camera World named Mixbook the best photo book app. Tom's Guide ranked it a top overall pick. Rated 4.8 stars on the App Store and trusted by millions of customers.
AI PHOTO BOOKS FROM YOUR CAMERA ROLL
The new Mixbook introduces Stories, a first for photo book apps. AI organizes your iPhone photos into curated memories, and each arrives with a narrative you can rewrite, reorder, or personalize: the moment, told the way you'd tell it. Your photo book is built from that narrative, around what happened, not just what the photos look like. Built on Story Mode's patent-pending memory understanding and a layout engine made for print, and every page stays fully editable.
PHOTO BOOKS FOR EVERY OCCASION 
Vacation and travel photo books. Wedding albums. Baby books and family milestones. Holiday photo books and year-in-review albums. Choose from 700+ designer templates, eight sizes, and softcover, hardcover, and layflat styles, with up to 399 pages, double what most photo book apps allow.
PREMIUM PRINT QUALITY
Premium semi-gloss, matte, and lustre papers. Layflat binding for panoramic spreads. PUR binding, stronger and more flexible than the glue most budget photo book services use. Every book is backed by Mixbook's Happiness Guarantee.
MEMORY ART, MOVIES, AND MAGAZINES 
Every photo can become more than a book. Turn your memories into Memory Art, custom AI art drawn from the memory itself, a movie you can share, or even a digital magazine.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
Your photos are yours. LLM vendors are barred from training on customer content. Mixbook is a private alternative to public photo sharing sites.
FREE TO DOWNLOAD 
Make as many photo books as you want. Pay only when you print, from $14.99. Mixbook+ ($9.99/month) unlocks Memory Art, movies, and digital magazines in full, with no watermarks on shares or downloads.
COMMON QUESTIONS 
What is the best photo book app for iPhone? 
Mixbook. Wirecutter named it the best photo book service after testing 23 books, Digital Camera World named it the best photo book app, and it holds a 4.8-star App Store rating.
What is Story Mode? 
Story Mode is Mixbook's AI photo book creator. Answer a few prompts, and it analyzes your photos, gives milestones full-page space, groups supporting moments, writes the narrative, and returns a print-ready photo book you can order or edit. Free to use. "Beautiful books in record time." (customer review)
Can AI make a good photo book? 
Yes, when it understands the memory, not just the photos. Mixbook's AI runs on a patent-pending memory understanding model that recognizes the people, places, and moments that matter, builds the book around them, and keeps every page editable, unlike fully automated apps. "You can customize and modify the auto-generated book. The best of both worlds." (customer review)
TERMS OF USE (EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040347:ios.summary:
Mini Kitchen Chef – Cooking Simulation & Time Management Game
Step into Mini Kitchen Chef, the ultimate casual cooking simulation game featuring frying, baking, and sushi making. Perfect for cooking game enthusiasts, this addictive time-ma
bluejetty:00040347:ios.description:
Mini Kitchen Chef – Cooking Simulation & Time Management Game
Step into Mini Kitchen Chef, the ultimate casual cooking simulation game featuring frying, baking, and sushi making. Perfect for cooking game enthusiasts, this addictive time-management game offers engaging gameplay with intuitive cooking mechanics, restaurant management challenges, and immersive casual simulation elements.
Master Your Cooking Skills
Begin your culinary journey by slicing tomatoes, frying meat, boiling pasta, and quickly progress to advanced tasks. Expand your restaurant empire by unlocking diverse kitchen types, including a fully equipped Sushi Kitchen. Prepare authentic sushi dishes using premium ingredients like salmon, tuna, avocado, seaweed, rice, and more. Become a culinary master by experimenting with cooking techniques such as grilling, baking, boiling, frying, and crafting visually appealing dishes.
Cook Delicious Recipes
Combine a vast array of ingredients to fulfill customer orders. Bake savory dishes, fry crispy snacks, and roll perfect sushi. Manage your inventory wisely to meet the demands of hungry customers. Unlock many recipes to enhance customer satisfaction and showcase your culinary creativity.
Engaging Mini-Games & Cooking Challenges
Expand your gaming experience with fun and challenging minigames. Solve exciting Match-3 puzzles to win bonus rewards, and test your reflexes with the dynamic Tap-to-Jump game. These minigames provide extra opportunities to earn rewards to upgrade your kitchen and keep your gameplay experience fresh and engaging.
Fast-Paced Time Management Gameplay
Efficiently manage your cooking tasks, ingredient preparation, and restaurant management to quickly fulfill customer orders. Keep your customers satisfied by preventing food from burning and serving meals promptly. Progress through increasingly challenging levels, each designed to test your time-management abilities, strategic planning, and quick thinking.
Why Play Mini Kitchen Chef?
-Addictive casual gameplay perfect for fans of cooking and restaurant games.
-Realistic cooking simulation mechanics including mixing, frying, baking, sushi preparation, and kitchen management.
-Colorful, vibrant 2D graphics appealing to players of all ages.
-Relaxing music and immersive audio effects enhance your cooking experience.
-Fun and rewarding mini-games including Match-3 puzzles and Tap-to-Jump challenges.
-Extensive gameplay with numerous levels, kitchens, recipes, and ingredients.
Collect, Upgrade, and Customize
Earn stars by successfully completing levels and invest them in kitchen upgrades. Unlock powerful kitchen equipment, new utensils, fresh ingredients, and tasty recipes. Customize and expand your cooking spaces to optimize your kitchen’s efficiency and become the ultimate chef in your virtual restaurant.
Key Features:
-Comprehensive casual cooking simulation with multiple kitchens including Sushi Kitchen.
-Exciting mini-games and engaging cooking challenges.
-Strategic time management gameplay focusing on customer orders and restaurant management.
-Many diverse recipes, ingredients, and cooking techniques.
-Extensive gameplay experience tailored for cooking enthusiasts of all skill levels.
Download Mini Kitchen Chef today and start cooking your way to culinary greatness in this exciting time-management and simulation game!

bluejetty:00148355:ios.summary:
EVERYTHING YOU NEED

bluejetty:00148355:ios.description:
EVERYTHING YOU NEED
Pin, archive, add to favourites, or simply mark your notes as unread to visit them one more time. Sort your content into spaces simply using #tags.
AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
All your options, spaces, filters available at a swipe with the gesture perfected to milliseconds after 100+ tests so that you get a flawless experience. Every. Single. Time.
PRACTICALLY MAGIC
The pure joy of bringing words & thoughts to life is what makes writing magical. Unable to write freely, that flow is disturbed. It takes the magic away.
While most apps have a toolbar that makes you choose different options & rest of them support markdown with a syntax that is visible all the time...
Spaces blissfully integrates Markdown & hides all your syntax, as soon as you move your cursor away. It's practically magic!
HOW IS SPACES BETTER
- Automatically hiding Markdown Syntax
- Instant tagging directly using hashtags
- Unlimited Nesting
- Focus Mode
- Marking Current Line
- Archive, Favourites, Pin & Mark to Read
- Reference other notes using [[Brackets]]
- Multiple export options including TXT, MD, Docx, HTML
- Smart toolbar that automatically suggests tags based on your use
- All formatting options placed carefully so that you always find them naturally.
USE SPACES TO
- Capture your thoughts instantly (supports Markdown)
- Writing essays, notes, blog posts & prose (with live word count)
- Adding & keeping track of todos & tasks
- Writing class notes, meeting notes & other important texts
- Jotting down recipes, grocery list, plans & more...
PRIVATE AND SECURE
Spaces is built by a truly independent team of passionate people. 
We use Apple Cloudkit to securely sync your data between your devices. 
We cannot see your notes, tags or any of your other data. 
All your notes are safe and secure.
LOADED WITH GOODNESS
- 15+ Handcrafted Themes with each colour of each theme tested & matched for a beautiful look & ease on your eyes. We even keep adding more themes.
- 25+ Custom App Icons to choose from.
- Multiple Editor Formatting Options for your own personal preference.
Twitter: @SpacesDo
Privacy Policy: https://spaceswriting.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://spaceswriting.com/terms
Made with lots of love by Marvey.

Your Journey. Your Progress.Your Recovery.
The mymobility®app is your digital health companion, bridging the gap between you and your care
team. With step-by-step instructions, exercises, and helpful reminders, you will have a guided
experience before and after a procedure or injury, giving you the support you need to reach your
recovery goals.
mymobility is a personalized way to keep you moving and keep you connected like never before.
With mymobility you can:
• Follow a recovery plan with rehabilitation exercises tailored to your procedure
• Watch helpful videos and read tips to prepare for surgery
• Track your pain levels, range of motion, steps, and milestones
• Receive support from your care team, wherever you are
PLEASE NOTE: You must be enrolled by a participating healthcare provider to use this app.
For technical questions, contact our customer support team via
support@zbmymobilitysolutions.com
Not all patients are candidates for the use of this product and surgeons should evaluate
individually to determine which patients are appropriate for remote care. Patients must have
internet access and a text-capable mobile device or a compatible smartphone to use mymobility;
not all features are available on the web-based version.

Blob is back, and it is mightier than ever!
While Blob uses its arsenal of weaponry, it needs YOU to guide him through the endless waves of evil enemies and become the ultimate blob hero. 
As Blob gains experience through hard fought battles, you decide which skills it learns.
Are you a fan of survival games or warrior games? Even if you only like Blob Runner, you will love Blob’s show stopping survival craft features! From a complete noob to warrior, combine the best skills to destroy enemies and become the conqueror! You can create thousands of unique skill combinations to overcome the challenges and survive each wave of enemies’ attacks.
Forget the other blob games! This time, Blob can shoot Blob Balls! Blob can throw Blob Grenades! Blob can cast Blob Magic like a super wizard! And much more! Any kind of attack is possible with your friendly jelly warrior.
If Blob is out of HP, your blob run will be over. But do not fret! You and your Blob friend can always come back stronger than ever. 
Be the savior that Blob Hero needs!

bluejetty:00063844:ios.name: Paltalk: Live Chat Rooms
bluejetty:00063844:ios.summary:
Paltalk is a global community platform built around live, topic-based chat rooms.
Join thousands of active rooms organized around shared interests such as music, culture, sports, current events, and more. Each room centers on a specific to
bluejetty:00063844:ios.description:
Paltalk is a global community platform built around live, topic-based chat rooms.
Join thousands of active rooms organized around shared interests such as music, culture, sports, current events, and more. Each room centers on a specific topic, creating space for group discussions to grow naturally within a community setting. Take part in live group conversations using video, voice, or text, or simply listen and follow along. You choose how you participate. Paltalk focuses on interest-based rooms and structured community spaces designed for group interaction. Community experience is supported with safety in mind. Chat rooms include active moderators, room management tools, reporting options, and community guidelines to help maintain respectful and welcoming discussions.
With over 20 years of experience in social technology, Paltalk provides a stable and reliable environment for live group communication across desktop and mobile devices.
Download the app and join live community rooms built around your interests.
LIVE COMMUNITY CHAT ROOMS
• International Community vs. Local Flavor. Whether you’re looking to learn a new language, rock out to your favorite song, or examine the social issues in your city elections, Paltalk has a room for you. Explore thousands of active rooms organized around shared interests and ongoing group discussions.
GROUP VIDEO, VOICE, AND TEXT
• Participate in live conversations within structured rooms and choose how you engage in each community space. Upgrade to join more rooms simultaneously. Plus, no extra fees for international messaging or calling.
REAL-TIME MODERATION AND SAFETY TOOLS FOR LIVE CHAT ROOMS
• Live human room moderators
• Room management controls
• One-tap reporting
• Community guidelines
• AI Safety filters
CREATE YOUR OWN ROOM
• Can’t find a specific topic? Create a group and host your own room. Start a topic-based room and guide discussions using built-in management tools.
VIRTUAL GIFTS AND RECOGNITION
• Send virtual gifts within rooms and earn recognition within the Paltalk community, with special appearances from pop culture characters and brands you love; try sending gifts to say hello in a room. Each gift sent or received earns points toward special status as a Paltalk Crown member.
ACCESS ANYWHERE
• Join from desktop or mobile and stay part of your favorite community rooms wherever you are. Paltalk will even run in the background of your device if you want to listen to your favorite room or talk to a friend while you read emails. Never miss a great moment again.
If you enjoy the Paltalk community, we appreciate your review. For support, contact ptmobile@paltalk.com. We read and respond to every message.

bluejetty:00179360:ios.name: Australian Citizenship 2026
bluejetty:00179360:ios.summary:
Get ready to ace your Australian Citizenship Test 2026 with our complete study app. We've loaded it with actual test questions and a dynamic learning system to ensure you're fully prepared for the Australian Citizenship Test.
LEARN FROM TH
bluejetty:00179360:ios.description:
Get ready to ace your Australian Citizenship Test 2026 with our complete study app. We've loaded it with actual test questions and a dynamic learning system to ensure you're fully prepared for the Australian Citizenship Test.
LEARN FROM THE OFFICIAL GUIDE
Our lessons are based on the official "Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond" booklet, published by the Australia Department of Home Affairs. Practice with Australian citizenship test questions you could be asked on the big day, each supplemented with clear, helpful explanations.
A WEALTH OF LESSONS AND TESTS
Delve into over 30 engaging lessons, challenge yourself with 400+ questions, and feel ready for the real thing with 20+ citizenship tests. With such extensive content, passing the Australian Citizenship Test will feel like a breeze.
AUDIO SUPPORT FOR BETTER COMPREHENSION
Use the audio-support feature for an enhanced study experience. Listen and learn about Australia's history, values, government, and symbols in a more engaging manner, all tailored for the Australian Citizenship Test.
ENHANCE YOUR VOCABULARY
Our comprehensive flashcards and dictionary support can help clarify any difficult terms you come across. We aim to simplify your study process for the Australian Citizenship Test.
KEEP AN EYE ON YOUR PROGRESS
Stay on top of your Australian citizenship journey. Our app allows you to monitor your progress through lessons, track test scores, and even remember where you left off with the Continue Studying feature.
OFFLINE MODE FOR CONVENIENCE
Get ready for your Australian citizenship test even on the go. Our offline mode gives you access to all the lessons, quizzes, and tests, no matter where you are.
EXTRA FEATURES:
- Direct feedback on all answers
- Personalized study reminders
- Support for Dark Mode and automatic switch
- Countdown timer to your citizenship test
- Pronunciations for glossary words
The Australian Citizenship Test 2026 app is an assessment tool used to gauge your knowledge of Australia, along with the responsibilities and privileges that come with citizenship. It also tests your basic command of the English language. This computer-based multiple-choice test, comprising 20 randomly selected questions from a broad question pool, is an integral step towards Australian citizenship.
To pass the Australian citizenship test, you must correctly answer at least 75% of the questions. Successfully passing the test demonstrates your understanding and commitment to the responsibilities encapsulated in the Australian Citizenship Pledge.
Our app provides a variety of practice tests to aid your preparation for the Australian citizenship test in 2026. Depending on your preferred study style, you can opt to study individual topics or undertake a simulation of the citizenship test featuring 20 randomly selected questions. For those seeking a comprehensive challenge, try our ultimate Australian citizenship marathon test that includes all the possible questions from our repository. Regardless of your study preference, our app is designed to give you the confidence and knowledge to ace your Australian citizenship test.
YOUR FEEDBACK MATTERS
We're always eager to hear from you! If you have any thoughts or questions about the app or its content, please drop us a line at support@aucitizenship.com.
ENJOYING OUR APP?
We'd love to hear about it! Your review is invaluable to us, so please take a moment to let us know what you think about our Australian citizenship test prep app.

bluejetty:00075641:ios.description:
CATCH GHOSTS IN A SPOOKY BOBO WORLD!
Welcome to BoBo World: Haunted House, a fun and mysterious adventure filled with cute ghosts, surprising scares and spooky places to explore.
Walk through festival streets, enter a mysterious haunted mansion, visit a strange midnight party, explore a candy factory and discover what is hiding throughout six Halloween-themed locations.
WATCH OUT FOR CUTE GHOSTS
Little ghosts can appear when you least expect them!
Each ghost has its own funny way to surprise your BoBo friends. Stay alert as you explore every room and corner.
CATCH THE GHOSTS
Don't just run away—catch them!
Use special ghost-catching tools to capture mischievous spirits before they scare your friends.
HELP YOUR BOBO FRIENDS
Did someone get too scared?
Your little angel friend can arrive at just the right moment to help them recover and continue the adventure.
PLAY 6 FUN MINI-GAMES
Complete fun mini-games to earn more chances for your little angel to help.
Take a break from ghost hunting and discover new challenges along the way.
EXPLORE 6 SPOOKY PLACES
Discover six different Halloween-themed locations:
• Festival Street
• Haunted Mansion
• Shriek Diner
• Midnight Party
• Mystery Base
• Candy Factory
Every place has its own ghosts, surprises and interactive objects to discover.
DRESS UP FOR THE ADVENTURE
Try different Halloween outfits and create the perfect spooky look for your BoBo characters.
CREATE YOUR OWN SPOOKY STORIES
There are no fixed stories or rules.
Move characters between locations, interact with objects, catch ghosts, dress up and create your own funny and mysterious adventures.
PLAY TOGETHER
Multi-touch support makes it easy to explore, catch ghosts and create stories together.
PLAY ANYWHERE
Enjoy your spooky BoBo adventure without needing Wi-Fi.
BOBO SVIP
One BoBo SVIP subscription unlocks full content across participating BoBo apps. Download included BoBo games and enjoy all included content with no ads or additional purchases while your subscription is active.
Explore spooky places, catch cute ghosts and create your own Haunted House adventure with BoBo!

bluejetty:00128013:ios.name: Chef Merge - Fun Match Puzzle
bluejetty:00128013:ios.summary: Chef Merge is a relaxing fun puzzle game in which you can decorate mansions and merge elements. Just like wandering on a farm, in this fun merge game, you can see vegetables & fruit, crops everywhere. Just tap, drag & merge them to create v
bluejetty:00128013:ios.description:
Chef Merge is a relaxing fun puzzle game in which you can decorate mansions and merge elements. Just like wandering on a farm, in this fun merge game, you can see vegetables & fruit, crops everywhere. Just tap, drag & merge them to create values! 
Trading things you merged with your special neighbors, to get coins and diamonds for decorating mansions! The pattern of the carpet, the shape of the light, the style of the chairs & table.....It all depends on you! You can just realize your ideas for designing, pick up your favorite decorations - buy fancy furniture, flooring, and wallpaper to create your own mansion in Chef Merge! 
How to play:
1. Tap the boxes which have a lightning mark on them, to get new items for you to merge
2. Drag the same items together to merge them up
3. See what your neighbors want on the top of the game board, merge those certain items, and sell your products to them to get surprising rewards
4. Complete the decorating task by using the coins you got, make a special mansion for yourself
Features： 
1. Comfortable & soft color designing, relaxing background music, make you feel at ease. 
2. Vivid & cute farming elements bring you a special game experience with less pressure and more fun. 
3. No time limit, no force in passing levels or competing with other players. You can just follow your own pace to make any movements. 
4. More mansions for creating. You can design mansions in styles you like! 
5. Exercise your fingers and test your skills and strategies in a merge puzzle game. 
6. Collect farming elements and make an album for them. You can show your harvest easily by showing a screenshot of the album. 
If you are a merge/match game mania, do not miss Chef Merge! It's easy to pick up and manage. Many new elements will generate when you make a move, as well as the entertainment of a merge game, which will definitely please you！ 
Chef Merge will be updated with more blast merges to solve and more beautiful mansions regularly! Stay tuned for updates and drop us a review!

bluejetty:00073378:ios.description:
Download ClassPass today to book fitness classes & appointments at the top studios, gyms, salons, and spas near you!
How it works:
• Download the free ClassPass app.
• Sign up for a trial and get credits to try activities like yoga, pilates, gym visits, and more from some of our top-rated businesses.
• Browse studios, gyms, salons, & spas near you (pro tip: filter by reservation type, location, time, & more to easily find what you’re looking for!).
• Book classes & appointments instantly without needing to create additional accounts or enter payment details.
• After your trial, customize a plan that works best with your fitness & wellness routine.
• Roll over unused credits up to the number of credits in your next month’s plan.

• Access thousands of the world’s leading fitness studios, gyms, salons and spas including CorePower Yoga, [solidcore], PureBarre, Glosslab, & more!
• Browse a list of recommended studios, gyms, salons, & spas curated just for you.
• Bookmark your favorites.
• Invite friends to class and earn rewards.
• Connect with friends who are already on ClassPass.
• Receive badges to celebrate your milestones and share them with friends.
• Read reviews & ratings to know what to expect with each reservation.
ClassPass is available in more than 2,500+ locations including: USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, Ireland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal, Switzerland, Austria, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines, China, India, the United Arab Emirates, Brazil, Argentina, & Chile.

bluejetty:00120729:ios.description:
Wonster Words is an award-winning reading game to help kids build strong foundational literacy skills. Rooted in the science of reading, Wonster Words teaches phonics, phonemic awareness, letter-sound relationships, letter recognition, and spelling patterns through interactive puzzles, fun mini-games, and silly animations.
95% of parents say Wonster Words has helped their children learn to read! Join millions of families and download Wonster Words today!
_______________________
A FUN, PLAY-BASED APPROACH TO LEARNING
Children learn best when they’re having fun! Wonster Words combines interactive phonics puzzles with engaging animations to make reading feel like play. Kids explore words by dragging letters into place, hearing their letter names and sounds, and watching hilarious animated shorts that bring vocabulary to life.
• "As a 1st grade teacher with a kindergartener [son] I know how important it is to keep learning interesting. This is my son's favorite app and mine too."
• "I downloaded this game for my 2 yr old daughter and she is always running off with my phone to learn some new words."
_______________________
BASED ON THE SCIENCE OF READING
Wonster Words is built around phonics-based learning, research-backed principles that support early reading success. Kids go beyond basic ABCs and phonics—they learn how letters form blends, digraphs, word families, diphthongs, and CVC words, all key building blocks for fluency.
• "This app really helps reinforce the phonics principles and sight words we go over daily. I love that my children are eager to learn and have fun doing it."
• "[My 5 year old] has been using Wonster Words each night and has started to spell on his own. We are sounding out words together. He looks forward to playing the games and even reminds me of his practice time.
_______________________
CUSTOM WORD LISTS & SPELLING LESSONS
Every child learns differently, and now you can personalize their learning experience! With our Custom Word List feature, parents and teachers can enter their own words, and Wonster Words will automatically generate phonics-based spelling lessons tailored to those words.
• "I love this for my child’s spelling words. I am able to add our own words for her to practice and she enjoys the games."
• "Wonster words spelling has been a big help for my 3rd grader prepping for weekly spelling tests at school."
_______________________
SUPPORTS SPEECH & LANGUAGE DEVELOPMENT
For children with speech delays or language difficulties, Wonster Words provides a fun and effective way to practice articulation, phonological awareness, and vocabulary building. It’s an excellent supplement for speech therapy and a motivator for kids working on communication skills.
• "My three year old was slow to articulate many words. Speech therapy was helpful but he seemed bored with the simplistic repetitions. Got this game to work with him at home... He's four now and still loves this app. Non-stop chatterbox with a huge vocabulary."
• "I am a retired Speech-language Pathologist and I provide training for preschools. I love this app for vocabulary building, early reading and spelling."
_______________________
FITS YOUR NEEDS
Wonster Words supports offline play when traveling. It is safe for kids and ad-free. Its subscription can be canceled anytime without fees.
_______________________

◆ Dr. Toy's Best Picks
◆ Kidscreen iKids Finalist
◆ Mom's Choice Gold
◆ Academic's Choice

Wonster Words is safe, ad-free, and a subscription service. You can cancel anytime without fees.

• Privacy Policy: https://www.wonsterwords.com/privacy-policy

21 fun and educational games to help your child learn 3rd-grade lessons! Whether they are just starting Third Grade, or need to review
bluejetty:00062757:ios.description:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games and lessons to educate and entertain young children.
21 fun and educational games to help your child learn 3rd-grade lessons! Whether they are just starting Third Grade, or need to review and master the subjects, this is a perfect learning tool for kids aged 7-10. Math, language, science, STEM, reading, and critical thinking skills are all practiced in these games.
All lessons and activities are designed using real third-grade curriculums, so you can be sure these games will help give your child a boost in the classroom. Plus, your student or child will stay entertained with the help of voice narration, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. Improve your child's homework with the teacher-approved lessons & activities. 
Third Grade Learning Games cover the following educational topics: 
MATH
• Decimals and Fractions - Add decimals, convert from decimals to fractions 
• Multiply - Word problems, solve for x problems, multiply 3-factor and more
• Geometry - Perimeter, area, and different types of angles
• Measure - Measure length, volume, temperature, and time
• Division - Basic division and word problems
• Rounding and Places - Round numbers to the nearest 10 or 100, and identify place values
• Timed Facts - Quickly solve math problems to play a fun baseball game
LANGUAGE, GRAMMAR & READING
• Sentence Jumble - Help with reading compression and grammar
• Parts of Speech - Adverbs, pronouns, prepositions, adjectives, nouns, and verbs
• Syllables - Sound out words to figure out how many syllables they have
• Tense and Grammar - Learn the difference between past, present, and future tense
• Analogies - Compare words to complete the analogy
• Prefixes - Use a prefix to build words in a fun asteroid space game
• Reading - Read articles and answer questions
SCIENCE
• Food Chain - Identify types of animals and their role in the food chain
• Solar System - Learn about the planets and bodies in our solar system
• Water Cycle - Study the phases of the water cycle and how they interact
• Sound and Hearing - Understand what sound is and how the ear works
• Nutrition - Identify types of food and build a healthy plate
• Recycling and Energy - Learn why recycling is important and where energy comes from
• Erosion - Learn the causes and effects of erosion
Advanced Features Include:
- Detailed Progress Reports to help track your child's development
- Lesson Builder to create specific plans for your toddler to follow and play
- Multiple User support so up to 6 kids can play on the same app
- Avatars, stickers, and backgrounds for your toddler to unlock as they learn

Revolutionize how you practice and play golf. SWEE is the premier app with all the tools you need to reimagine how you practice with AI. Access immediate, personalized coaching anytime, anywhere, and as often as you want. Record and analyze your swings on your own time at a driving range, indoor facility, or at home. SWEE’s AI Coach analyzes your swing and provides practice plans to help you unlock your full potential.

Swing analysis made simple: Harness the power of advanced AI to analyze your swings and elevate your performance. Our cutting-edge technology provides personalized feedback to help you improve your swing.

Expert Guidance: Access exclusive and comprehensive content from a world-renowned coach. Benefit from expert teaching, detailed explanations, personalized guidance, effective drills, helpful tips, training recommendations, and much more.

Chippy, Your AI Coach: Ask questions in the Chat and get answers grounded in your swing and your plan. Go deeper on technique, drills, and what to work on next, right from the Chat tab. Available whenever you want a conversation, not just a video.

Personalized Practice Plans: Experience tailored practice plans with personalized feedback to reimagine how you practice. These plans are generated to optimize your technique and improve your swing, helping you unlock your full potential.

Track Your Swing Trends: State-of-the-art data visualization tools track and display your performance data for every swing you analyze. Understand your tendencies and improvements over time, while visually comparing your swings over time.

Learn at Your Own Pace: Our coaching system simplifies learning by breaking down complex concepts into manageable pieces, empowering you to progress at your own speed.

Your Personalized Golf Coach: Forget the endless search for answers on YouTube. SWEE provides tailored feedback based on your swing.

SWEE Features
• Automated Video Clipping: Every swing during your session is clipped and cataloged into your library for analysis.
• Swing Analysis: Improve your swing with our advanced AI technology. Obtain over 50 analysis metrics spanning your Setup to Follow Through from both Down Plane and Face On angles.
• Immediate Feedback: Record, upload, and analyze your swings from anywhere, anytime. Get a comprehensive breakdown of your swing in seconds.
• Expert Coaching: Access expert guidance from a world-renowned coach, tailored to you based on your swing.
• Chippy AI Chat: Ask Chippy anything about your swing and your practice. Dig deeper with natural conversational help whenever you need it.
• Personalized Practice Plans: Receive customized feedback and tailored performance plans to improve your swing.
• Coaching Videos: Navigate the most extensive library of coaching content ever provided by an AI coaching platform.
• Performance Tracking: Track performance metrics and visualize your progress using state-of-the-art data visualization tools.

bluejetty:00069250:ios.description:
Roll Player is a digital adaptation of a dice manipulation, strategy board game where you will compete to create the greatest fantasy character in the role-playing world!
Roll and draft dice to build up your character’s attributes!
Purchase weapons and armor to outfit your hero!
Gain skills and discover your hero’s traits to prepare them for their journey.
Earn Reputation Stars by constructing the perfect character. The player with the greatest Reputation wins the game and will surely triumph over whatever nefarious plot lies ahead!
At the beginning of the game, each player is assigned a random RPG class, alignment and a backstory. Through a series of puzzle-like dice manipulations, a player optimizes their character's attributes and attempts to maximize their alignment and backstory points. Earned gold is used to purchase various skills, traits, weapons and armor in the market phase of each turn. The game ends with a fully created character sheet of an RPG character and the player whose character has the most reputation points wins the game. The best character sheets are stored in the Hall of Heroes.
FEATURES:
- Cross-platform online multiplayer!
- Private online games with friends
- Synced progress across all your devices. Play online game on one device, continue on another!
- Play against 5 levels of AI (or multiple AIs!)
- Local multiplayer with friends on the same device
- Challenge yourself in Solo mode
- Keep a record of your best heroes, recent games and various stats
- Interactive tutorial - Play and learn!
LANGUAGE:
English
QUOTES:
Zee Garcia (The Dice Tower): “The whole thing just comes together nicely! I think that’s a good, good app. It really works well.”
Retromation (YouTube): “I think this game is fantastic! It’s such a good interpretation of a board game into a digital format. Just really, really, really enjoyable! Very nice!”
AWARDS & HONORS:
2022 Golden Geek Best Board Game App Runner Up
2016 Golden Geek Most Innovative Board Game Nominee

bluejetty:00072186:ios.description:
Are you a prank chat master?. Lie or truth. 
So many exciting life scenarios are waiting for you to choose what happens next, just by texting on mobile. All feels like a real chat! Enjoy and become a chat master!
Chat Game is an exciting interactive messaging game! 
With dozens of levels, different events and topics will fascinate you! Remember that every conversation is in your hands, you can determine the direction of the story with your choices! 
It's time to solve mysteries, reveal secrets and interact with different characters! Sometimes you will experience an action-packed tension, and sometimes you will go on an emotional journey. Chat Game will transport you to an immersive world! 
Among all the truth-or-lie, yes-or-no choice games, Chat Master: Prank Text is one of the funniest. In this chat game, you may be a prankster who fools your friends, makes your girlfriend jealous, or send your dad a witty joke. You can be anyone you want and talk in any manner you want, even to your boss at work or a scary ghost. Choose your story because each reply results in a different outcome; select the correct answers such as yes or no, truth or lie to complete each level's challenge.
With various prank texts and humorous wording, you will burst out laughing and relieve heavy stress with your friends and family on any occasion. Try it out, have fun with this funny text game, and learn how to pull off practical jokes; you won't be disappointed!
This yes-no game roleplay chat also offers one or two interesting quick mini-games that keep your brain active and sharp to easily pass other choices and texting levels, making you a prank master or cheat master.
Features this simple yet addictive texting game app brings you
- Play-by-play chat games that simulate real-life conversations.
- Various topics and settings to test your reaction and choose how your story will go.
- Endless fun mini-games to master your brain.
- Simple gameplay: choose yes or no, truth or lie, pick your response and your story, and complete all the entertaining chat challenges.
Do you want to be a chat, cheat, or prank master? Or are you just simply bored and want some fun? Download Chat Master: Prank Text now, select your story, and complete all of the humorous conversations and challenges.
Be prepared to understand the language of the characters when interacting with them! By making the right choices, you will reach special information, deepen the stories and witness surprising results! 
Download Chat Game now to have an exciting gaming experience! 
Become the main protagonist of a gripping story with Chat Master! Download and start your adventure now!
Chat Game - Chat Master!

bluejetty:00075974:ios.description:
Do you live alone and worry that if there is an emergency or accident that your family or friends might not find out until it's too late?
Life alone is not an easy thing; it has its own challenges. Your family members and friends are the circle you keep in touch with and seek from in case of emergencies. The present age of apps allows lots of opportunities to meet and chat, but only a few are designed to actually help you with senior monitoring and personal safety check ins with your circle. 
Circle Alert - Family Care & Senior Safety Alert is one of a kind health monitoring and elderly care app that lets you keep in touch with your folks through check ins or it will automatically send an emergency alert to your circle in case you do not check in with the app. Designed to make geriatric care, those on medicard or retired more manageable and medical alerts swifter, this app is one of the best check in apps available online.
Health Monitoring and Medical Alert App For Elderly Care 
To put it clearly, elderly care is not an easy job. Senior monitoring is an essential part of ensuring that your elders are doing well. With this safety check in app, you can enjoy a perk of consistent senior monitoring to ensure proper elderly care for your medicare loved ones. Since it also works as a health monitoring app, you can rely on Circle Alert app to send emergency alert in case your elders miss a daily check in. 
Safety Checkin For Single, Adults, Families
Whether you are an adult living alone or a child who wants to look after his\her parents, this senior monitoring app makes elderly care and senior monitoring more efficient. Designed to help you keep an eye on the ones who matter, this app has a personalized safety check feature which can be adjusted according to preferred duration. A medical alert sent to your linked family circle will allow your family members to check in on you and see if everything is going okay. Thus, this app truly makes geriatric care more manageable and efficient.
Send Automatic Emergency Alert or Medical Alerts
No need to worry about your family members or friends as this health monitoring app will do the check-ins for you. When you connect with the app, you can add your family circle as an elderly care party. Open the app to safety check in every day and inform your family about your well being. In case you ever miss a daily check in, the app will instantly send a medical alert or emergency alert, 
Features of Circle Alert - Family Care & Senior Safety Alert
• Simple and easy health monitoring app
• Appealing and easy to use elderly care app
• Set check in time and add persons who you want to notify in case of missing check in.
• Safety check in informs family of the user’s wellbeing
• Automatically send pre-configured emergency alert or medical alert in case of missing check ins with the circle
• Completely safe and private geriatric care check in app for families
So, what are you waiting for? Download and use Circle Alert - Family Care & Senior Safety Check today!

bluejetty:00078866:ios.description:
Learn English in a Fun & Effective Way 
Singit makes learning English easy and enjoyable by combining music with interactive lessons. 
Follow lyrics, get pronunciation feedback, and learn new words in context — all while listening to songs you love.
How Singit Helps You Learn Faster
5M+ Songs & Lyrics – Learn English with the music you enjoy.
*Instant Translations – Tap any word to see what it means.
*AI Speaking Coach – Get tips to improve your pronunciation.
*Fun Quizzes – Test what you’ve learned in an easy way.
*Personalized Lessons – The app adjusts to your level and progress.
Why Learn English with Music?
Ever noticed how songs stay in your mind? That’s because music makes learning words easier. Studies from Stanford, MIT, and Cambridge show that music helps with memory, pronunciation, and fluency—making it one of the best ways to learn a language.
Remember words without effort – Music helps new words stay in your mind.
Sound more natural – Singing along improves pronunciation and speech flow.
Understand spoken English better – Songs train your ears to catch words and phrases in daily conversations.
Learn everyday English – Music teaches common phrases the way people actually use them.
Stay motivated – Studies from Harvard and Yale show that fun learning leads to better results.
With Singit, you’re not just listening to music—you’re learning English in a way that feels easy and natural.
A Learning Method for Everyone
Singit is designed for all levels. Whether you're just starting or already have experience, music helps you learn faster, stay engaged, and improve naturally.
Download Singit today and start learning with music.
(Full access requires a subscription.)
SingIt Home: https://welcome.singit.io 
Terms of Service: https://app.singit.io/privacy/#tos 
Privacy Policy: https://app.singit.io/privacy/#policy

bluejetty:00013677:ios.description:
Carry essential resources and an active, supportive community wherever you go!
Join the most active sober community on any app, and have every resource you could need in one place. Over 100,000+ individuals trust it to provide them with the support they need on their journey, one day at a time.
Unlock the complete text and audio of foundational material, reflections for each day, resources to help you stay sober, and much more!
Foundational Material
- Immerse yourself in the content spread across 164 pages, including prayers, personal stories, and insights into the steps and traditions.
- Includes the full Big Book text, 12 Steps and 12 Traditions (12 and 12), As Bill Sees it, Daily Reflections, Prayers, Living Sober, the Joe and Charlie Audio Tapes, and much more! 
- Easily navigate through pages and chapters with search and highlight features, ensuring a smooth reading experience.
- Customize your reading with adjustable font sizes and Light and Dark Mode options for comfortable reading anytime, anywhere.
- Have the cornerstone material always at hand, offering constant guidance and support in your journey towards sobriety and personal development.
Podcasts and Audiobooks
- Explore a variety of podcasts and audiobooks from individuals sharing their journey to recovery.
- Discover new content contributed by community members or share your own story with others.
- Listen to audio versions of foundational material, making it easier to absorb its wisdom wherever you are.
Speaker Talks
- Gain motivation and insights by listening to speaker talks from meetings worldwide.
- Stay updated with new content added regularly, offering a continuous flow of inspiration.
Tracker for Sobriety
- Monitor your sobriety by recording your sobriety date and tracking your progress in days, weeks, months, and years.
- Celebrate milestones with digital tokens, marking each step of your journey.
- Embrace the practice of tracking and celebrating your sobriety, one day at a time.
Meeting Finder
- Connect with the community by attending live meetings at any time, accessible via phone, Zoom, and other services.
- Access meetings directly from various sources, with real-time updates and options tailored to your preferences.
- Filter meetings based on type, format, language, and accessibility.
Community Support
- Engage with an active, moderated community offering support, understanding, and camaraderie.
- Connect with individuals sharing the common goal of staying sober, one day at a time.
- Find strength and insight from daily reflections, shared stories, and lessons learned.
- Enhance your journey and minimize the risk of relapse with the support of a like-minded community.
- Share your story in a safe, supportive space with community guidelines. Objectionable content and abusive behavior are not tolerated: every member can report posts and block other users at any time.
From foundational material to community support, this app is your companion on the path to sobriety. Join our community and experience the difference it can make. Download the app today and take the first step towards a brighter, sober future.

bluejetty:00019562:ios.name: Navionics® Boating
bluejetty:00019562:ios.summary: Get up-to-date, detailed charts you can use offline plus a boatload of features on your mobile device, so they’re on hand wherever you go. The Boating app is a must-have for cruising, fishing, sailing, diving and all your activities on the
bluejetty:00019562:ios.description:
Get up-to-date, detailed charts you can use offline plus a boatload of features on your mobile device, so they’re on hand wherever you go. The Boating app is a must-have for cruising, fishing, sailing, diving and all your activities on the water. Try it free for a limited time. To continue using charts and advanced features, you can purchase a yearly auto-renewable subscription*.
A COMPLETE PACKAGE
• INTERNATIONALLY RENOWNED NAVIONICS® CHARTS: Use them offline along with multiple overlays, so you can be more aware of what’s above and below the water. 
- NAUTICAL CHART: Use this premier marine reference to study port plans, anchorages and safety depth contours, locate navaids, marine services and more. 
- SONARCHART™ HD BATHYMETRY MAPS: Extraordinary 1’ (0.5 meter) HD bottom contour detail is the ideal tool for locating new fishing areas. 
- U.S. GOVERNMENT CHARTS (NOAA): These are available within the following coverages: U.S. and Canada, Mexico, Caribbean to Brazil. 
- OVERLAYS: The relief shading overlay allows you to have a better understanding of bottom topography for improved fishing and diving. Sonar imagery reveals bottom hardness clearly and in vivid color on select lakes. Want more? Display satellite imagery on land and water.
- MAP OPTIONS: Change chart-overlay combinations to customize chart views, activate night mode, highlight shallow areas, target multiple fishing ranges and more.
- DAILY UPDATES: Benefit of thousands of daily updates worldwide.
• TOOLS FOR PLANNING AND ENJOYING YOUR DAY
- AUTO GUIDANCE+TM TECHNOLOGY**: Easily plan your trip with a suggested dock-to-dock path based on chart data and navigation aids. Get ETA, distance to arrival, heading to waypoint, fuel consumption and more. 
- WEATHER AND TIDES: Knowing conditions before heading out is crucial. Access real-time weather data, daily and hourly forecasts as well as wind, weather buoys, tides and currents. 
- MARKERS, TRACKS, DISTANCE: Place a marker on a good anchorage spot or where you reeled in a big fish. Record your track, take photos and videos within the app, and look back at your day anytime. Easily check distance among two points. 
• AN ACTIVE AND HELPFUL COMMUNITY
- COMMUNITY EDITS and the ACTIVECAPTAIN® COMMUNITY: Obtain and contribute useful local knowledge along with thousands of fellow boaters, such as points of interest, navigation aids and valuable recommendations from people with firsthand experience of the local environment. 
- CONNECTIONS: Stay in touch with your friends and fellow boaters by sharing your live location, tracks, routes and markers to easily meet on the water or let them check out your adventures. 
- GPX IMPORT/EXPORT: Share your saved data outside the app or transfer it to your chartplotter. 
- SHARE MAP OBJECTS: Share a marina, repair shop or any other location outside the app.
• EXTERNAL DEVICE-FRIENDLY FOR MORE FEATURES
- PLOTTER SYNC: If you own a compatible chartplotter, sync it with the app to transfer routes and markers, activate, update or renew your Navionics chartplotter card subscription. 
- SONARCHART LIVE MAPPING FEATURE***: Connect with a compatible sonar/plotter, and create your own maps in real time while navigating. 
- AIS: Connect to a compatible AIS receiver with Wi-Fi® connectivity to see nearby marine traffic. Set a safe range, and receive visual and aural alerts to signal potential collisions. 
NOTES: 
*You can manage your subscription anytime, and you can turn auto-renewal off.
**Auto Guidance+ is for planning purposes only and does not replace safe navigation operations
***Free features 
A tablet device with Wi-Fi connectivity locates your approximate position if it is connected to Wi-Fi. A tablet Wi-Fi + 3G model operates similarly to a phone device with GPS. 
Wi-Fi is a registered trademark of the Wi-Fi Alliance. iOS is a trademark licensed to Apple, Inc.

bluejetty:00073790:ios.summary:
Experience the Battle of Gettysburg Like Never Before!

bluejetty:00073790:ios.description:
Experience the Battle of Gettysburg Like Never Before!
Immerse yourself in the drama, heroism, and pivotal moments of the Battle of Gettysburg with this self-guided audio tour. Discover how this three-day conflict shaped the future of the United States, as you explore the battlefield at your own pace from the comfort of your car.
Bring History to Life with a Self-Guided Tour
Tired of dull history lessons? This audio tour brings the Civil War to life with engaging narration, expert insights, and thrilling accounts of the Union’s victory over Confederate forces. Follow the footsteps of the brave soldiers, discover the strategies of key generals, and witness the turning point in American history—all with GPS-triggered stories that play automatically.
Explore freely: No need for a guide or schedule. You’re in control of the tour. Stop, explore, and take in the historical significance of each site at your leisure.
Deep dive into history: Get detailed insights into the strategies, key moments, and personal stories that shaped the battle. Learn about the bravery, struggles, and humanity of the soldiers.
Top Gettysburg Battlefield Stops:
▶McPherson Ridge: Learn how the first shots of the battle were fired.
▶Eternal Light Peace Memorial: Commemorating peace after the war.
▶Oak Ridge Observation Tower: Overlook key battlefield positions.
▶Sallie Memorial: Dedicated to a beloved canine companion of soldiers.
▶Seminary Ridge Museum: Hear about the critical role of the seminary in the battle.
▶North Carolina Memorial: A tribute to Confederate soldiers from North Carolina.
▶Virginia Monument: Honoring the soldiers from Virginia.
▶Pitzer Woods: Site of fierce fighting on the second day.
▶Warfield Ridge: Witness the Confederates’ struggle.
▶Little Round Top: The pivotal site of Union defense.
▶Devil's Den: Scene of intense combat and fierce resistance.
▶The Wheat Field & Peach Orchard: Blood-soaked landscapes from brutal fighting.
▶Plum Run: A stream that ran red with blood.
▶George Weikert Farm: Shelter and battleground for soldiers.
▶Pennsylvania Memorial: The largest monument on the battlefield.
▶Spangler's Spring: A symbol of temporary truce.
▶Line of Battle: Key points in the Union defense line.
▶Culp's Hill Tower: Site of relentless battles for control.
▶East Cemetery Hill: A critical defensive position.
▶The High Water Mark & Pickett’s Charge: The climax of the battle.
▶National Cemetery: Resting place for the fallen and the site of Lincoln’s speech.
▶Lincoln’s Gettysburg Address: Visit where President Lincoln gave his historic address.
RAVE REVIEWS:
“We had an unforgettable experience! The audio guide made history come alive, and the GPS worked flawlessly.”
“Loved it! The detailed stories and ability to go at our own pace made this tour far more immersive than any classroom lesson!”
APP FEATURES:
■Automatic Audio Playback: The app uses your GPS location to automatically play stories about what you’re seeing, ensuring you never miss a key point.
■Fascinating Narration: Enjoy engaging and professionally narrated stories prepared by local experts. Dive into both the broad history and personal stories of the soldiers.
■Works Offline: No need for data or cell service while on tour. Simply download the tour over Wi-Fi ahead of time.
■Full Flexibility: No crowds, no schedules, no rush. Skip, linger, and explore as much as you’d like. It’s your tour, your way.
■Award-Winning Platform: This app is powered by the award-winning developers behind the famous Newport Mansions tours, which host over a million visitors each year.
Free Demo vs Full Access:
Try out the free demo to experience a sample of this immersive tour. If you love it, upgrade to full access for all stops and stories.
QUICK TIPS:
Download the tour ahead of time using Wi-Fi.
Ensure your phone is fully charged, or bring an external battery, as GPS can use significant battery power.

bluejetty:00033653:ios.description:
Blendeo, the most advanced long exposure photo and video editor. First of its kind, it lets you change exposure time after capture to blend imagery that gets noticed. 
The hardest part of creating amazing long exposures is out of the control of even the best photographers. You can use a tripod or stabilization, frame the scene just right, but when do you start and stop the capture? With Blendeo you don’t need to get lucky; you take control.
No need for ND filters, calculating shutter time, aperture, or ISO. Simply capture for up to 5 minutes or import a video and edit the perfect long exposure with Blendeo.
"I can quickly create a Sunrise photo with smooth water thanks to Blendeo. No need for waiting 5 minutes with a $500 filter on my lens." — Jason Teale
HOW TO BLENDEO
・ Capture in-app or import a video to create a document 
・ Choose the image type: Photo or Video
・ Choose the blending mode: Motion Blur or Light Trails
・ Turn the Exposure Time dial
・ Scrub the timeline to get the best looking blend 
・ Export and share as a photo, Live Photo, or video
・ Send to Cinemagraph Pro for iOS to create a long exposure cinemagraph
BLENDEO PHOTO
・ Adjust the start frame by moving the indicator on the timeline
・ Set the exposure time by turning the dial
・ Exposure time can be from 1/30 second to the duration of the capture time (maximum 5 minutes) for photo
BLENDEO VIDEO
・ Adjust the start and end frames by moving the trimmer on the timeline
・ Set the exposure time by turning the dial
・ Exposure time can be from 1/30 second to half of the duration of the capture time (maximum 5 minutes) for video
・ Set the playback speed 
MOTION BLUR BLENDING
Great daytime effects as photos or videos:
・ Soften moving water and clouds
・ Make a car look like it was speeding by
・ Ghostly shadows of people walking 
・ Make transient objects like people and cars disappear in a busy place with a long exposure time of minutes
LIGHT TRAILS BLENDING
Great nighttime effects as photos or videos:
・ Star trails through the sky
・ Streaks of light from moving planes, trains, and automobiles 
・ Amusement park rides 
・ Sparklers and fireworks
MADE FOR iOS 
Blendeo is powered by the amazingly fast hardware in iPhone and iPad, along with the specially-tuned software frameworks Metal, Vision, Core Image, Core ML, and AVFoundation. Combined with Flixel’s near decade of experience creating professional digital imagery tools, Blendeo pushes the limits of what can be created on iOS to a new level.
FLIXEL PLANS
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews at the purchase price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the Account Settings after purchase. Subscriptions are one month or year in length. For Terms of Service see https://flixel.com/terms/

bluejetty:00143982:ios.name: Штрафы ГИБДД: авто проверка
bluejetty:00143982:ios.summary:
Does the seller say that the car is in perfect condition? Our comprehensive auto-check will show if this is really the case. Autobot is your personal car expert who looks into the car's past and finds things that you won't be told about.
We
bluejetty:00143982:ios.description:
Does the seller say that the car is in perfect condition? Our comprehensive auto-check will show if this is really the case. Autobot is your personal car expert who looks into the car's past and finds things that you won't be told about.
We analyze not only the official traffic police databases, but also the hidden sales history on the Internet.
That's what we find every day.:
After a serious accident, it is sold as "not beaten, not painted."
The mileage is twisted by 150,000 km just before the sale.
She worked in a taxi for 2 years, although the seller denies this.
It is pledged by the bank, which is not mentioned in the announcement.
Your full auto library report will include:
Hidden sales history. Our anti-overbooking module will find previous ads on auto.ru. You will see old photos, prices, and descriptions that the seller may have deleted. Data from the nomerogram is also included.
Legal purity. Protect your money from problems. We check cars for bail, arrests and other restrictions. The report includes information about the CTP policy and unpaid fines that may interfere with registration.
The actual technical condition. We will show not just the fact of the accident, but help you assess its severity. Reconciliation of mileage through the inspection databases (EAISTO) will help identify fraud.
Full registration history. The entire chain of owners, data from the vin01 database, and the car's car code. You no longer need to check everything manually through public services.
We created Autobot so that buying a used car would no longer be a lottery. The entire check by VIN (VIN) and state number takes place in a couple of minutes. Install the app and get all the arguments for a confident bargain!
Legal information and data sources
Attention! Autobot is an independent application that does not represent the government structure of the Russian Federation.
The sources of information in the application may be as follows (sites will be reliably accessible only when switching from a Russian IP address):
The official website of the Traffic police of the Russian Federation https://гибдд .Russian Federation/check/auto
The official website of the FSSP of the Russian Federation https://fssp.gov.ru/iss/ip
The official website of the Register of Mortgages of the Russian Federation https://www.reestr-zalogov.ru/search
The official website of the Customs of the Russian Federation https://customs.gov.ru/cars ?vin=
Our service is not responsible for the quality and accuracy of the data provided. Information about how the application accesses, collects, uses, and shares data with other users, as well as how it restricts the use of data for these purposes, can be found in our Privacy Policy - https://autoexpert.vc/agreement_ruavtobot
Do you have any questions when checking the car? Our expert is in touch! Write to us at avtobot.info@mail.ru

------
WHAT MAKES DEEPSTASH DIFFERENT
Knowledge in Deepstash comes as beautifully designed idea cards: short, visual notes that condense profound thoughts from bestselling books into simple, memorable insights. Each idea is paired with stunning artwork that makes learning feel less like work and more like inspiration.
No clutter. No distractions. Just focused, delightful content that helps you grow smarter every day.

WHAT IDEAS CAN DO FOR YOU
Ideas are fundamental to your wellbeing, your success, and your career. Reading powerful ideas daily can make you:
- Smarter (you'll know more valuable concepts)
- More Creative (you can connect more dots)
- Happier (better habits, less anxiety)
Fuel your curiosity and get smarter daily.
------
PERSONALIZED CONTENT & FEEDS
Choose topics you care about: productivity, leadership, psychology, philosophy, marketing, and more. As you read and save ideas, we learn what resonates with you and surface the best of our curated library of insights from top books.
You don't even have to work for it. We refresh your recommendations multiple times a day so you never run out of fresh ideas.

FREE & PRO: WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE?
- Start Free
Access 200,000+ powerful ideas from top books, articles, podcasts, and videos
Create and share your own ideas
- Upgrade to Deepstash Pro
No Ads: Read without interruptions

Save ideas that matter to you and organize them into collections. Create stashes for work projects, personal growth goals, or topics you're passionate about. Search and filter your saved ideas anytime, so they're always at hand when you need them.

SHARE YOUR DISCOVERIES

bluejetty:00170579:ios.description:
ChordButter is the secret ingredient for any musician or producer needing a simple audio workspace. ChordButter's block-based, easy interface does away with all the music theory confusion so you can tap into your pure creativity — anytime, anywhere.
From the creator of Tonaly, the #1 music app in over 20 countries
CHORD PROGRESSIONS SIMPLIFIED
▶ Chord Composer: Easily navigate keys and their chords to build your song and go beyond overused progressions.
▶ Learn by Doing: Play with the user-friendly chord extension menu and make music theory fun.
▶ Song Generator: Generate chord progressions in various styles and complexity, providing a complete foundation for your musical creations.
▶ Smart Chord Suggestions: Beat writer's block with musical recommendations based on your song.
ALIGN MELODIES WITH CHORDS
▶ Effortlessly craft melodies while staying in key and harmonizing with your chords.
▶ Visual Note Guide: Instantly see which notes fit within the current chord and key for seamless composition.
▶ Smart Chord Suggestions: Get harmonic recommendations based on your melody to keep your creativity flowing.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR DEMOS
▶ Backing Track Personalization: Try different instrumental play styles (Arpeggios, Rhythms) to hone in on your sound.
▶ Add drums and bass for greater creative control.

Hate typing the same thing over and over on your iPhone? WordBoard is a custom keyboard that lets you copy, paste, and insert text snippets instantly so you can type faster everywhere.
Save phrases, quick replies, contact details, hashtags, templates, or entire messages and insert them directly from your keyboard in any app. One tap. Done.
Featured in Best Apps for iOS 26 — Apple
FOR FAST TYPING ON IPHONE 
Stop switching between Notes and your keyboard. WordBoard keeps your most used text always one tap away so you can reply faster, stay consistent, and avoid mistakes.
ONE KEY FOR COPY AND PASTE 
Create keys that instantly insert:
* Common phrases and responses
* Email addresses and phone numbers
* Business details and links
* Customer support replies
* Hashtags and captions
* Text snippets and templates
* Your favorite images & GIFs
Power users save dozens of snippets and never retype the same thing again.
KAOMOJI & EMOTICONS 
Browse and insert hundreds of kaomoji and emoticons directly from your keyboard. No copy-pasting from other apps.
IMAGES & GIFS
Save and insert images and GIFs directly from your keyboard. Perfect for reaction images, logos, signatures, or anything you send repeatedly.
SMART TEMPLATES AND VARIABLES 
Use dynamic placeholders like {{ DATE }} or {{ CLIPBOARD }} and WordBoard automatically fills them in when you paste your text.
AI KEYS
On Apple Intelligence compatible devices, WordBoard can rewrite, translate, and transform text directly from your keyboard.
FOLDERS AND ORGANIZATION
Organize your snippets into folders for work, personal use, social media, or customer support so everything is easy to find while typing.
WORKS IN EVERY APP
WordBoard works anywhere the iOS keyboard works, including Messages, Mail, WhatsApp, Instagram, Slack, Notes, and more. Switch instantly between the standard keyboard and WordBoard while typing.
WHAT CUSTOMERS ARE SAYING 
This is such a practical keyboard for those that constantly use the same wording. Formatting stays intact and it saves so much time.
So convenient. I used to copy and paste from Notes all day. Now everything is one tap.
Best shortcut keyboard ever. If you repeat phrases, this is the fastest way to type on iPhone.
SAVE TIME. TYPE FASTER.
WordBoard is the fastest way to copy, paste, and insert text snippets on iPhone and iPad.
Start with 6 free keys or upgrade to Pro for unlimited keys, hashtag imports, and contact info integration.
To enable the keyboard, allow Full Access in Settings. This only allows WordBoard to share data between the app and the keyboard. WordBoard does not use network access to collect your data.
Download WordBoard today and type faster with instant copy and paste, text snippets, and smart shortcuts.
FAQ
What is WordBoard?
WordBoard is a custom iOS keyboard that lets you copy, paste, and insert saved text snippets directly while typing.
How does WordBoard help me type faster on iPhone?
Instead of retyping or switching apps to copy and paste, WordBoard inserts your saved text with a single tap.
Is WordBoard good for copy and paste on iPhone?
Yes. WordBoard is designed to make copy and paste faster, easier, and more organized than using Notes or the clipboard alone.
Can I use WordBoard for text snippets and templates? 
Yes. WordBoard lets you create reusable snippets, templates, and quick replies that work in any app.
Does WordBoard work in all apps?
Yes. WordBoard works anywhere the iOS keyboard works.
Is WordBoard better than iOS text replacement?
WordBoard keeps formatting, supports folders, templates, variables, and does not require remembering shortcuts.
Is WordBoard free?
WordBoard includes 6 free keys. You can upgrade to Pro for unlimited keys and advanced features.
Does WordBoard collect my data?
No. WordBoard does not collect or transmit your data.

bluejetty:00180825:ios.description:
The classic card game!
Solitaire is a popular classic card game that everyone loves, perfect to exercise your brain! It can also be played offline anytime, anywhere! The aim of this game is simple: put all cards on the table into 4 piles (one per suit), using one deck with 52 cards. During the game, any empty pile on the table can be filled with a king and all cards must be arranged in order from large to small and alternating in colors.
Awesome modern design - Customize deck and board
We provide you with an amazing and modern design, which includes easy-to-read cards, fun, and unique animations, and some relaxing music! If you are feeling creative and want to add a personal touch to your Solitaire game, you can customize card faces, card backs, and backgrounds using our gallery of photos that we carefully chose for you. Make it your own!
Relaxing and challenging
Some solitaire games can be quite hard sometimes, but you can make it easier! If you get stuck, use the shuffle or magic wand powerup and enjoy this extra help. Additionally, if you can’t figure out what move to make next, don’t worry! We give you unlimited hints to use whenever you want! So, if you are having trouble solving the game, don’t be shy and use a hint every now and then!
Daily challenges - win exciting prizes!
Play these challenging daily games and double the fun! Solve the daily challenge to win rewards that will help you any game! The more challenges you complete, the more prizes you’ll earn.
-Super Addictive and Fun
-Solve daily challenges
-Train your brain
-Set new records
-You can choose to draw 1 card (easy mode) or 3 (hard mode)
-Choose between different themes and card styles
-Detailed statistics to help you improve your performance
-Smooth music
-Beautiful animations whenever you complete a level
-Auto-complete function
-Autosave
-Play offline, anytime and anywhere
-Listen to the radio while playing
-Scoring - None, Klondike Standard, Vegas or Vegas Cumulative
-Amazing powerups
And so much more!

bluejetty:00084722:ios.name: Horizonpedia
bluejetty:00084722:ios.summary:
The only app for ACNH that lets you truly recreate your character and island!
- No ads you dont want to! (Ads can be disabled for free in the settings if you dont like them!)
This App is everything you need to have a pleasant stay on your
bluejetty:00084722:ios.description:
The only app for ACNH that lets you truly recreate your character and island!
- No ads you dont want to! (Ads can be disabled for free in the settings if you dont like them!)
This App is everything you need to have a pleasant stay on your Island:
 - A Dashboard always shows you wich events and birthdays are coming up on your island
 - Recreate your own Character like it looks in the game and track progress for up to 8 characters per island on up to 20 islands
 - A critter tracker (Fish, Insects, Sea Creatures) where you can see what's currently catchable.
 - You can also track what you have donated to your museum
 - Find what you need to know faster with on-point, easy-to-use filters for everything
 - It has lists for favourites so find quickly what you need more often
 - The flower breeding section shows you almost all possible combinations of breeding a flower, making it super easy to get the blue rose
 - Guides are written with the knowledge of the dataminers
 - Every created island has its own museum tracker and every character has its own critterpedia and catalog tracker. You will always know wich of your characters has wich items obtained and its super easy to use.
Currently available information:
 - Dashboard with customizable daily todo list, current seasons and events showing, active critter tracking and island visitor tracking
 - Profile where you can enter all personal data from the game for quick use
 - All critters
 - All Fossils and pieces of art
 - All villagers with many characteristics
 - The whole catalog
 - DIY recipes
 - All reactions
 - Very detailed flowerbreeding
 - K.K. Songs
 - Turnip price prophet
 - Guides (e.g. friendship with villagers, events etc)
 - Special item lists (Tools, critter models, event items, seasonal items)
 - Ad settings let you choose if and how much you want to support the project. Disabling them will cost you nothing!
- Fully supported languages: German, English, French, Spanish
We are working to provide features, tips & tricks to make your life on the island as pleasant as it can ever be.
We are directly linked to the community via Discord where you can give direct feedback to the developer.
We care for good translations. If you want to contribute to your native language translations, send a Message to info@horizonpedia.com or contact Salatgurke#6901 on Discord.

bluejetty:00078235:ios.name: My TimeBook
bluejetty:00078235:ios.summary:
My Timebook App has been designed to be used by Longshoreman who work on the waterfront.
Go mobile! Have your time book with you at all times. Keep track of where you've worked and most importantly, keep track of your hours worked. 
NOTE
bluejetty:00078235:ios.description:
My Timebook App has been designed to be used by Longshoreman who work on the waterfront.
Go mobile! Have your time book with you at all times. Keep track of where you've worked and most importantly, keep track of your hours worked. 
NOTE: All the data is stored on the phone and will get deleted if you delete the app. If you need to delete, don't forget to use the built-in backup feature. The backup will save all your data to a file and email a copy to yourself.
Features:
- Enter daily job events with the following information: Shift, Ship, Location, Job, Hours, Flop Hours, Average Hours, Travel Hours, and Notes.
- Ability to update job events.
- Automatic Calculations of Check-In Hours, Actual Worked Hours, and Earnings.
- Hours worked calculated for each quarter, year to date, selected month, selected week, and career hours.
- Earnings calculated for each quarter, year to date, selected month, and selected week.
- Monthly view of all job events including all Holidays.
- Configuration panel to update primary shift (day/night) and Local (Casual, 13, 63, 94, ...).
- Automatic filtering of jobs based on Local selection.
- For users which have less than 5000 hrs, enter Career Hours in Configuration Panel and have this App keep track of your hours worked.
- Make phone calls within the Timebook App: for Checking In and Job Counts.
This time book app has been developed by someone who works in the industry. Any suggestions for enhancements are welcomed, if reasonable will be considered.
This is just a start. New features are in the works.
Terms:
New installs will have use of the Time Book for 15 days.
The time book will be renewable on a yearly basis for $4.99 and subject to change.
For more information or for comments, go to: www.laptopindustries.com
