bluejetty:00183453:ios.name: eMeals - Healthy Meal Plans
bluejetty:00183453:ios.summary: eMeals is the easiest way for busy families to plan healthy meals. With 15 different weekly meal and diet plans there is sure to be enough recipe inspiration to please even the pickiest eater. Our meal plans create your customizable shoppin
bluejetty:00183453:ios.description:
eMeals is the easiest way for busy families to plan healthy meals. With 15 different weekly meal and diet plans there is sure to be enough recipe inspiration to please even the pickiest eater. Our meal plans create your customizable shopping list ingredients that connect directly to one of our online grocery delivery or pickup partners.
The Benefits of our Healthy Meal Planning:
>Stress-Free Weekly Meal Plans
Our meal plan service helps add variety and save you time. Each week eMeals send you 7 new recipes to eliminate the overwhelming feeling of searching for new recipes to try. As you select your meal plan recipes for the week, our planner is automatically creating an interactive grocery shopping list. If you don’t see recipes on this week’s plan you like, search previous meal plans, other food style plans & bonus meal collections published throughout the year for extra meal inspiration.
>Easy Grocery Shopping Options
Each meal plan’s automated grocery list connect directly to grocery partners like Walmart, Instacart, Shipt, AmazonFresh, Albertsons, Safeway, H-E-B or Kroger without leaving the app. You can have your grocery & shopping list gathered for curbside grocery pickup or home delivery. 
Not interested in online grocery options? Our customizable shopping list breaks down ingredients by location in the grocery store to make shopping in person a breeze. 
>Meal Plans for Every Food Style
Our most popular meal plans focus on simple, healthy eating. From healthy sensible carb-smart meals to protein-rich meals, our dietitians ensure we follow all national recommendations for heart healthy & diabetic food plans. 
If you’re looking for quick, healthy family-friendly recipes, we have several plans that both meet your budget & get dinner on the table in under 30 minutes. Looking to cut a few inches? Our Low Carb, Low Calorie, Paleo & Keto plans are great a great resource to meet your health or fitness goals. Each meal plan subscription has access to all 15 food styles & diets. 
>Diet Specific Meal Plans
Starting & maintaining a diet meal plan can be tricky. Let our meal planner take the guesswork out of counting carbs, calories and sugars with our specialty and weight management diet plans. 
Options like Low Carb, Low Calorie, Paleo, Keto & Mediterranean Meal Plans are a great start to meet any weight loss or fitness goal. These plans are also great to make health-focused meal planning easier for Diabetic or Heart Healthy diets. Each recipe plan is crafted to meet your health goals with nutritional information to make dinnertime stress-free.
Download our planner today to take the stress out of meal planning, grocery shopping & cooking delicious, healthy dinners.
Our subscription offers:
3-month Dinner Meal Plan recurring subscription: $29.99
12-month Dinner Meal Plan recurring subscription: $59.99
3-month All-Day Meal Plan Bundle recurring subscription: $39.99
12-month All-Day Meal Plan Bundle recurring subscription: $99.99
Privacy Policy: http://emeals.com/about/privacy-policy.php
Terms: http://emeals.com/about/terms.php

bluejetty:00068052:ios.description:
لعبة برا السالفة لعبة جماعية مليئة بالضحك اعرف مين من أصحابك أو عائلتك محترف في ترقيع السالفة وخبير في التصريف. اجمعهم والعبوا "برا السالفة" واستمتعوا بأجواء طقطقة وضحك في أفضل العاب جماعيه تناسب كل جلسه مع الأصدقاء أو العائلة.
مين فيكم بيقفط النصّاب؟ ومين يقدر يمثّل ويضلل مثل ألعاب امبوستر أو لعبة الجاسوس؟ هنا التحدي الحقيقي في العاب تحديات تعتمد على الذكاء والتصريف.
● طريقة اللعب:
— اجمع أصحابك أو عائلتك
— اختار نوع السالفة (الموضوع) مثل مسلسلات أو أكلات أو أنمي وغيرها
— إذا كنت داخل السالفة حاول تكتشف الشخص خارج السالفه بأسئلة ذكية
— اسأل أسئلة تحجيرية بدون ما تفضح السالفة
— ركّز على إجابات البقية واكشف التناقض
— إذا كنت برا السالفة حاول تفهم الموضوع من أسئلة واجوبة البقية
● أجواء تحدي وضحك
استمتعوا بجو من الطقطقة والتحدي في لعبة جماعية خفيفة وسريعة تناسب كل جلسه.
● العب بدون نت
سواء في البيت أو الطلعات، تقدرون تلعبون برا السالفة بدون نت وفي أي وقت.
● سوالف متنوعة
سواليف الأكل، الحلويات، المشروبات، الكرتون، الأنمي، القيمرز، الكيبوب وغيرها
وفيها أيضاً طور مستوحى من لعبة الجاسوس لمحبي هذا النوع من الألعاب
● عدد اللاعبين:
3 - 20 لاعبين
مناسبة لجميع أفراد العائلة وطلعات الأصحاب. سواء تبغون لعبه جماعيه خفيفة أو تحدي مليء بالضحك، "برا السالفة" لعبة الجمعات الأفضل!
السواليف ما تخلص مع "برا السالفة" جربها الآن!

bluejetty:00039669:ios.description:
Introducing QUOX – The World’s First AI-Powered Motivational Quotes App
Step into the future of inspiration with QUOX, the revolutionary AI-driven quotes app that transforms how you stay motivated. Powered by ChatGPT, QUOX delivers uniquely personalized quotes based on your mood, goals, and preferences — right when you need them most.
Whether you’re chasing big dreams or just need a quick boost, QUOX becomes your personal motivation coach, always ready to inspire.
Why You’ll Love QUOX:
• AI-Generated Quotes – QUOX uses advanced AI technology powered by ChatGPT to craft original, meaningful quotes just for you.
• Personalized Motivation – Choose from hundreds of categories like self-growth, confidence, love, and productivity to get quotes that truly match your mindset.
• QUOX Premium – Unlock smarter quotes, all themes, quote history, and deeper personalization for the ultimate motivational experience.
• Daily Reminders – Set customizable alerts to stay inspired and on track, every day.
• Beautiful Themes – Customize your quote experience with a wide range of elegant themes.
• Easy Sharing – Instantly share your favorite quotes on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and more.
• Home and Lock Screen Widgets – Get instant motivation right from your screen without opening the app.
• Favorites and History – Save quotes you love and revisit your full quote history anytime.
Upgrade to QUOX Premium:
• Smarter Quotes Powered by ChatGPT – Access advanced AI-generated content that’s even more personal and impactful.
• All Themes Unlocked – Choose your favorite visual style to suit your inspiration.
• Full Quote History – Never lose a quote that moved you.
• Deeper Personalization – Get motivational quotes crafted specifically for your goals and preferences.
QUOX is more than just a quotes app — it’s your daily companion for focus, growth, and inspiration.
Join the growing community discovering smarter motivation through AI. Start shaping your mindset and reaching your full potential with QUOX.
Download QUOX now and begin your journey of self-discovery and positive transformation.
Subscription Details:
To access QUOX Premium content and features, choose between a weekly or monthly auto-renewing subscription.
Payment will be charged to your App Store Account at confirmation of purchase and will renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal anytime in your App Store Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://quox.app/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://quox.app/termsandconditions

bluejetty:00160731:ios.description:
AquaPeixe is an all-in-one aquarium guide for fishkeepers who want to learn about species, organize tank care, track water parameters, and manage everyday aquarium maintenance.
Whether you keep a freshwater aquarium, saltwater tank, planted aquarium, or reef setup, AquaPeixe brings useful information and practical tools together in one place.
EXPLORE AQUARIUM SPECIES
Browse detailed information about fish, aquatic plants, crustaceans, corals, anemones, and other aquatic species.
Learn about:
• Common and scientific names
• Natural habitat and origin
• Adult size and lifespan
• Ideal temperature and pH
• Water hardness and care requirements
• Diet and recommended foods
• Temperament and behavior
• Compatibility with other species
• Aquarium requirements
• Care difficulty
MANAGE YOUR AQUARIUM
Create your aquarium profile and keep important information organized. Follow your tank setup, inhabitants, water parameters, and maintenance routine from one place.
TRACK WATER PARAMETERS
Keep an eye on important aquarium conditions such as:
• Temperature
• pH
• Ammonia
• Nitrite
• Nitrate
• GH
• KH
• Salinity
Review your parameter history and better understand how your aquarium changes over time.
REMINDERS & MAINTENANCE
Create reminders for recurring aquarium tasks, including:
• Feeding
• Water testing
• Water changes
• Cleaning
• Tank maintenance
FISH CARE & COMMON DISEASES
Learn about common aquarium fish diseases, possible symptoms, causes, and general care information to help you recognize problems and take better care of your aquatic animals.
AQUARIUM CALCULATORS
Use practical tools designed for everyday fishkeeping:
• Aquarium volume calculator
• Fertilizer dosage calculator
• Salt dosage calculator for marine or hospital tanks
• Filter flow calculator
• Water parameter calculator
• Temperature converter
FOR BEGINNERS AND EXPERIENCED FISHKEEPERS
AquaPeixe is designed for anyone interested in aquariums—from people setting up their first fish tank to experienced hobbyists managing freshwater, planted, marine, or reef aquariums.
Research species before adding them to your tank, organize your aquarium routine, monitor important parameters, and keep useful fishkeeping information always within reach.
Discover more about your aquarium and make everyday fish care simpler with AquaPeixe.

bluejetty:00123265:ios.description:
UBL Digital: Redefining Convenience and Security in Banking!
Manage your finances with ease using UBL Digital, the ultimate mobile banking solution. Perform secure transactions, pay bills, transfer funds, and access a host of banking services all from your smartphone. Whether you're at home, work, or on the go, UBL Digital ensures banking is always at your fingertips.
Opening a UBL Account is instant: 
Simply provide your CNIC and biometric verification, and get access to a bank account with a Debit card within minutes! No branch visits. No phone calls. Simply launch the UBL Digital App > Tap on ‘Open Smart Account’.
Stay in control & safer than ever: 
• Benefit from advanced security controls that protect you from fraud.
• Use biometric verification such as fingerprint and face scan to keep your money safe at all times.
• No need to write down your bank account details, just view and share via the UBL Digital App.
• Track all your transactions, check your account balance, and view/download your account statement anytime.
• Lock/unlock your card, order new cards/cheque books, and change your banking limits in seconds up to Rs. 10 million from within the app.
• Enable/disable NetBanking access via your app, to keep your account safe and private.
Hassle-free banking that’s fast & secure: 
• Quickly send & receive money via account details, CNIC, mobile number, or QR code. Funds transfer is that easy!
• With over 100+ global remittance partners, you can receive money online from anywhere in the world.
• Use the app to manage all your bill and fee payments ranging from utilities, to government, to education fees and more.
• Schedule payments for all your bills or fees in advance on the app. Set it and forget it! Bills get paid automatically, saving you time and stress.
• Pay multiple utility bills on the app with just one tap!
• Pay zakat quickly and easily on the app by selecting from our list of renowned charitable organizations.
• Find nearby UBL branches, offices and ATMs, and get alerts for new card discounts and promotions.
How to Get Started:
1. Download the UBL Digital app. 
2. Log in using your UBL account details or sign up as a new user.
3. Start exploring the convenience of digital banking!
Download UBL Digital today and join millions simplifying their banking experience!
Follow us - @ubldigital all channels!

https://www.instagram.com/ubldigital
https://twitter.com/ubldigital
https://www.linkedin.com/company/united-bank-limited

bluejetty:00040473:ios.description:
Welcome to Happy Farm - Small Town, where you can escape the hustle and bustle of the city and embrace the peaceful life of a farmer! Build your dream farm from the ground up, grow and harvest a variety of crops, raise adorable animals, and create a thriving rural community. Whether you’re a seasoned farmer or just getting started, Happy Farm offers endless fun and relaxation for everyone.
Happy Farm - Small Town Game Features:
- Build & Expand Your Farm: Start with a small plot of land and turn it into a prosperous farm. Plant and grow a wide range of crops, from wheat to strawberries, and watch your farm flourish with every harvest.
- Raise & Care for Animals: Bring your farm to life by raising animals like cows, chickens, and sheep. Feed and care for them, and they’ll reward you with fresh produce that you can use or sell.
- Harvest & Trade: Reap the rewards of your hard work by harvesting your crops and trading them in the market. Use your earnings to expand your farm, upgrade your equipment, and customize your farmhouse. Full fill orders using truck and boat service.
- Create Your Perfect Farm:
 + Design and decorate your Farm city the way you like it! Add charming buildings, decorate with beautiful plants, and make your farm a cozy place to call home.
 + Factories: wild mill, milk factory, beverage factory, various types of product with many recipe
- Daily Goals and Achievements: Complete daily challenges to earn bonuses and unlock achievements.
- Collect treasure chests to win FREE power ups and free coin/gem
- Join a Friendly Community: Connect with other players, trade goods, and help each other build the best farms in the land. Participate in fun events and competitions to earn special rewards.
Escape to the countryside and experience the joys of farming with Happy Farm - Small Town. Download now and start building the farm of your dreams today!
- Having fun playing every day with a lot of gold and experience
- Try to complete all the challenge tasks
- Watch the video to receive daily reward
- Tons of great discount farming products and ingredients constantly offered on the Market stall
- Smooth game play experience along with beautiful graphics
- Offline playing mode allows you to enjoy the farmer game anywhere and anytime like traveling on the bus or walking down the street

bluejetty:00184811:ios.name: Simple Booth Classic
bluejetty:00184811:ios.summary: Searching for the perfect photo booth app for live events? Look no further. With the Simple Booth Classic app, you can quickly set up a modern DIY photo booth at your next party for just a fraction of the cost of a traditional photo booth.
bluejetty:00184811:ios.description:
Searching for the perfect photo booth app for live events? Look no further. With the Simple Booth Classic app, you can quickly set up a modern DIY photo booth at your next party for just a fraction of the cost of a traditional photo booth. 
Simple Booth Classic is designed to run for hours at a time at events, parties, weddings, birthdays and more. Create a thrilling experience for guests with stunning photo layouts and GIFs. Guests will also appreciate the intuitive screen layout and ability to quickly send their photos by email or text message (U.S. only). And you’ll love the keen attention to detail built into every feature.
Simple Booth Classic is so effortless to use that guests will have time to take as many photos as they want, with or without an attendant. Create a next-generation photo kiosk. Set the app up to run by itself by using the iPad's front camera, so guests can have their very own selfie booth. It works perfectly in either portrait or landscape orientation.
Post-event, you and your guests can relive all of the excitement in your event’s very own online gallery! Your gallery includes the #hashtag of your choice, as well as icons to enable guests to easily share to Facebook, Instagram or Twitter directly from their mobile device. 
You can pre-select GIFs or choose from a variety of traditional photo layout options, including single photos or photo strips. Your guests change their layout with the swipe of a finger, or you can choose to lock the layout down to be the same for every person.
In need of a traditional photo booth experience? We’ve thought of that too. Simple Booth Classic offers printing via AirPrint and comes loaded with automatic formatting for vertical photo strips. You can choose any paper size that your printer supports.
Download the app and create a premium DIY photo booth experience today!
REAL REVIEWS BY REAL USERS
“Being a professional photographer and having worked in the industry for over 30 years, this app has to be the most brilliant one I’ve found…many happy smiles will be captured with this brilliant program” - Marrez Imaging
“This is by far the best photo booth app out there. It is professional and simple to use. If you are looking to do an event or start a business, this is the app to get.” - Yan. T 
MADE WITH LOVE. PACKED WITH PREMIUM FEATURES.
Don’t just satisfy your customers—delight them. Simple Booth Classic is loaded with all of the features and customizable options you need to make your event awesome, including:
• Unlimited number of photos
• Image filters and photo editing
• Online galleries for all photos and GIFs
• AirPrint support
• Automatic formatting for vertical photo strips
• Send pictures by email or via text message (U.S. & Canada only)
• You and your guests have the ability to change layout
• Place branded logos on any GIF or layout
The ultimate photo booth app is at your fingertips. Download the app today!
Love the app? Please rate us on the App Store :)

bluejetty:00175101:ios.description:
Play Your Cards Right in Moxie Word Traveler - A Game of Strategy, Fun, and Wordplay!
Love word puzzles, word patterns, and clever challenges? Moxie Word Traveler combines the best of card and word games into a unique adventure perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers.
• Play at Your Own Pace: No clock, no rush – just pure, relaxing fun.
• Exercise Your Brain: Use strategy and creativity to transform words, avoid “twaddles,” and score big!
• Easy to Learn, Challenging to Master: Simple mechanics, 2,400+ hand-crafted puzzles, and daily challenges invite you back for more.
Unwind while you sharpen your mind and build your vocabulary.
Each level gives you a solitaire-style deck of letter cards to place on the board, creating chains of words. But don’t break the chain – that's called a “twaddle” and it will lock a letter.
Like Scrabble and Words With Friends, you add one letter at a time to the words already on the board, turning them into new words. Like anagram puzzles, word jumbles, and word searches, you use word patterns to find the best spot for each letter.
You can play Moxie Word Traveler anytime, even if you just have a few minutes. Or you can beat many levels at once – it’s up to you!

Elevate your business communication with the Genesys Cloud™ Associate app. Use Genesys Cloud softphone capabilities to make IP-based calls and access your business phone system from your mobile device. Stay in touch with your colleagues, partners and customers from virtually anywhere.

- Use your dedicated Genesys Cloud business phone number to make and receive calls.
- Keep your business and personal phones separate.
- Make and receive calls using Wi-Fi, even in areas with poor cellular coverage.
- Search for people and groups in your organization and personal contacts.
- View your call history and return missed calls.
- Check your inbox to review your voicemails, recordings and faxes.

bluejetty:00168121:ios.description:
Unleash your maximum potential with LooksMax Rate AI.
Whether you want to sharpen your jawline, clear your skin, or build ultimate confidence, our AI-powered coach provides the roadmap to your best self.
LooksMax Rate AI offers a wide range of tips and advice to help you look your best. Get professional-level recommendations on skin care, hairstyle selection, clothing style, and accessories based on your unique features.
HOW IT WORKS:
 1. Upload your photos: Take a selfie or upload clear shots from your gallery.
 2. AI Analysis: Our advanced algorithms scan your facial features, jawline, skin, and symmetry.
 3. Instant Visualization: See your "Maxxed" potential instantly with AI-enhanced previews.
 4. Action Plan: Get a personalized roadmap and start your journey to your best self.
CORE FEATURES:
- Precision face rating: Get honest, objective scores on your facial traits and overall attractiveness.
- AI glow-up visualization: Don't just dream about it - see it. Visualize your improved version with realistic AI enhancements.
- Transformation tracking: Monitor your progress with visual charts. Watch your scores rise as you stick to your routine.
- Comprehensive routines: Build winning habits with our structured daily tasks. Choose repeating actions to stay consistent.
- All-in-one to-do: Dedicated tracks for Skin, Style, Body, Confidence, and Dating.
- Personalized recommendations: Actionable tips tailored specifically to your facial structure and goals.
Become more confident with LooksMax Rate AI! It is not just about photos - it is about the discipline to improve. Whether you want to attract more matches, gain confidence in business, or simply feel better in your own skin, we provide the tools to make it happen.
DISCLAIMER:
LooksMax Rate AI is designed strictly for informational and entertainment purposes. This app is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, professional diagnosis, or treatment plans.
Our AI-generated appearance insights and style suggestions are subjective and intended for self-improvement guidance only. These results should not be used as a substitute for professional consultation with a licensed physician, dermatologist, or other healthcare provider.
By using LooksMax Rate AI, you acknowledge and agree that:
 1. All ratings and suggestions are based on AI algorithms and are not clinical assessments.
 2. You should always consult with a professional before making any health or lifestyle changes based on the app’s content.
 3. We do not guarantee any specific aesthetic or physical results.
Subscription information:
- Prices in countries may vary and the actual cost may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm your purchase.
- Subscription will automatically renew. You can turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Within 24 hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged the subscription renewal fee with the renewal price.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to iTunes Account Settings.
- Subscriptions can be canceled at any time in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
- The unused portion of the free trial, if offered, will be canceled when you purchase a subscription.
- If a free trial is offered, the subscription will automatically renew at the end of the trial period unless canceled before its conclusion

bluejetty:00089036:ios.summary:
LESS TAPPING. MORE PLAYING.

WZHUB is a fast, clean and easy-to-use companion for Warzone and Call of Duty. No cluttered screens, confusing menus or endless
bluejetty:00089036:ios.description:
LESS TAPPING. MORE PLAYING.
Find the loadout you need. Track your camos. Check the map. Get back to the game.
WZHUB is a fast, clean and easy-to-use companion for Warzone and Call of Duty. No cluttered screens, confusing menus or endless navigation. Just the tools you actually need, right where you expect them.
BUILD. TRACK. DOMINATE.
META LOADOUTS — STRAIGHT TO THE POINT
Find powerful weapon builds for Warzone, Modern Warfare 4, Black Ops 7 and other supported games and modes.
• Browse meta loadouts by weapon and tier.
• Check recommended attachments and effective ranges.
• Copy loadout codes and jump straight into the action.
• Quickly switch between builds and weapon categories.
• Explore detailed Weapon Pages without unnecessary distractions.
Find your build. Copy it. Play.
CAMO TRACKER — PROGRESS MADE SIMPLE
Unlocking mastery camos takes time. Tracking your progress shouldn't.
• Track camouflage challenges weapon by weapon.
• Mark completed challenges with a tap.
• See your overall progress at a glance.
• Search and filter weapons to find exactly what you need.
• Save your progress to your WZHUB account.
• Keep your progress synced between the app and WZHUB.GG.
Less time managing your tracker. More time completing challenges.
INTERACTIVE MAPS — FIND WHAT MATTERS
Explore detailed interactive maps for Warzone, Zombies and DMZ.
• Find points of interest and important locations.
• Search the map to locate what you need.
• Customize map layers and filters.
• Explore locations, Easter eggs and useful information.
• Save your map preferences with your account.
Open the map. Find your target. Get moving.
WARZONE PLAYLIST — STAY UPDATED
Check Warzone playlists and seasonal information in a clear, easy-to-read layout.
No unnecessary steps. Just the information you came for.
BUILT FOR SPEED AND SIMPLICITY
WZHUB is designed around how players actually use companion apps.
• Clean, modern interface.
• Quick access to your favorite tools.
• Smooth, intuitive navigation.
• Easy-to-read loadouts, maps and trackers.
• Optimized layouts for iPhone and iPad.
• Account-based progress synchronization with WZHUB.GG.
Whether you're preparing a loadout, chasing a mastery camo or exploring a new map, WZHUB helps you spend less time searching and more time playing.
BUILD. TRACK. DOMINATE.
WZHUB is an independent fan-made companion and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Welcome to Lorcana, Illumineers! The Disney Lorcana Companion app is the official app to manage your Disney Lorcana ca rd collection. Use it to discover cards, keep track of your collection, and get helpful gameplay tools.
The Disney Lorcana TCG Companion app includes useful features like:
- A comprehensive visual card catalog that provides essential information, with card renders that respond to your movement to give you a better look at the gorgeous foil treatments.

- Alerts for the latest news and articles, so you can stay up to date on all things Lorcana.

Télécharge l’appli Skyrock et rejoins la communauté de la première radio urbaine mondiale !
Écoute gratuitement le meilleur du Rap français, du R&B et de la musique urbaine. Retrouve tout l’univers Skyrock dans ton mobile : hits en exclu, émissions cultes et expérience ultra-connectée.
LE MEILLEUR DU SON ET DE LA RADIO
• LE DIRECT : Écoute ta radio préférée en haute qualité.
• EMISSIONS CULTES : Tous les contenus Morning de Difool, Radio Libre et Planète Rap.
• RADIOS THÉMATIQUES : Urban Music Non-Stop, 100% Français, Klassiks... choisis ton style et écoute encore plus de sons !
• SONS DIFFUSES: Retrouve et réécoute les derniers morceaux passés à l’antenne en un seul endroit.
• PODCASTS : T'as loupé l'émission de ce matin ? Tous les replays sont disponibles en podcasts, avec même quelques exclus comme les Interview Skyrock par M'Rik. Télécharge les et écoute ça même hors connexion.
• VIDEOS : Le live vidéo et tous le meilleur de Planète Rap est dispo dans ton app.
UNE EXPÉRIENCE 100% CONNECTÉE
• RÉVEIL ET VEILLE : Programme ton alarme pour te réveiller avec le son Skyrock.
• MESSAGE À L’ANTENNE : Réagis en direct ! Tes messages s’affichent en temps réel dans le studio.
• TON PROFIL : Créé gratuitement ton compte Skyrock et personnalise ton compte avec tes photos, tes artistes favoris et ta meilleure punchline.
• CHAT & RENCONTRES : Discute avec des milliers d'utilisateurs via le chat et la messagerie Skyrock.
• ACTUS URBAINE : News, concerts, exclusivités... ne rate rien de la culture rap.
JEUX ET CADEAUX
• 72020, ROULETTE ET 1500 : Toutes les infos sur les jeux antenne qui te font gagner PS5, iPhone ou encore des milliers d'euros.
• ECOUTE GAGNANTE : C'est simple, tu écoutes nos radios et tu gagnes ... sans rien faire.
CONNECTIVITÉ TOTALE
• CARPLAY : Retrouve Skyrock directement sur le tableau de bord de ta voiture.
• APPLE WATCH : Pilote ta radio et tes podcasts depuis ton poignet.
Une suggestion ou un problème ? Contacte-nous dans la rubrique « Contacte-nous » des réglages ou sur support@skyrock.fm.
Suis-nous partout : TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, Snapchat : @skyrockfm @planeterap

bluejetty:00135578:ios.summary: Color Picker & Palette Generator is a helpful all-in-one color tool for a creative person that works with color palettes on a daily basis. Get the app because this Color Picker will help you in all possible easy ways to create a harmonious
bluejetty:00135578:ios.description:
Color Picker & Palette Generator is a helpful all-in-one color tool for a creative person that works with color palettes on a daily basis. Get the app because this Color Picker will help you in all possible easy ways to create a harmonious color palette for your art projects or detect & collect beautiful colors around you.
– Create a color palette from an image or photo – grab auto-generated color swatches extracted from the uploaded image or manually pick colors from an image with the Color Picker tool (Eyedropper).
– Create palettes from the colors you collect around you! Capture and detect colors simply by pointing the camera at the object. The app identifies the color name and hex color code of the selected area on the screen.
– Color Palette Generator. The application algorithm creates harmonious color palettes and you can adjust color values to your liking. Or you can generate with our app a harmonious color palette with any custom color you input to Magic Generator.
– Color Harmonies. For each color you collect, the app creates color combinations that go well with a base color (based on color theory and color wheel harmonies). Grab a pre-defined color palette and adjust color values to your liking.
Are you colorblind, unable to distinguish certain color hues, or simply want to know What color is it? It is a simple-to-use app for identifying colors around you – just point at anything the Live Camera Color Picker and it will tell you the color.
Easily save, share, duplicate, remove and edit already saved palettes. The app supports the most common color models as RGB, HEX, LAB, HSV, HSL, CMYK and color formats – .PNG, .SVG, .ACO, .ASE, .GPL.
Whether you’re creating visual graphics, painting digitally, designing logos or interfaces, trying to match the brand color theme – being able to select the right color or palette quickly is important. Color Picker & Palette Generator helps you create harmonious color schemes with ease. Generate palettes, find a hex code of needed hue, edit colors to your liking, and find everyday inspiration with one app.

bluejetty:00063518:ios.name: Hugo Troll Race 2: Rail Rush
bluejetty:00063518:ios.summary: Play the sequel to the smash hit endless runner that had generations of players glued to their screens! Hugo Troll Race 2 brings back everything you loved in the original game, plus tons of fun new features, awesome graphics and plenty of s
bluejetty:00063518:ios.description:
Play the sequel to the smash hit endless runner that had generations of players glued to their screens! Hugo Troll Race 2 brings back everything you loved in the original game, plus tons of fun new features, awesome graphics and plenty of surprises! Did we mention loads of new content as well?
Join Hugo in his fight against Scylla and her minions and gather as much gold as possible by demonstrating your ultimate trolley-driving skills! Navigate dark mines, dodge trains, use power-ups and put your whole bag of tricks to work against her Evilness. 
ONE-ON-ONE BATTLE
Face Scylla, Hugo’s nemesis, in a direct battle where only an unparalleled set of skills can defeat her! Win incredible prizes in Daily Quests, but don’t spend all that gold in one place!
PLAY AS HUGOLINA
Want to take a break from playing as Hugo? Of course you can do that! Hugolina is eager to hop on the trolley and join the fun. There are even loads of different outfits that you can purchase for her. 
NEW TROLLEYS
While you’ll find all the classic trolleys you love, there is an exciting selection of new mine-friendly vehicles, waiting to be taken out for a ride on the tracks. Which ones do you like best?
NEW DYNAMIC ENVIRONMENTS
Immerse in the gameplay and feel like you’re part of the action! Just be careful: don’t allow your attention to be diverted by the beautiful lava stalagmites or fiery lava fountains! 
Dodge mine carts, avoid falling stalactites and stalagmites that burst upwards, speeding trains, dirt mounds and, of course, hordes of Crocos!
COMPETE AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS
What will your best score be? Make your unmatched skills known to all of your friends by getting the highest scores on the Leaderboard!
MANY NEW COLLECTIBLES
You’re not a real Troll if collecting things is not among your hobbies! We’ve added loads of exciting (and shiny!) items to collect. Add new trolleys and outfits to your collection and make sure Hugo and Hugolina always ride in style! There is also an impressive list of upgrades to purchase and employ in your fight against Scylla!

bluejetty:00088354:ios.description:
"Get ready for an enchanting and thrilling Halloween experience like never before with our Halloween Witch and Wizard game!
Immerse yourself in the magical world of Halloween City Night, where adventure and action await at every corner. The city comes alive with bubble-faced pumpkins, eerie skeletons, and an atmosphere that's both spooky and exciting.
Embark on a series of challenging missions, including daring escapes, thrilling chases, and the noble quest to rescue kidnapped children. Each level will test your skills and courage as you explore this mysterious world.
Meet our three incredible characters, including the next-generation witch and wizard, each with unique abilities. The flying witch takes to the skies to chase ghosts and save children, while the fast wizard wields formidable powers to capture and return these mischievous spirits to the Wizard Hill in the fort.
Explore a richly detailed world with diverse environments. Soar over the city, explore the ancient fort, navigate the haunted graveyard, and venture deep into the eerie forest. You have the freedom to go wherever your heart desires!
And what's Halloween without gifts? Our benevolent witch personally delivers gifts door-to-door, adding an extra layer of charm to this spine-tingling event.
With realistic gameplay, you'll enjoy a seamless experience of walking, running, and jumping through this fantastical world. The roadside comes alive with pumpkin-lined streets and skull decorations hanging from trees.
Customize your perspective with a flexible camera position; simply touch the screen to find the perfect angle for your adventure.
Unravel the mysteries of Halloween as you dive into this unforgettable adventure, filled with horror and funky elements that create a captivating atmosphere.
Your mission is crucial: the survival of kids and wizards is at stake, and the academia in this game is yandere. Prepare for a mix of excitement, heartwarming moments, and spine-tingling surprises as you delve into the Halloween Witch and Wizard experience!
Are you ready to embark on a spellbinding journey? Download now and join the Halloween festivities like never before. Don't miss your chance to become the ultimate Halloween hero!

Realistic Night Weather
Immersive Gameplay
Dynamic Environments
Freedom of Movement
Magical Flying Mechanics
Heartwarming Gift Delivery
Horror-Funky Atmosphere
Academic and Yandere Elements
Spooky Halloween Theme
Witchcraft Adventure
Creepy Forest Exploration
Kidnapped Children Rescue
Halloween City Night

Whether you're dressing up your character in a toga like a Roman, enjoying a fun game of yo-yo, or pretending to eat a taco at a lively food stall, Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life offers something for everyone. If you like Roblox and crave adventures, this game will make you go aha! Explore a vibrant city and immerse yourself in a wonder world full of fun and storytelling opportunities. Get ready to Go Aha in this wonder world where every moment is a new adventure.
In Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life, you can create and customize avatars in a way that suits your style. Dress up your dream avatar in a toga, or choose modern outfits to reflect the vibrant life of the city. Once your character is ready, take them on an adventure through various scenes like the police station, restaurant, hotel, garden, and more. Each location in this wonderful world is a canvas for your imagination, where you can learn and play in countless ways. Whether you're managing a mini town or exploring a mega city, Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life is packed with opportunities to create stories and live out your wildest dreams.
Explore the townhome of your dreams, where every room is a new adventure. From the cozy comfort of your apartment to the bustling excitement of the police station, there's no end to the fun you can have. Visit the restaurant to pretend you're a master chef or check into the hotel for a relaxing getaway. Feel the breeze at the beach, set up camp in the garden, or run a food stall where customers shout, “Let's go taca taca!” and “eat a taco!” Each scene is designed to let you Go Aha with delight as you learn and play in this wonderful world.
Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life isn't just about role-playing; it's about living a life full of joy. Whether you're a mini character exploring a mega world or a seasoned avatar mastering the art of storytelling, this game provides a dynamic platform for creative expression. It's like having a wonder world in your pocket, where you can switch between different scenes in a city or a town, creating endless possibilities for fun. If you enjoy Roblox, you'll love the dream avatar experience in Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life.
In addition to all the fun and creativity, Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life encourages players to explore different aspects of daily life in a city or town setting. Whether you're running a mini market, setting up a camp, or solving mysteries in the police station, this game offers a world of opportunities to learn and play. The townhome becomes your playground, and each location in this world game offers a unique backdrop for your stories. Go Aha as you learn and play in this interactive dream world where every scene is a new adventure.
With so many exciting scenes to explore, Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life truly lives up to its name. It’s not just a game; it's a wonderful world where you can create, imagine, and live out your dreams. Whether you're managing your own town, building relationships in the city, or dressing up your character in a stylish toga, this game offers endless fun. Each scene is a new chapter in your life story, and with every download, you're adding to a global world game community that celebrates creativity and fun.
Ready to Go Aha in the wonderful world of Tizi Town: Fantasy Avatar Life? Download now and start your adventure today! Whether you’re exploring the city or relaxing in your townhome, there's always something new to discover. Learn and play with friends, create stories in different scenes, and watch your dream avatar come to life in this wonder world. From mini adventures to mega experiences.

Enter our GTA 6 Ultimate and Standard giveaway contest, where 50 lucky fans will win a free copy of the most anticipated video game, ever. Results are randomized, and winners are notified instantly. Don't miss your ticket to Vice City. 
FanUp is the easiest way to play and win. Pick your favorites in fantasy sports, reality TV, and pop culture, compete with friends and fans everywhere, and win real prizes from the world's biggest brands. No experience needed. No spreadsheets. Just you, your picks, and a community of millions of fans, where every fan wins.
PLAY WHAT YOU LOVE
NFL, NBA, MLB, F1, EPL, La Liga, IPL, soccer, every season of the shows you cannot stop talking about: Love Island, The Traitors, Dancing with the Stars, Ted Lasso, and more. If fans are talking about it, there are predictions and contests for it.

Four picks. One tap. Quick Pick builds your lineup in under 3 seconds so you can play between texts, between episodes, between everything. No drafts. No waivers. No salary caps. It's that easy.
WIN REAL PRIZES
Cash, tickets, trips, and rewards from Nike, Sephora, Alo, Lululemon, StubHub, and 75+ brands you actually love. Weekly prizes drop all season long, and our biggest contests give away up to $2.1M. Every week, thousands of fans win something.
PLAY TOGETHER
Challenge your friends, join your group chat's league, chat live during every contest, and climb the leaderboard with millions of fans around the world. Fandom is better together.
FREE TO PLAY
Enter contests for free, win real prizes, and level up with in app rewards. FanUp is free to download and free to play.
WATCH THE RANDOMIZER
When you win, you know instantly. Watch the Randomizer pick winners live and get your prize sent straight to you.
Link up. Level up. Live it up.

From trends to strategy - everything you need in one app.

On Monday, wake up with a ready-to-go content strategy, video scripts, post ideas, and performance insights. Review, approve, and shoot/create. Trendy takes care of the rest.

“Finally consistent without burning out” — Lifestyle Blogger

Bloggers, creators, small businesses, coaches, artists - anyone with too many ideas and no clear plan.

Stop guessing. Start growing.
Download Trendy, your AI Co-pilot for social media success

bluejetty:00032116:ios.description:
Loopsie is your all-in-one video editor and photo generator app for creating stunning, AI-generated & dynamic content that captures attention and turns heads. Whether you’re looking to animate your photos into immersive 3D masterpieces through cinematic motion, create AI videos, or enhance your pictures with vibrant AI effects, Loopsie has everything you need to elevate your creativity.
We update the app weekly with fresh AI effects and presets, ensuring you always have access to the latest AI trends and tools to make your content stand out & go viral.
Key Features You Must Try
Anime Filters – AI Art with a Tap!
Have you ever wondered what you’d look like as an anime character? Loopsie’s AI effects anime generator technology can turn your photos into toon headshots with a single tap. It’s fast, fun, and perfect for creating viral photos & videos that get people talking.
Explore Popular AI Effects & Presets
Choose from a wide variety of AI effects and presets to match any mood or theme. Some of our most-loved options include:
- AI Anime Generator: Turn yourself into your favorite anime character.
- 90’s AI Polaroid: Rediscover the charm of 90’s Polaroids.
- Legends: Add a heroic touch to your visuals.
- Vertigo: Create mesmerizing, dizzying motion AI effects.
- Neon & Sparkle: Light up your photos with vibrant, eye-catching details.
- Cloud, Vaporwave, VHS, Indie: Tap into retro vibes or futuristic aesthetics.
3D Photos – Add Depth and Dimension
Create immersive 3D photos with ease. Use Loopsie’s integrated 3D camera to capture the moment or animate any standard photo into a stunning 3D experience. From classic 360° wiggle AI effects to smooth vertical motions, Loopsie brings your photos to life like never before.
Cutting-Edge AI Technology
- AI-Powered Depth Prediction: Loopsie’s neural network intelligently predicts depth for every photo, giving it a realistic, dimensional look.
- Augmented Reality Stickers: Add 3D stickers that interact with your photos in captivating ways.
- Advanced 3D Scene Reconstruction: Our unique algorithm fills in missing details for a seamless 3D scene.
- 3D Subject Segmentation: Highlight key subjects in your photos with precise AI-powered segmentation.
Discover Loopsie AI Effects Pro – Unlock Your Full Potential
Upgrade to Loopsie AI Effects Pro to access all the premium AI effects, filters, tools, and presets. Whether you’re a casual creator or a content pro, our subscription plans are designed to fit your needs:
Weekly, Monthly, Yearly, or Lifetime Plans
Cancel anytime! Manage your subscription directly in your Account Settings.
Prefer a one-time purchase? Go for our Lifetime Access option for unlimited creativity.
Here’s what makes Loopsie the go-to app for creative viral content:
Intuitive interface that’s easy for beginners yet powerful enough for pros.
A constantly growing library of AI effects and tools updated weekly.
Seamless sharing to all major platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, and more.
Stay Connected with Loopsie
Have questions or feedback? iOS.support@loopsie.it – we’d love to hear from you!
Follow us on Instagram and TikTok (@loopsieapp) for inspiration, tutorials, and the latest updates.
Subscription and Free Trial Policy
Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal via your Account Settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited upon purchase of a subscription.
Terms and conditions:
https://bit.ly/2PWcXgi
Privacy policy:
https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/8126812

bluejetty:00089501:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00089501:ios.description:
Flow Lab is your digital performance & mindset coach to improve your concentration, self-confidence & grit through personalized guided meditation and coaching exercises.
Based on research in Positive Psychology our digital coach analyzes your mental and emotional state and generates your individual flow profile by asking you about your challenges, feelings and experiences on a daily basis. In your weekly schedule you will find guided meditations that help you to find the concentration and motivation to overcome procrastination to unlock peak performance and productivity.
Our Flow Coaching helps you develop a growth mindset that gives you the self confidence, optimism and grit to step out of your comfort zone and find into the Flow State - the mental state where peak performance and productivity feel fun and effortless.
Did you know that in Flow we are up to 5 times more productive, increase our creativity by up to 600% and learn up to 5 times faster!
MENTAL TRAINING TECHNIQUES YOU’LL FIND IN OUR FLOW SESSIONS:
- Mindfulness Meditations
- Breathing Exercises
- Goal Setting
- Visualization
- Positive Affirmations
- Mindset Priming
- Hypnosis
- Relaxation
- Inspirational Quotes
- and others from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Mental Coaching and Performance Psychology
WHAT DO YOU TRAIN WITH FLOW LAB?
Focus - Strengthen your self-awareness, concentration and attentional control to productively manage distractions and mind wandering.
Ease - Learn to balance yourself emotionally to remain calm and level-headed - even under stress.
Optimism - Develop the self-confidence and positive thinking habits to master difficult challenges with determination and joy.
Drive - Increase your grit, stoicism and perseverance and develop a growth mindset that fuels the motivation you need to achieve your goals.
HOW DO YOU TRAIN WITH FLOW LAB?
With Flow Lab you train your mind in guided audio sessions to master your everyday challenges with more flow. Through mindfulness-based meditation and breathing exercises you will increase your ability to concentrate and your emotional balance. But Flow Lab is more than traditional mindfulness training: Science-based mental training exercises from positive neuroplasticity training and cognitive behavioral therapy also help you cultivate positive emotions, overcome limiting beliefs and develop an optimistic and resilient mindset.
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND CONDITIONS
The subscription is automatically renewed unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current term. Your iTunes account will be charged for the next term within 24 hours of the current subscription expiring. You can turn off automatic renewal at any time via iTunes Account Settings.
Flow Lab integrates with the Apple Health app. If you chose to connect Flow Lab with Apple Health you will be able to track your meditations as mindful minutes.
Learn more about our privacy policy and terms and conditions here:
https://theflowlab.de/en/privacy-policy/
https://theflowlab.de/en/terms-and-conditions/

GROUP CHAT THAT’S ALL FUN & GAME
bluejetty:00019049:ios.description:
Discord is designed for gaming and great for just chilling with friends or building a community. Customize your own space and gather your friends to talk while playing your favorite games, or just hang out.
GROUP CHAT THAT’S ALL FUN & GAMES
∙ Discord is great for playing games and chilling with friends, or even building a worldwide community. Customize your own space to talk, play, and hang out in.
MAKE YOUR GROUP CHATS MORE FUN
∙ Create custom emoji, stickers, soundboard effects, and more to add your personality to voice, video, or text chat. Set your avatar, a custom status, and write your own profile to show up in chat your way.
STREAM LIKE YOU’RE IN THE SAME ROOM
∙ High-quality and low-latency streaming makes it feel like you're hanging out on the couch with friends while playing a game, watching shows, looking at photos, or idk doing homework or something.
HOP IN WHEN YOU’RE FREE, NO NEED TO CALL
∙ Easily hop in and out of voice or text chats without having to call or invite anyone, so you can chat with your friends before, during, and after your game session.
SEE WHO’S AROUND TO CHILL
∙ See who’s around, playing games, or just hanging out. For supported games, you can see what modes or characters your friends are playing and directly join up.
ALWAYS HAVE SOMETHING TO DO TOGETHER
∙ Watch videos, play built-in games, listen to music, or just scroll together and spam memes. Seamlessly text, call, video chat, and play games, all in one group chat.
WHEREVER YOU GAME, HANG OUT HERE
∙ On your PC, phone, or console, you can still hang out on Discord. Easily switch between devices and use tools to manage multiple group chats with friends.

Ready for love, friendship, or a thrilling romance? Start your journey now and see where your choices lead you!
[ CHOOSE YOUR LOVE STORY ]
Meet five stunning housemates, each with a unique personality and story!
Decide Your Fate: Your choices change the story—will you find true love, a hidden secret, or a shocking twist?
Live the Fantasy: From sweet moments to intense drama, every interaction feels real with high-quality FMV scenes.
[ Meet Your Dream Housemates ]
The Loyal Friend – Go Mal-sook
"Are we really just friends?"
Your childhood friend who’s tired of being just that.
The Fallen Idol – Park Min-jung
"I want more than just fan service."
Your first love who dreams of a real romance.
The Boss – Gran
"So, you like this kind of thing, Yoo-man?"
Your demanding boss who loves to tease.
The Bold Junior – Go Eun-bi
"I came to marry you, oppa!"
Your straightforward junior who knows what she wants.

"I’ve been saved."

Prepare for unexpected twists, secret endings, and maybe even a BAD END if you’re not careful!

Immersive FMV Experience
Real-life video sequences with professional actors.
Every conversation, glance, and touch feels intensely real.
100+ Story Paths & Multiple Endings
Your choices lead to different stories and fates.
Unlock special endings and hidden scenarios.
Text, Chat, and Romance
Deepen your bond through texts and heart-fluttering chats.
Uncover the girls’ secrets as you get closer.
High-Quality Acting & Cinematic Production
Feel like you’re in a real romance with movie-quality FMV scenes.
Famous creators bring each character to life with authentic performances.
Five Unique Love Interests
The childhood friend, the idol, the boss, the direct junior, and the shy recluse.

Crave a live-action FMV romance experience.
Dream of being surrounded by beautiful women.
Love romance sims with deep stories and real consequences.
Enjoy uncovering secrets through chat and texts.
Want a romance game with multiple love interests.
Can’t resist a thrilling mix of drama, suspense, and love!
[ A Message from the Developers ]
We believe that love stories should feel real and unforgettable.
Five Hearts Under One Roof combines live-action FMV with an interactive romance sim to bring you a love story that’s truly yours.
Choose your girl, craft your love story, and discover an ending that will stay with you forever.
Whether you want a sweet romance, a thrilling twist, or a bit of both, your story begins here.

bluejetty:00114358:ios.description:
Indy isn't a human coach. It's a different kind of support, one that couldn't exist without ADHD coaching.
100,000+ real ADHD coaching sessions went into building it: the questions that actually help, the frameworks that work for ADHD brains, the moments when someone needs structure and when they need permission to stop. That knowledge lives inside every check-in. What Indy does with it is show up daily, every morning, every evening, every time you're spiraling at 11pm, in the moments a human coach can't reach.
---
WHO INDY IS FOR
People with ADHD who:
- Keep losing the thread of what they're actually trying to do
- Feel overwhelmed or stuck despite genuinely caring about their goals
- Have abandoned planners, trackers, and systems that work for other people
- Aren't sure what they even want anymore
You don't need motivation or a perfect plan to start. Indy meets you where you are.
---
WHAT INDY DOES
DAILY CHECK-INS
Morning and evening sessions under 5 minutes. Morning: slow down and choose what actually matters today. Evening: close the loop without guilt, and notice what you actually got done.
WEEKLY PLANNING
Short sessions to set realistic priorities, anticipate what might get in the way, and connect this week to what you're actually building. The roadblock question alone is worth the download.
SUPPORT WHEN YOU SPIRAL
When you're stuck, scattered, or starting to spiral, Indy helps you find the next concrete move. Not a lecture. A path forward.
SELF-KNOWLEDGE
Guided exercises to understand your strengths, energy patterns, and what makes you tick. The more Indy knows you, the more useful every check-in becomes.
CHALLENGES
10 to 14-day challenges designed for how ADHD brains actually build habits, not how neurotypical planners assume they do.
PROGRESS & PATTERNS
Track wins and insights over time. See what's working. Understand yourself better than any planner has helped you before.
---
WHAT USERS SAY
"It removes the cognitive load of getting from A to B. I only saw where I wanted to go — now I actually get there." — Sarah P., Indy member
"My life is so much more organized and I'm less flaky and dipsy." — Edelweiss S., Indy member
"It helps me break things down so I don't feel overwhelmed and can actually get started." — Christy, Workshop Facilitator
"I recommend Indy to all my clients." — Karen J., ADHD Coach
---
WHAT SETS INDY APART
* Built from 100,000+ real ADHD coaching sessions, not generic AI
* No streaks, no guilt, use it when you actually need it
* Not a productivity app. A compass.
* Designed by ADHD coaches, clinicians, and people who live this
* Free
---
GET STARTED
You don't need clarity or momentum to begin.
Indy helps you find your next step, whatever day it is.
100% free to download.

firefox-addons:2998148.name: Automatic Tab Discarder
firefox-addons:2998148.summary: Automatically unload inactive tabs from memory to keep Firefox fast. Tabs stay in your tab bar and reload when you need them — no lost history, just a lighter browser.
firefox-addons:2998148.description:
Tab Discarder keeps Firefox running smoothly by automatically unloading tabs you haven't used in a while. Discarded tabs remain visible in your tab bar and reload instantly when you click them — you won't lose any history or bookmarks.
🔧 FEATURES
• Automatic discard — inactive tabs are unloaded after a configurable time (5–120 minutes)
• Manual discard — one click to free up memory from all eligible tabs right now
• Live stats — see how many tabs are open, asleep, or eligible for discarding
• Pinned tab protection — pinned tabs are never discarded (optional)
• Audio protection — tabs playing music or video are never discarded (optional)
• Lightweight — runs quietly in the background, checks once per minute
• No data collection — this extension does not collect, transmit, or share any data whatsoever
💡 HOW IT WORKS
When a tab hasn't been active for longer than your chosen threshold, Tab Discarder unloads it from memory. The tab title and favicon stay visible in the tab bar. Clicking the tab reloads it normally. This is the same mechanism Firefox uses natively — Tab Discarder just gives you control over when and how it happens.
🔒 PRIVACY
Tab Discarder requires only the permissions it needs: tab access (to detect activity and discard tabs), storage (to save your settings), and alarms (to check tabs on a schedule). No browsing data ever leaves your browser.

apple-macos:6826638764.name: Moneyflow: Sankey Finance
apple-macos:6826638764.description:
See exactly where your money goes, and where it's headed.
Moneyflow turns your budget into a living Sankey diagram. Income streams in on the left and flows through your needs, wants, savings and investments. Every ribbon is as wide as the money inside it, so your biggest expenses and your best habits stand out in seconds.
Then look ahead. Step through every month and watch the picture change. Moneyflow projects your whole timeline, from six months to thirty years, so you can see what your choices add up to.
WATCH YOUR WEALTH GROW
• Savings and investments compound at the rate you choose
• See your total balance climb, and every account on its own line
• Debts shrink month by month as you pay them down
SEE EVERY EXPENSE, EVERY MONTH
• A month-by-month table of income, spending and savings, with a colour for every category
• Plan one-off costs like a laptop or a trip, and see only the month they land
• Change a single month, or apply the change from then on
• Due dates on your payments, right on the diagram
BUILT FOR SWISS SAVERS
• Pillar 3a and Pillar 2 contributions, with a warning when you pass the yearly cap
• See the tax you save along the way
MAKE IT YOURS
• Tap any box to set its amount, colour and growth
• Drag to reorder, pinch to zoom in on the details
• Keep several budgets: yours, a partner's, or a what-if plan
• Undo and redo, CSV export, dark and light appearance
• One app for Mac, iPad and iPhone
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No bank connection. No tracking. Everything stays on your device.
Moneyflow is a planning tool. It does not move money, connect to your bank, or give financial advice.

Deep calm breathing combined with relaxing sleep music and sleep sounds leads to the predominance of the processes of inhibition in the central nervous system. Deep and controlled breathing is evolutionarily associated with a feeling of rest and relaxation. In addition, soothing sleep sounds provide an opportunity to relax and get a positive emotion, effectively reducing the likelihood of excitation before sleep.
Sleep recording:
Our sleep tracker app is also a snore recorder and sleep recorder which helps you track snoring and other sleep habits, including sleep apnea.
Sleep retention:
Breathing techniques results in more reliable replacement of wakefulness rhythms (alpha and beta waves) with low-amplitude sleep waves (theta and delta waves), thus making sleep much more durable. Meditation sessions promote deep relaxation and mindfulness, bring the body to a deep and lasting sleep. Bedtime meditation qualitatively improves the most fragile REM phase, which allows you to complete a full sleep cycle and feel yourself full of energy in the morning.
Waking Up Refreshed

Pleasant alarm melodies allow you to wake up gently, gradually and with no stress. It is very important for mental wellness to live the first minutes of your day with positive emotions and thoughts.
Sleep Sounds
